en.narration:
Mysore Palace is a DREAM made of STONE! 🏰

Imagine a MASSIVE palace made of PINK and GOLDEN stone! It looks like something from a FAIRY TALE! ✨

The palace has 200+ ROOMS! Each one is filled with INTRICATE CARVINGS, PAINTINGS, and DECORATIONS! 🎨 It took workers YEARS to carve and decorate everything!

The dome is SO TALL that it looks like it's touching the SKY! When you look up - WOW! 🏔️

The Eastern Gate is made of SOLID SILVER! It's SO HEAVY but opens so SMOOTHLY - ancient engineering GENIUS! 🥈

BUT here's the COOLEST part: The Royal Family STILL LIVES HERE! It's not just a museum - it's a REAL HOME for a REAL KING! 👑 How cool is that?

During the DUSSEHRA FESTIVAL (September-October), the entire palace is ILLUMINATED with 100,000+ LIGHTS! 💡 It's like the palace is MADE OF LIGHT! The whole thing GLOWS! ✨

At SUNSET, the pink and golden stone catches the light and the palace LITERALLY GLOWS GOLDEN! 🌅 Photographers from around the WORLD come to take pictures!

Inside, there are:
- Royal treasures 💎
- Ancient artifacts 🏺
- Beautiful gardens 🌳
- Throne rooms 👑
- Private chambers 🛏️

When you visit, you can:
- Walk through the grand halls 🚶
- See the royal treasures 💎
- Take photos in the golden light 📸
- Experience royalty! 👑

Mysore Palace teaches us that BEAUTY and GRANDEUR can last CENTURIES! 🏰

kn.title: 🏰 ಮೈಸೂರು ಅರಮನೆ - ರಾಜಮನೆತನದ ಸ್ಮಾರಕ!
kn.mainText: ಮೈಸೂರು ಅರಮನೆಯು ಮೈಸೂರಿನ ಭವ್ಯ ರಾಜಮನೆತನದ ಅರಮನೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಇದರ ಇಂಡೋ-ಸಾರಸೆನಿಕ್ ವಾಸ್ತುಶೈಲಿ, ಅಲಂಕೃತ ಒಳಾಂಗಣ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶೇಷ ಸಂದರ್ಭಗಳ ಬೆಳಕು ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ! ✨

didYouKnow.text: ನಿಮಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತೇ? 1897ರಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಮರದ ಅರಮನೆ ಬೆಂಕಿಯಿಂದ ನಾಶವಾದ ನಂತರ ಈಗಿನ ಮೈಸೂರು ಅರಮನೆ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲಾಯಿತು! 🔥🏰

tryThis.text: ಭೇಟಿ ನೀಡಿದಾಗ ಗುಂಬಜಗಳು, ಕಮಾನುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅಲಂಕೃತ ಒಳಾಂಗಣಗಳನ್ನು ಗಮನಿಸಿ; ಎಷ್ಟು ವಿಭಿನ್ನ ವಾಸ್ತು ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯಬಹುದು ನೋಡಿ! 🔎

kn.narration:
ಮೈಸೂರು ಅರಮನೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ರಾಜಮನೆತನದ ಸ್ಮಾರಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು! 🏰

ಈಗಿನ ಅರಮನೆ 1912ರಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಂಡಿತು ಮತ್ತು ಇದು ಮೈಸೂರು ವೊಡೆಯರ್ ರಾಜವಂಶದೊಂದಿಗೆ ನಿಕಟವಾಗಿ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದೆ. 👑

ಇದರ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಂಡೋ-ಸಾರಸೆನಿಕ್, ಇಸ್ಲಾಮಿಕ್, ರಾಜಪೂತ ಮತ್ತು ಗೋಥಿಕ್ ಪ್ರಭಾವಗಳು ಸೇರಿವೆ. ಗುಂಬಜಗಳು, ಕಮಾನುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅಲಂಕಾರಗಳಿಂದ ಅರಮನೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಭವ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ. 🎨

ವಿಶೇಷ ಸಂದರ್ಭಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ದೀಪಗಳಿಂದ ಅರಮನೆಯನ್ನು ಬೆಳಗಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಮೈಸೂರು ದಸರಾ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ ನಗರವು ಮೆರವಣಿಗೆ, ಸಂಗೀತ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮಗಳಿಂದ ಕಂಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. 🎉

ಇದು ಇತಿಹಾಸ, ವಾಸ್ತುಶಿಲ್ಪ ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವಂತ ಪರಂಪರೆ ಒಂದಾಗಿರುವ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಸ್ಥಳ!

keyFacts.text: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಮೈಸೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇದೆ! 📍
ಈಗಿನ ಅರಮನೆ 1912ರಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಂಡಿತು! 📅
ಇದರ ವಾಸ್ತುಶೈಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇಂಡೋ-ಸಾರಸೆನಿಕ್, ಇಸ್ಲಾಮಿಕ್, ರಾಜಪೂತ ಮತ್ತು ಗೋಥಿಕ್ ಪ್ರಭಾವಗಳಿವೆ! 🏛️
ಅರಮನೆ ಮೈಸೂರು ವೊಡೆಯರ್ ರಾಜವಂಶದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಹೊಂದಿದೆ! 👑
ವಿಶೇಷ ಸಂದರ್ಭಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅರಮನೆ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ದೀಪಗಳಿಂದ ಬೆಳಗುತ್ತದೆ! 💡
ಮೈಸೂರು ದಸರಾ ನಗರದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಹಬ್ಬಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು! 🎉
The Royal Family: STILL lives here! 👑
Dussehra Festival: Entire palace is lit with 100,000+ lights! 💡
Museum inside: You can see royal treasures! 💎
Gardens: Beautiful landscaped gardens! 🌳

coolFacts.text: ಮೈಸೂರು ಅರಮನೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಪರಂಪರೆ ಸ್ಮಾರಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು! 🏰
ಅರಮನೆಯೊಳಗೆ ಅಲಂಕೃತ ಸಭಾಂಗಣಗಳು, ಕಲಾಕೃತಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ರಾಜಮನೆತನದ ವಸ್ತುಗಳಿವೆ! 🎨
ಇದರ ವಾಸ್ತುಶೈಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಲವು ವಿಭಿನ್ನ ಪರಂಪರೆಗಳ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆ ಇದೆ! 🧩
ರಾತ್ರಿ ಬೆಳಗಿಸಿದಾಗ ಅರಮನೆ ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ಆಕರ್ಷಕವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ! ✨
ಮೈಸೂರನ್ನು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ರಾಜಧಾನಿ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ! 🎭
The Royal Family STILL LIVES in the palace! It's not just a museum - it's a real HOME for a real KING! 👑

en.title: 🐘 INDIAN ELEPHANT - The GENTLE GIANT!
en.mainText: The Asian elephant is the largest land animal in Asia and can weigh several tonnes. 🐘 Has amazing MEMORY! Can pick up things with its TRUNK! So SMART and LOVING! 💚

keyFacts.text: Weight: 5000 kg! (Like 80 adult humans!) 💪
Height: 3 meters at shoulder! (Taller than a basketball hoop!) 🏀
Trunk: 40,000+ muscles! Can pick up a PEANUT! 🌰
Ears: Can be 4 meters long! (Size of a car!) 🚗
Memory: NEVER forgets! 🧠
Lifespan: 60-70 years! (Almost human!) 👴
Diet: Eats 200 kg of food per day! 🍌
Lives in: Western Ghats, South India forests 🌲
Baby: Called a CALF - born 2 kg! 👶
Social: Lives in herds, VERY family-oriented! 👥

coolFacts.text: Indian Elephants have AMAZING memories! They remember people, places, and even other elephants for DECADES! 🧠
The trunk has 40,000+ MUSCLES! That's more muscles than a human has bones! 💪 And it's SO sensitive that it can pick up a SINGLE PEANUT! 🌰
Elephants are SO INTELLIGENT that they recognize themselves in mirrors! They're SELF-AWARE! 🪞
Baby elephants stay with their mothers for YEARS! They learn everything from mom! 👶
Elephants communicate with SOUNDS we can't hear - called infrasound! It travels for MILES! 📢
In temples, elephants are HONORED and BLESSED! They're sacred animals! 🙏

didYouKnow.text: Indian Elephants are so IMPORTANT to Indian culture that they're in temples, festivals, and even royal ceremonies! They're not just animals - they're RESPECTED and LOVED! 🐘

tryThis.text: Visit an elephant sanctuary in Karnataka where you can see wild elephants! Watch them move, eat, communicate! If possible, feed an elephant and feel their TRUNK - it's AMAZING! 🐘

en.narration:
Indian Elephants are the KINGS of the forest! 🐘

They're the LARGEST land animals in ENTIRE ASIA! 💪 Weigh 5000 kg - that's like 80 ADULT HUMANS!

At 3 meters tall at the shoulder, they're TALLER than a basketball hoop! 🏀

But here's the MOST AMAZING part: The TRUNK! 🌿 It has 40,000+ MUSCLES! That's MORE muscles than a human has BONES! And it's SO SENSITIVE that an elephant can pick up a SINGLE PEANUT! 🌰

Elephants have INCREDIBLE MEMORY! They NEVER FORGET! 🧠 They remember people, places, and other elephants for DECADES! If an elephant saw you 20 YEARS AGO, it might REMEMBER YOU!

Elephants are SO INTELLIGENT that they:
- Recognize themselves in mirrors! 🪞
- Use tools! 🔧
- Feel EMOTIONS! 💚
- Mourn their dead! 😢

They live in FAMILY GROUPS called HERDS! Baby elephants (called calves) stay with their mothers for YEARS and learn EVERYTHING! 👶

Here's something INCREDIBLE: Elephants can communicate with SOUNDS we CAN'T HEAR! Called INFRASOUND! It travels for MILES! 📢 So two elephants far apart can still "TALK" to each other!

Elephants eat 200 kg of FOOD PER DAY! 🍌 Bananas, leaves, bark, fruits - they're always EATING!

In India, elephants are HONORED! They're in TEMPLES, FESTIVALS, and ROYAL CEREMONIES! 🙏 They're not just animals - they're RESPECTED and SACRED!

When you visit Karnataka, seeing a wild elephant is a PRIVILEGE! Watch their GRACE, their INTELLIGENCE, their LOVE for their family! 🐘

kn.title: 🐘 ಏಷ್ಯನ್ ಆನೆ - ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಸೌಮ್ಯ ದೈತ್ಯ!
kn.mainText: ಏಷ್ಯನ್ ಆನೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಪ್ರಾಣಿ. ಈ ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಗಳು ಕುಟುಂಬ ಗುಂಪುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತವೆ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಅನೇಕ ಅರಣ್ಯ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡುಬರುತ್ತವೆ. 🐘

didYouKnow.text: ನಿಮಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತೇ? ಆನೆಯ ಸೊಂಡಿಲು ಮೂಗು, ಕೈ ಮತ್ತು ನೀರು ಕುಡಿಯುವ ಕೊಳವೆ — ಈ ಮೂರರಂತೆಯೇ ಹಲವು ಕೆಲಸಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ! 🐘

tryThis.text: ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ ವನ್ಯಜೀವಿ ಉದ್ಯಾನ ಅಥವಾ ಅಭಯಾರಣ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಆನೆಗಳನ್ನು ದೂರದಿಂದ ಗಮನಿಸಿ. ಅವು ಸೊಂಡಿಲು ಮತ್ತು ಕಿವಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಬಳಸುತ್ತವೆ ನೋಡಿ! 👀

kn.narration:
ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಯನ್ನು ಭೇಟಿಯಾಗೋಣ — ಏಷ್ಯನ್ ಆನೆ! 🐘

ಆನೆಗಳು ದೊಡ್ಡದಾಗಿದ್ದರೂ ಬಹಳ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಗಳು. ಕುಟುಂಬ ಗುಂಪುಗಳು ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಸಂಚರಿಸಿ, ಆಹಾರ ಹುಡುಕಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮರಿಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ. 👨‍👩‍👧

ಸೊಂಡಿಲು ಒಂದು ಅದ್ಭುತ ಸಾಧನ. ಆನೆ ಅದನ್ನು ವಾಸನೆ ಗ್ರಹಿಸಲು, ಉಸಿರಾಡಲು, ಆಹಾರ ಎತ್ತಲು, ನೀರು ಕುಡಿಯಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸಂವಹನ ಮಾಡಲು ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ. 🌿

ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಏಷ್ಯನ್ ಆನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಮುಖವಾದ ಅರಣ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಂರಕ್ಷಿತ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳಿವೆ. ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಆನೆಯನ್ನು ನೋಡುವುದು ವಿಶೇಷ ಅನುಭವ, ಆದರೆ ವನ್ಯಜೀವಿಗಳನ್ನು ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ ದೂರದಿಂದಲೇ ಗಮನಿಸಬೇಕು. 🌳

keyFacts.text: ಏಷ್ಯನ್ ಆನೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಪ್ರಾಣಿ! 🐘
ಆನೆಗಳು ಏಷ್ಯಾದ ಅತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಭೂಪ್ರಾಣಿಗಳು! 🌏
ಅವು ಕುಟುಂಬ ಗುಂಪುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತವೆ; ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಆನೆಗಳು ಗುಂಪನ್ನು ಮುನ್ನಡೆಸುತ್ತವೆ! 👨‍👩‍👧
ಸೊಂಡಿಲನ್ನು ಉಸಿರಾಟ, ವಾಸನೆ ಗ್ರಹಿಸುವುದು, ಆಹಾರ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿಯಲು ಬಳಸುತ್ತವೆ! 👃
ಆನೆಗಳು ವಿವಿಧ ಧ್ವನಿಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ, ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯ ಧ್ವನಿಗಳನ್ನೂ ಒಳಗೊಂಡಂತೆ, ಸಂವಹನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ! 📢
ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಆನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ವಾಸಸ್ಥಾನಗಳಾಗಿರುವ ಅರಣ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಂರಕ್ಷಿತ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳಿವೆ! 🌳
Diet: Eats 200 kg of food per day! 🍌
Lives in: Western Ghats, South India forests 🌲
Baby: Called a CALF - born 2 kg! 👶
Social: Lives in herds, VERY family-oriented! 👥

coolFacts.text: ಆನೆಯ ಸೊಂಡಿಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಸ್ನಾಯುಗಳಿದ್ದು ಅದು ಬಹಳ ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ! 💪
ಆನೆಗಳು ತಮ್ಮ ಸೊಂಡಿಲಿನಿಂದ ತುಂಬಾ ಸಣ್ಣ ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನೂ ಎತ್ತಬಲ್ಲವು! 🌰
ಮರಿ ಆನೆಗಳು ಹಿರಿಯ ಆನೆಗಳ ಜೊತೆಗಿದ್ದು ಅನೇಕ ವರ್ತನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯುತ್ತವೆ! 👶
ಆನೆಗಳು ಆಹಾರ ಮತ್ತು ನೀರನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕುತ್ತಾ ಬಹಳ ದೂರ ಸಂಚರಿಸಬಹುದು! 🚶
ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಅರಣ್ಯಗಳು ಏಷ್ಯನ್ ಆನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ವಾಸಸ್ಥಾನಗಳಾಗಿವೆ! 🌲
In temples, elephants are HONORED and BLESSED! They're sacred animals! 🙏

en.title: ☕ COFFEE PLANTATIONS - The COFFEE FOREST!
en.mainText: Karnataka is a major coffee-producing state in India, with coffee plantations concentrated in its hill districts. ☕🌿

keyFacts.text: Karnataka is one of India’s major coffee-producing states! ☕ ☕
Plantations in Western Ghats & Nilgiris! 🏔️
Area: 250,000+ acres! (Size of a big city!) 📈
Two types: Arabica & Robusta beans! 🌿
Height: Coffee grows on hills at 3000+ feet elevation! 🏔️
Climate: Cool, misty, perfect for coffee! 🌫️
Shade-grown: Trees protect coffee plants! 🌳
Harvest: Hand-picked between October-December! 🍂
Processing: Beans dried, roasted, packaged! 🔥
World quality: Karnataka coffee is WORLD-FAMOUS! 🌍

coolFacts.text: Coffee was brought to Karnataka by an Arab saint in the 1600s! Now it's EVERYWHERE! ☕
Walking through a coffee plantation smells like HEAVEN! The aroma is SO STRONG! 👃
Coffee plants grow on HILLSIDES under SHADE TREES - it's like a green FOREST! 🌳
A single coffee plant produces only about 200 grams of roasted coffee per YEAR! That's why coffee is PRECIOUS! 💎
Karnataka coffee is exported to over 80 COUNTRIES! The WHOLE WORLD drinks it! 🌍
Coffee plantations are homes to RARE BIRDS, ANIMALS, and INSECTS! They're ecosystems! 🦜

didYouKnow.text: Karnataka's coffee is so GOOD that it's one of the MOST EXPORTED agricultural products from India! It's known for its RICH FLAVOR and SMOOTH TASTE! ☕

tryThis.text: Visit a coffee plantation during harvest season (October-December)! See workers hand-picking coffee beans, walk through the green rows, and drink FRESH coffee brewed from beans picked THAT DAY! 🌿☕

en.narration:
Karnataka is the COFFEE KINGDOM of India! ☕

70% of ALL Indian coffee comes from here! That's HUGE! 🌍

Imagine MILLIONS of coffee plants growing on BEAUTIFUL GREEN HILLSIDES! 🏔️ That's what Karnataka looks like!

Coffee was brought to Karnataka by an Arab saint in the 1600s! And since then, it's been GROWING and GROWING! ☕

The coffee grows in the WESTERN GHATS and NILGIRIS mountains - cool, misty places at 3000+ feet elevation! 🌫️ The cool weather is PERFECT for coffee!

Walking through a coffee plantation is MAGICAL! 🌳 The smell of coffee is SO STRONG that you can TASTE it in the AIR! 👃

Coffee plants grow UNDER SHADE TREES! It's like a GREEN FOREST with coffee hiding underneath! This is called SHADE-GROWN COFFEE and it's the BEST! 🌿

During HARVEST (October-December), workers hand-pick every coffee bean! 🍂 It takes SO MUCH WORK! But the beans are PERFECT!

Here's something AMAZING: A single coffee plant produces only about 200 grams of ROASTED coffee per YEAR! That's why coffee is PRECIOUS! 💎

After harvest:
1. Beans are DRIED in the sun ☀️
2. Beans are ROASTED to bring out flavor 🔥
3. Beans are PACKAGED and shipped to the world! 📦

Karnataka's coffee is exported to over 80 COUNTRIES! The whole WORLD drinks it! 🌍

Coffee plantations are also HOME to rare birds, animals, and insects! They're ECOSYSTEMS! 🦜

When you visit a coffee plantation:
- See green HILLS covered in coffee plants 🏔️
- Smell the AMAZING aroma 👃
- Watch workers hand-pick beans 🍂
- Drink FRESH coffee! ☕
- Feel like you're in a GREEN DREAM! 🌳

kn.title: ☕ ಕಾಫಿ ನಾಡು - ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಹಸಿರು ಬೆಟ್ಟಗಳು!
kn.mainText: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕವು ಭಾರತದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕಾಫಿ ಉತ್ಪಾದಕ ರಾಜ್ಯವಾಗಿದ್ದು, ದೇಶದಲ್ಲೇ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕಾಫಿ ಉತ್ಪಾದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಕೊಡಗು, ಚಿಕ್ಕಮಗಳೂರು ಮತ್ತು ಹಾಸನ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕಾಫಿ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳಾಗಿವೆ! 🌿

didYouKnow.text: ನಿಮಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತೇ? ಕಾಫಿ ಬೋರ್ಡ್‌ನ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಇತ್ತೀಚಿನ ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತದ ಕಾಫಿ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಪಾಲು ಸುಮಾರು 70% ಅಥವಾ ಅದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇದೆ! ☕📊

tryThis.text: ಕಾಫಿ ತೋಟಕ್ಕೆ ಭೇಟಿ ನೀಡಿದಾಗ ಕಾಫಿ ಹಣ್ಣುಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಅವುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ನೆರಳು ನೀಡುವ ಮರಗಳನ್ನು ಹತ್ತಿರದಿಂದ ಗಮನಿಸಿ! 🔎🌿

kn.narration:
ಕರ್ನಾಟಕವು ಭಾರತದ ಕಾಫಿಯ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕೇಂದ್ರ! ☕🌿

ಕೊಡಗು, ಚಿಕ್ಕಮಗಳೂರು ಮತ್ತು ಹಾಸನ ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಹಸಿರು ಬೆಟ್ಟ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಫಿ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

ಕಾಫಿ ಬೋರ್ಡ್‌ನ ಉತ್ಪಾದನಾ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಇತ್ತೀಚಿನ ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತದ ಕಾಫಿ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಪಾಲು ಸುಮಾರು 70% ಅಥವಾ ಅದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು. 📊

ಕಾಫಿ ಗಿಡಗಳು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ನೆರಳು ನೀಡುವ ಮರಗಳ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಹಣ್ಣುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಾಫಿ ಚೆರಿ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಅದರೊಳಗಿನ ಬೀಜಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಸ್ಕರಿಸಿ ಹುರಿದ ನಂತರ ನಾವು ಕಾಫಿಯಾಗಿ ಕುಡಿಯುತ್ತೇವೆ. 🍒

ಅಂದರೆ ನೀವು ಒಂದು ಕಪ್ ಕಾಫಿ ಕುಡಿಯುವಾಗ, ಅದು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಹಸಿರು ಬೆಟ್ಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆದ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಹಣ್ಣಿನಿಂದ ಆರಂಭವಾಗಿರಬಹುದು!

keyFacts.text: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕವು ಭಾರತದ ಅತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕಾಫಿ ಉತ್ಪಾದಕ ರಾಜ್ಯ! ☕
ಕೊಡಗು, ಚಿಕ್ಕಮಗಳೂರು ಮತ್ತು ಹಾಸನ ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಹಲವು ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಫಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ! 🏔️
ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಅರಬಿಕಾ ಮತ್ತು ರೋಬಸ್ಟಾ ಎರಡೂ ವಿಧದ ಕಾಫಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತವೆ! 🌱
ಅನೇಕ ಕಾಫಿ ತೋಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಫಿ ಗಿಡಗಳು ನೆರಳು ನೀಡುವ ಮರಗಳ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತವೆ! 🌳
ಕಾಫಿ ಹಣ್ಣುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಟಾವು ಮಾಡಿ, ಸಂಸ್ಕರಿಸಿ, ಒಣಗಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹುರಿದ ನಂತರ ಕಾಫಿ ಬೀಜಗಳು ಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ! 🔥
ಇತ್ತೀಚಿನ ಹಲವು ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತದ ಒಟ್ಟು ಕಾಫಿ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಪಾಲು ಸುಮಾರು 70% ಅಥವಾ ಅದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇದೆ! 📈
Shade-grown: Trees protect coffee plants! 🌳
Harvest: Hand-picked between October-December! 🍂
Processing: Beans dried, roasted, packaged! 🔥
World quality: Karnataka coffee is WORLD-FAMOUS! 🌍

coolFacts.text: ನೆರಳು ಮರಗಳ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಕಾಫಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುವುದರಿಂದ ತೋಟಗಳು ಹಸಿರು ಕಾಡಿನಂತೆಯೇ ಕಾಣಬಹುದು! 🌳
ಕಾಫಿ ಬೋರ್ಡ್‌ನ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಭಾರತದ ಕಾಫಿ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಪಾಲು ಬಹಳ ದೊಡ್ಡದು! 📊
ಕೊಡಗು, ಚಿಕ್ಕಮಗಳೂರು ಮತ್ತು ಹಾಸನ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕಾಫಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳಾಗಿವೆ! ☕
ಕಾಫಿ 'ಬೀಜ' ಎಂದರೆ ವಾಸ್ತವವಾಗಿ ಕಾಫಿ ಹಣ್ಣಿನೊಳಗಿನ ಬೀಜ; ಆ ಹಣ್ಣನ್ನು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಕಾಫಿ ಚೆರಿ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ! 🍒
ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಕಾಫಿ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳು ಕೃಷಿ, ಹಸಿರು ಪ್ರಕೃತಿ ಮತ್ತು ವನ್ಯಜೀವಿಗಳ ವಾಸಸ್ಥಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಒಂದೇ ಭೂದೃಶ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಂದಿವೆ! 🐦
Coffee plantations are homes to RARE BIRDS, ANIMALS, and INSECTS! They're ecosystems! 🦜

en.title: 🏛️ VIDHANA SOUDHA - The Government Palace!
en.mainText: One of INDIA'S famous government buildings! A STUNNING dome structure built in Dravidian-British architectural style!

keyFacts.text: Completed in 1956 - the year India became a Republic! 🇮🇳
Built in neoclassical Dravidian architecture - SO UNIQUE! 🏛️
Houses the LEGISLATURE and SECRETARIAT of Karnataka! 📜
The dome is COPPER-COVERED - turns GREEN with age (oxidation)! 🟢
Built by thousands of workers over many years! 👷
The main structure has 4 wings representing different aspects of governance! 📐
Beautifully illuminated at night - looks like a GLOWING PALACE! ✨
One of the LARGEST government buildings in India! 📏

coolFacts.text: The ENTIRE BUILDING is constructed with beautiful GRANITE and SANDSTONE! 🪨
The dome took SPECIAL ENGINEERING to construct - a MARVEL of that time! 🏗️
It's a MAJOR LANDMARK visible from many parts of Bangalore! 📍
Thousands of people visit for photography every year! 📸
The building was designed to be FUNCTIONAL and BEAUTIFUL at the same time! 🎨
It symbolizes India's NEW DEMOCRATIC GOVERNMENT after independence! 🇮🇳

didYouKnow.text: Vidhana Soudha means 'Government House' in Kannada! It's not just a building - it's a SYMBOL of democratic governance in India! 🏛️

tryThis.text: Visit Vidhana Soudha at NIGHT when it's illuminated! The lights make it look like a MAGICAL PALACE from a fairy tale! ✨

en.narration:
Vidhana Soudha is the seat of the Karnataka state legislature and government in Bengaluru. 🏛️

Its large Neo-Dravidian design combines traditional Indian architectural elements with modern civic architecture.

kn.title: 🏛️ ವಿಧಾನ ಸೌಧ - ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಆಡಳಿತದ ಕೇಂದ್ರ!
kn.mainText: ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನ ವಿಧಾನ ಸೌಧವು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ವಿಧಾನಮಂಡಲದ ಆಸನ ಮತ್ತು ನವ-ದ್ರಾವಿಡ ವಾಸ್ತುಶೈಲಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕಟ್ಟಡವಾಗಿದೆ. 🇮🇳

didYouKnow.text: ನಿಮಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತೇ? ವಿಧಾನ ಸೌಧವನ್ನು 1956ರಲ್ಲಿ ಉದ್ಘಾಟಿಸಲಾಯಿತು; ಅದೇ ವರ್ಷ ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ಪುನರ್‌ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಭಾರತದ ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ಗಡಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳು ನಡೆದವು! 🇮🇳

tryThis.text: ವಿಧಾನ ಸೌಧದ ಚಿತ್ರವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಗುಂಬಜಗಳು, ಕಂಬಗಳು, ಕಮಾನುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಗ್ರಾನೈಟ್ ಮುಂಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ! 🔎

kn.narration:
ವಿಧಾನ ಸೌಧವು ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಕಟ್ಟಡಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು! 🏛️

ಇದು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ವಿಧಾನಮಂಡಲದ ಆಸನವಾಗಿದ್ದು, ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಆಡಳಿತದೊಂದಿಗೆ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದೆ. 📜

ಈ ಕಟ್ಟಡವನ್ನು 1956ರಲ್ಲಿ ಉದ್ಘಾಟಿಸಲಾಯಿತು. ಇದರ ಭವ್ಯ ನವ-ದ್ರಾವಿಡ ವಾಸ್ತುಶೈಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ಗ್ರಾನೈಟ್ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣ ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ರೂಪ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. 🪨

ರಾತ್ರಿ ಬೆಳಗಿಸಿದಾಗ ಕಟ್ಟಡವು ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಆಕಾಶದ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ. ✨

ವಾಸ್ತುಶಿಲ್ಪವು ಒಂದು ಸ್ಥಳದ ಇತಿಹಾಸ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಜಾಪ್ರಭುತ್ವದ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಹೇಳಬಹುದು ಎಂಬುದಕ್ಕೆ ಇದು ಉತ್ತಮ ಉದಾಹರಣೆ!

keyFacts.text: ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇದೆ! 📍
ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ವಿಧಾನಮಂಡಲ ಮತ್ತು ಸಚಿವಾಲಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಆಡಳಿತ ಕಟ್ಟಡ! 📜
1956ರಲ್ಲಿ ಉದ್ಘಾಟಿಸಲಾಯಿತು! 📅
ಇದರ ವಾಸ್ತುಶೈಲಿಯನ್ನು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ನವ-ದ್ರಾವಿಡ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ! 🏛️
ಕಟ್ಟಡದ ಬಹುಭಾಗ ಗ್ರಾನೈಟ್‌ನಿಂದ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ! 🪨
ರಾತ್ರಿ ಬೆಳಗಿಸಿದಾಗ ಇದರ ಮುಂಭಾಗ ಬಹಳ ಆಕರ್ಷಕವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ! ✨
Beautifully illuminated at night - looks like a GLOWING PALACE! ✨
One of the LARGEST government buildings in India! 📏

coolFacts.text: ವಿಧಾನ ಸೌಧವು ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ನಾಗರಿಕ ಕಟ್ಟಡಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು! 🏛️
ಇದರ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಭಾರತೀಯ ವಾಸ್ತುಶೈಲಿಯ ಪ್ರಭಾವ ಮತ್ತು ಭವ್ಯ ಪ್ರಮಾಣವಿದೆ! 🧩
ಈ ಕಟ್ಟಡ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಪ್ರಜಾಪ್ರಭುತ್ವದ ಆಡಳಿತ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ನಿಕಟವಾಗಿ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದೆ! 🇮🇳
ಇದರ ಭವ್ಯ ಮೆಟ್ಟಿಲುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕಂಬಗಳು ವಾಸ್ತುಶಿಲ್ಪದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳಾಗಿವೆ! 📸
'ವಿಧಾನ ಸೌಧ' ಎಂಬುದು ರಾಜ್ಯದ ವಿಧಾನಮಂಡಲದ ಕಟ್ಟಡವನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ! 📜
It symbolizes India's NEW DEMOCRATIC GOVERNMENT after independence! 🇮🇳

en.title: 🌊 CHENNAI - The GATEWAY to South India!
en.mainText: Chennai is the capital of Tamil Nadu, a major city on the Bay of Bengal known for classical arts, culture, beaches and Tamil cinema. 🏖️

keyFacts.text: Population: 1 CRORE (10 million)! 🏙️
Called MADRAS before 1996! 🎭
Marina Beach: 13 km LONG! One of the LONGEST beaches! 🏖️
Fort St. George: Historic British fort! 🏛️
San Thome Basilica: 2000-year-old church! ⛪
Kapaleeshwarar Temple: Ancient 400-year-old temple! 🙏
Silk sarees: FAMOUS handmade silk! 🧵
Classical arts: Bharatanatyam dance born here! 💃
Tamil cinema: Kollywood - one of India's major film industries! 🎬
Street food: Dosa, Idli, Sambar! 🍲

coolFacts.text: Chennai is one of the OLDEST cities in India - thousands of years old! 👑
Marina Beach is SO LONG (13 km) that you can walk for HOURS! 🏖️
Fort St. George was built by British in 1644 - 380 years ago! And you can STILL visit it! 🏛️
San Thome Basilica is built over the tomb of Saint Thomas (Doubting Thomas) from JESUS'S DISCIPLES! 2000 years old! ⛪
Tamil cinema produces MORE movies per YEAR than Hollywood! 🎬
Kapaleeshwarar Temple is SO BEAUTIFUL with intricate carvings that it looks like CARVED LACE! 🏛️

didYouKnow.text: Chennai was called 'MADRAS' until 1996 when it was renamed to CHENNAI! The name means 'the gift of Chenna' - a local landlord! 🎁

tryThis.text: Walk along Marina Beach at sunset! Watch the waves crash, feel the sea breeze, and eat FRESH street food! Or visit Kapaleeshwarar Temple and see the intricate carvings! 🏖️

en.narration:
Chennai is the GATEWAY to South India! 🌊

1 CRORE people live here on the coast of the Bay of Bengal! It's a city where ANCIENT TEMPLES meet MODERN BUILDINGS! 🏛️

Marina Beach is INCREDIBLE! 13 km LONG! You can walk for HOURS! 🏖️ The waves crash, the sand is soft, and at sunset the sky turns ORANGE and PINK! 🌅

Fort St. George is a HISTORIC fort built by the British 380 YEARS ago! You can walk inside and feel the HISTORY! 🏛️

But here's the MOST AMAZING part: San Thome Basilica! It's built over the TOMB of Saint Thomas - one of JESUS'S DISCIPLES! That's 2000 YEARS OLD! ⛪

Kapaleeshwarar Temple is SO BEAUTIFUL! 400 years old with INTRICATE CARVINGS! It looks like CARVED LACE! 🙏

Chennai is the HOME OF:
- Bharatanatyam dance 💃
- Silk sarees 🧵
- Classical music 🎵
- Tamil cinema (Kollywood!) 🎬

Tamil cinema makes one of India's major film industries! Over 200 per year! 🎬

When you visit Chennai:
- Walk Marina Beach 🏖️
- Visit Fort St. George 🏛️
- Pray at Kapaleeshwarar Temple 🙏
- Eat AMAZING dosa and idli 🍲
- Feel the HISTORY! 👑

ta.title: 🌊 சென்னை - தென்னிந்தியாவின் நுழைவாயில்!
ta.mainText: சென்னை தமிழ்நாட்டின் தலைநகரமும் வங்காள விரிகுடா கரையில் அமைந்துள்ள முக்கிய நகரமும் ஆகும். கடற்கரை, கோயில்கள், கலை மற்றும் கலாச்சாரத்திற்கும் இது புகழ்பெற்றது! 🏖️
ta.narration:
சென்னை தமிழ்நாட்டின் தலைநகரம்! 🌊

வங்காள விரிகுடா கரையில் அமைந்துள்ள இந்த நகரம் கடற்கரை, கோயில்கள், இசை, நடனம் மற்றும் திரைப்படங்களுக்குப் புகழ்பெற்றது. 🏖️🎵🎬

மெரினா கடற்கரை சென்னையின் மிகப் பிரபலமான இடங்களில் ஒன்று. ஃபோர்ட் செயின்ட் ஜார்ஜ் நகரின் காலனித்துவ வரலாற்றை நினைவூட்டுகிறது. 🏛️

மயிலாப்பூரில் உள்ள கபாலீஸ்வரர் கோயில் சென்னையின் முக்கிய பாரம்பரியச் சின்னங்களில் ஒன்று.

சென்னையில் பழைய பாரம்பரியமும் நவீன நகர வாழ்க்கையும் ஒன்றாகக் காணலாம்!

didYouKnow.text: உங்களுக்குத் தெரியுமா? சென்னை 1996ஆம் ஆண்டு அதிகாரப்பூர்வமாக 'மதராஸ்' என்பதிலிருந்து 'சென்னை' எனப் பெயர் மாற்றப்பட்டது! 🔄

tryThis.text: மெரினா கடற்கரையில் கடல் காற்றை ரசிக்கவும் அல்லது கபாலீஸ்வரர் கோயிலின் கட்டிடக் கலை விவரங்களை கவனிக்கவும்! 🔎

keyFacts.text: தமிழ்நாட்டின் தலைநகரம்! 🏛️
வங்காள விரிகுடா கடற்கரையில் அமைந்துள்ளது! 🌊
மெரினா கடற்கரை சென்னையின் புகழ்பெற்ற அடையாளங்களில் ஒன்று! 🏖️
ஃபோர்ட் செயின்ட் ஜார்ஜ் நகரின் முக்கிய வரலாற்றுச் சின்னம்! 🏛️
கபாலீஸ்வரர் கோயில் மயிலாப்பூரில் உள்ள புகழ்பெற்ற கோயில்! 🛕
தமிழ் திரைப்படத் துறையின் முக்கிய மையமாக சென்னை விளங்குகிறது! 🎬
சென்னையில் பல பல்கலைக்கழகங்கள் மற்றும் கல்வி நிறுவனங்கள் உள்ளன! 🎓
சென்னை தென்னிந்தியாவின் முக்கிய பொருளாதார மற்றும் தொழில்துறை மையங்களில் ஒன்று! 🏙️
சென்னையின் கடற்கரை நகர வாழ்க்கையில் முக்கியமான பகுதியாக உள்ளது! 🌊
சென்னையில் தமிழ், ஆங்கிலம் உள்ளிட்ட பல மொழிகள் பயன்படுத்தப்படுகின்றன! 🗣️

coolFacts.text: மெரினா கடற்கரை நகரின் நீண்ட மணற்கரைகளில் ஒன்றாகும்! 🏖️
ஃபோர்ட் செயின்ட் ஜார்ஜ் 1644ஆம் ஆண்டு ஆங்கிலேயர்களால் கட்டப்பட்டது! 🏛️
சென்னையில் இசை, நடனம் மற்றும் நாடகத்திற்கான பல முக்கிய நிறுவனங்கள் உள்ளன! 🎵
மயிலாப்பூர் பகுதியில் பழமையான கோயில்கள் மற்றும் பாரம்பரிய இடங்கள் உள்ளன! 🛕
பழைய மரபும் நவீன நகர வாழ்க்கையும் சென்னையில் ஒன்றாகக் காணப்படுகின்றன! 🏙️
சென்னையின் வரலாற்றுப் பகுதிகளில் பழைய கட்டிடக்கலை இன்னும் காணப்படுகிறது! 🏛️

en.title: 🗣️ TAMIL - India's Ancient Language!
en.mainText: Tamil is a major classical language of India with a long literary tradition. It is spoken widely in Tamil Nadu and by Tamil communities elsewhere. 🌍

keyFacts.text: Tamil has a long recorded literary tradition, including ancient Sangam literature. 📜 📜
Spoken by 80 MILLION people worldwide! 🌍
One of the 22 official languages of India 🇮🇳
The exact origin of the word 'Tamil' is still debated by language experts today! 🔍
Ancient Tamil has beautiful poetry and literature! 📚
Tamil alphabet has 12 vowels and 18 consonants 🔤
Tamil cinema (Kollywood) makes 200+ movies a year! 🎬
VANAKKAM = Hello/Goodbye 🙏
NANDRI = Thank you 💚
Some Tamil words have been used for 2,000 YEARS without change! ⏰

coolFacts.text: Tamil is the ONLY language with over 2,000 years of continuous literature! 📖
Tamil literature includes love poems, war stories, and ancient wisdom! 💝
Sangam literature (2,000 years old) is the OLDEST Tamil texts! 🏛️
Tamil has influenced many Asian languages! 🌏
Tamil's alphabet is so organized - each letter represents a sound perfectly! 🎯
You can find Tamil in place names everywhere in South India! 🗺️
Tamil cinema is called 'Kollywood' - the K comes from Kodambakkam! 🎥
Tamil words for numbers are SUPER logical - it's like math! 🔢

didYouKnow.text: Tamil is the only language with continuous literary tradition spanning 2,000 YEARS! Other languages changed or disappeared, but Tamil kept going strong! Some ancient Tamil poems are still sung today! 📜

tryThis.text: Learn these cool Tamil words: VANAKKAM (hello), NANDRI (thank you), SAPPADU (food), VELLAI (moon), MANI (jewel). Say them to your friends - you'll sound like a Tamil movie star! 🎬

en.narration:
Tamil is SUPER ancient! Imagine - when the Great Wall of China was being built, Tamil was already written and spoken! 2,000 YEARS! 📜

Tamil is still the same today - you can read Tamil poetry written 2,000 years ago and understand it!

Almost 80 MILLION people speak Tamil - that's like... a whole country! 🌍

Tamil music and movies are FAMOUS all over the world! If you watch Tamil movies (Kollywood), you'll hear beautiful songs and exciting stories! 🎬

The cool part? Every Tamil letter is super organized - each one is like a perfect puzzle piece! 🧩

VANAKKAM (hello), NANDRI (thank you), SAPPADU (food)... try saying them! They sound so cool! 💬

ta.title: 🗣️ தமிழ் - தமிழ்நாட்டின் மொழி!
ta.mainText: தமிழ் தமிழ்நாட்டின் முக்கிய மொழியும் இந்தியாவின் 22 அட்டவணை மொழிகளில் ஒன்றும் ஆகும். இது நீண்ட இலக்கியப் பாரம்பரியத்தையும் தனித்துவமான எழுத்துமுறையையும் கொண்டுள்ளது! 📚
ta.narration:
தமிழ் ஒரு பழமையான மற்றும் வளமான மொழி! 🗣️

தமிழ் தமிழ்நாட்டின் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ மொழி. இது இந்தியாவின் 22 அட்டவணை மொழிகளில் ஒன்றாகும். 🇮🇳

தமிழுக்கு நீண்ட இலக்கியப் பாரம்பரியம் உள்ளது. சங்க இலக்கியம், திருக்குறள் போன்ற படைப்புகள் தமிழ் மொழியின் செழுமையை காட்டுகின்றன. 📚

2004ஆம் ஆண்டு தமிழுக்கு இந்தியாவின் செம்மொழி அந்தஸ்து வழங்கப்பட்டது.

இன்றும் தமிழ் வீடுகள், பள்ளிகள், திரைப்படங்கள், இசை மற்றும் தொழில்நுட்பத்தில் உயிரோட்டமாகப் பயன்படுத்தப்படுகிறது!

didYouKnow.text: உங்களுக்குத் தெரியுமா? இந்திய அரசு 2004ஆம் ஆண்டு தமிழுக்கு செம்மொழி அந்தஸ்தை வழங்கியது! 🏛️

tryThis.text: 'வணக்கம்' = Hello, 'நன்றி' = Thank you என்று இரண்டு தமிழ் சொற்களை கற்றுக்கொள்ளுங்கள்! 🗣️

keyFacts.text: தமிழ் தமிழ்நாட்டின் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ மொழி! 🏛️
தமிழ் இந்திய அரசியலமைப்பின் எட்டாவது அட்டவணையில் உள்ள 22 மொழிகளில் ஒன்று! 🇮🇳
தமிழுக்கு நீண்ட இலக்கியப் பாரம்பரியம் உள்ளது! 📚
தமிழுக்கு தனித்துவமான எழுத்துமுறை உள்ளது! ✍️
சங்க இலக்கியம் தமிழ் மொழியின் பழமையான இலக்கிய மரபுகளில் ஒன்று! 📜
தமிழ் 2004ஆம் ஆண்டு இந்தியாவின் செம்மொழியாக அங்கீகரிக்கப்பட்டது! 👑
தமிழ் இலக்கியத்தில் சங்கப் பாடல்கள் முக்கியமான பழமையான படைப்புகளாகும்! 📜
தமிழ் எழுத்துமுறையில் உயிரெழுத்துகள் மற்றும் மெய்யெழுத்துகள் உள்ளன! 🔤
தமிழ் திரைப்படங்கள் உலகின் பல பகுதிகளில் பார்வையாளர்களை அடைகின்றன! 🎬
தமிழ் மொழி தமிழ்நாட்டின் கலாச்சார அடையாளத்தின் முக்கிய பகுதியாகும்! ❤️

coolFacts.text: தமிழ் இலக்கியத்தில் கவிதை, அறம், காதல், போர் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கை பற்றிய பல படைப்புகள் உள்ளன! 📖
சங்க இலக்கியம் பழந்தமிழ் சமூகத்தைப் பற்றி அறிய உதவுகிறது! 🏺
திருக்குறள் தமிழ் மொழியின் புகழ்பெற்ற நெறி நூல்களில் ஒன்று! 📚
தமிழ் இன்று வீடு, பள்ளி, திரைப்படம், இசை மற்றும் தொழில்நுட்பம் என பல துறைகளில் பயன்படுத்தப்படுகிறது! 🎵
தமிழ் உலகின் பல நாடுகளில் பேசப்படுகிறது! 🌍
தமிழில் பழமையான கல்வெட்டுகள் மற்றும் இலக்கியப் பதிவுகள் கிடைக்கின்றன! 🪨
தமிழ் இணையம் மற்றும் கணினி பயன்பாடுகளிலும் பரவலாக பயன்படுத்தப்படுகிறது! 💻
தமிழின் பல பேச்சுவழக்குகள் வெவ்வேறு பகுதிகளில் காணப்படுகின்றன! 🗣️

en.title: 🥘 DOSA - The CRISPY, GOLDEN WONDER!
en.mainText: A thin, crispy, golden pancake made from rice and lentils! You dip it in coconut chutney and spicy sambar - ABSOLUTELY AMAZING! 😋

keyFacts.text: Made from rice and lentils fermented overnight! 🍚
Crispy outside, soft inside - PERFECT! ✨
Served with sambar (spicy lentil soup) and coconut chutney 🥥
A dosa takes 2-3 minutes to cook on a hot griddle 🔥
Street food in South India - eaten for breakfast! 🌅
Dosa comes in varieties: Plain, masala (spicy), butter, cheese! 🧀
One dosa = 150-200 calories - good fuel! ⚡
Dosa has been eaten for 1,500+ years! 📜
No dosa is the same - each cook makes it unique! 👨‍🍳
The BEST dosa is hot off the griddle with hot chutney! 🔥

coolFacts.text: A 'Masala Dosa' means the potato filling is spiced - SO GOOD! 🌶️
Some restaurants make GIANT dosas - 2 meters long! Incredible! 📏
The crispy edges are called 'lacy' - like edible lace! 🎀
Sambar (the sauce) has 10+ spices in it - it's a flavor explosion! 💥
Coconut chutney is made fresh every morning - SO fresh! 🥥
Dosa batter needs to ferment - that's the secret to crispiness! ⏰
In South India, dosas are eaten almost every day! 🍽️
You can eat a dosa with your hands - it's like edible cutlery! 🥄

didYouKnow.text: The word 'DOSA' might come from an old Tamil word! It's been part of Tamil culture for THOUSANDS of years! Street vendors have been making dosas the same way for 500+ years! 🌟

tryThis.text: Visit a local South Indian restaurant and try a masala dosa! Dip it in sambar and chutney - the hot, spicy, crispy flavors will blow your mind! 🎉

en.narration:
Dosa is MAGIC! When you bite into a hot dosa, it's crispy on the outside and soft inside - it's like eating a GOLDEN CLOUD! ☁️

Makers pour thin batter on a VERY hot griddle - SSSSSSSSS! It cooks in seconds! 🔥

Then you add the filling - soft potatoes mixed with onions and spices!

The sambar is spicy lentil soup with 10+ spices - your taste buds will DANCE! 💃

And coconut chutney? It's made fresh every morning with FRESH coconut! So creamy and yummy! 🥥

You eat it HOT - straight off the griddle - that's when it's BEST! The crispy edges are like golden lace! ✨

Did you know? People have been making dosas the SAME WAY for over 2,000 years! It's ancient food that's still SUPER popular today! 👨‍🍳

ta.title: 🥘 தோசை - மொறுமொறுப்பான தென்னிந்திய உணவு!
ta.mainText: தோசை என்பது அரிசி மற்றும் பருப்பால் தயாரிக்கப்படும் புளித்த மாவை சூடான தவாவில் மெல்லியதாக ஊற்றி சுட்டு செய்யப்படும் உணவு. இது சாம்பார் மற்றும் சட்னியுடன் பரிமாறப்படுகிறது! 😋
ta.narration:
தோசை ஒரு பிரபலமான தென்னிந்திய உணவு! 🥘

அரிசி மற்றும் பருப்பை சேர்த்து மாவு தயாரித்து, அதை புளிக்க வைக்கிறார்கள். பின்னர் சூடான தவாவில் மாவை மெல்லியதாக ஊற்றி சுடுகிறார்கள். 🔥

மசாலா தோசையில் உருளைக்கிழங்கு மசாலா போன்ற நிரப்புகள் இருக்கலாம். சாம்பார் மற்றும் சட்னியுடன் சேர்த்து சாப்பிடுவது மிகவும் பிரபலமானது. 🥥

தோசையில் சமையலும் அறிவியலும் ஒன்றாகச் சந்திக்கின்றன — புளித்த மாவுதான் அதன் தனித்துவமான சுவை மற்றும் அமைப்புக்கு உதவுகிறது! 🧪

didYouKnow.text: உங்களுக்குத் தெரியுமா? தோசை மாவை புளிக்க வைப்பது அதன் சுவை மற்றும் அமைப்பை மாற்றும் ஒரு இயற்கையான நுண்ணுயிரியல் செயல்முறை! 🧪

tryThis.text: ஒரு தோசை எப்படி தவாவில் ஊற்றி பரப்பப்படுகிறது என்பதை கவனித்து பாருங்கள். அதன் வட்ட வடிவத்தை நீங்கள் கணிக்க முடியுமா? 🔎

keyFacts.text: அரிசி மற்றும் பருப்பால் தயாரிக்கப்படுகிறது! 🍚
மாவு சுடுவதற்கு முன் புளிக்க வைக்கப்படுகிறது! ⏰
சூடான தவாவில் தோசை சுடப்படுகிறது! 🔥
சாம்பார் மற்றும் தேங்காய் சட்னியுடன் பரிமாறப்படுகிறது! 🥥
தோசைக்கு சாதாரண, மசாலா போன்ற பல வகைகள் உள்ளன! 🌶️
தென்னிந்தியாவில் தோசை மிகவும் பிரபலமான உணவாகும்! 🌍
தோசை மாவில் பொதுவாக அரிசியும் உளுந்தும் பயன்படுத்தப்படுகின்றன! 🍚
மாவை புளிக்க வைப்பது தோசையின் சுவை மற்றும் அமைப்பை மாற்றுகிறது! 🧪
மெல்லிய தோசையிலிருந்து தடிமனான தோசை வரை பல வகைகள் உள்ளன! 📏
தேங்காய் சட்னி தோசையுடன் பரிமாறப்படும் பிரபலமான துணை உணவு! 🥥

coolFacts.text: புளித்த மாவு தோசைக்கு தனித்துவமான சுவையும் அமைப்பும் தருகிறது! 🧪
மசாலா தோசையில் பொதுவாக உருளைக்கிழங்கு மசாலா நிரப்பப்படுகிறது! 🥔
சில உணவகங்களில் மிகப் பெரிய தோசைகளும் தயாரிக்கப்படுகின்றன! 📏
தோசையின் மெல்லிய விளிம்பு மொறுமொறுப்பாக இருக்கும்! ✨
தோசையை கையால் சாப்பிடுவது தென்னிந்திய உணவு கலாச்சாரத்தில் பொதுவானது! 🍽️
தோசையை சுடும்போது மாவு தவாவில் மெதுவாக பரப்பப்படுகிறது! 🔥
மசாலா தோசையின் நிரப்பில் பலவிதமான மசாலாப் பொருட்கள் இருக்கலாம்! 🌶️
தோசை வீட்டு சமையலிலும் உணவகங்களிலும் பொதுவாக தயாரிக்கப்படுகிறது! 👩‍🍳

en.title: MEENAKSHI AMMAN TEMPLE

ta.mainText: மதுரையில் உள்ள மீனாட்சி அம்மன் கோயில் அதன் வண்ணமயமான கோபுரங்களுக்கும் நுணுக்கமான சிற்பங்களுக்கும் புகழ்பெற்றது.

keyFacts.text: இந்தக் கோயில் தமிழ்நாட்டின் மதுரையில் உள்ளது.

தற்போதைய கோயில் வளாகம் பல நூற்றாண்டுகளாக வளர்ந்துள்ளது.

en.title: 🐐 NILGIRI TAHR - Mountain Climber!
en.mainText: The Nilgiri tahr is the state animal of Tamil Nadu and lives in the rocky grasslands of the Western Ghats.

keyFacts.text: Bengal tigers weigh 200-260 kg (400-570 lbs)! 💪
wild tiger numbers are monitored through national wildlife surveys in wild India! 😢
Can jump 30 FEET in a single leap! 🏃
Run at 40 mph - SUPER fast! 🏃‍♂️
Each tiger's stripes are unique - like fingerprints! 🔍
Night hunters - they see in the DARK! 🌙
Can eat 100+ pounds of meat in one meal! 🍖
Live 15 years in wild, 20+ in zoos 📅
Cubs learn to hunt for 2+ years! 👶
Tigers are swimming experts - they love water! 🏊

coolFacts.text: A tiger's roar can be heard 2 MILES away! 📢
Bengal tigers can eat one zebra or buffalo in 4 meals! 🍖

Each tiger's stripe pattern is COMPLETELY unique - no two tigers are the same! 🐯
A tiger can rotate its ears 180 degrees to track sounds! 👂
Tigers are solitary hunters - they hunt alone! 🏕️
They mark their territory by scratching trees and leaving scent marks! 🌳
Tiger cubs wrestle and play to learn hunting skills! 🎮

ta.title: 🐐 நீலகிரி வரையாடு - தமிழ்நாட்டின் மாநில விலங்கு!
ta.mainText: நீலகிரி வரையாடு தமிழ்நாட்டின் மாநில விலங்கு. இது மேற்குத் தொடர்ச்சி மலைகளின் உயரமான புல்வெளி மற்றும் மலைப்பகுதிகளில் வாழும் அரிய மலைவாழ் விலங்கு! ⛰️
ta.narration:
தமிழ்நாட்டின் மாநில விலங்கு யார் தெரியுமா? நீலகிரி வரையாடு! 🐐

இது மேற்குத் தொடர்ச்சி மலைகளின் உயரமான புல்வெளி மற்றும் மலைப்பகுதிகளில் வாழ்கிறது. ⛰️

செங்குத்தான மலைச்சரிவுகளில் எளிதாக நகரும் திறன் இதன் சிறப்பு. புல் மற்றும் பிற தாவரங்களை உணவாகக் கொள்கிறது. 🌿

முக்கூர்த்தி தேசியப் பூங்கா போன்ற பாதுகாக்கப்பட்ட பகுதிகள் இந்த அரிய விலங்கின் வாழ்விடத்தைப் பாதுகாக்க உதவுகின்றன.

மலைகளையும் அவற்றின் விலங்குகளையும் பாதுகாப்பது இயற்கையை பாதுகாப்பதற்கான ஒரு முக்கிய வழி! 🌳

didYouKnow.text: உங்களுக்குத் தெரியுமா? நீலகிரி வரையாடு உலகில் இயற்கையாக தமிழ்நாடு மற்றும் கேரளாவின் சில மேற்குத் தொடர்ச்சி மலைப் பகுதிகளில் மட்டுமே காணப்படுகிறது! 🌿

tryThis.text: வனவிலங்கு பூங்கா அல்லது பாதுகாக்கப்பட்ட மலைப்பகுதியில் வரையாடுகளை பார்த்தால், அவற்றின் மலைச் சரிவு நடையை தொலைவில் இருந்து கவனியுங்கள்! 👀

keyFacts.text: நீலகிரி வரையாடு தமிழ்நாட்டின் மாநில விலங்கு! 🐐
மேற்குத் தொடர்ச்சி மலைகளில் காணப்படுகிறது! ⛰️
உயரமான மலைப் புல்வெளிகள் இதன் முக்கிய வாழ்விடங்களில் ஒன்று! 🌿
ஆண் வரையாட்டின் உடலில் வயதுடன் உருவாகும் தனித்துவமான நிறமும் வடிவமும் இருக்கும்! 🐐
இவை கூட்டமாக வாழக்கூடிய சமூக விலங்குகள்! 👥
வாழ்விடப் பாதுகாப்பு இந்த இனத்தைப் பாதுகாக்க முக்கியமானது! 🌳
பெண் நீலகிரி வரையாடுகள் குட்டிகளை வளர்ப்பதில் முக்கிய பங்கு வகிக்கின்றன! 👶
ஆண் மற்றும் பெண் வரையாடுகளின் தோற்றத்தில் வேறுபாடுகள் காணப்படலாம்! 🐐
மலைப்புல்வெளிகள் இந்த இனத்திற்கு உணவும் வாழ்விடமும் வழங்குகின்றன! 🌿
வாழ்விட அழிவு இந்த அரிய மலைவாழ் விலங்கிற்கு அச்சுறுத்தலாக இருக்கலாம்! 🌳

coolFacts.text: நீலகிரி வரையாடு செங்குத்தான மலைச்சரிவுகளில் நன்றாக நகர முடியும்! 🧗
இவை புல் மற்றும் பிற தாவரங்களை உணவாகக் கொள்கின்றன! 🌿
நீலகிரி மலைகளின் 'ஷோலா-புல்வெளி' சூழல் இதற்கு முக்கியமான வாழ்விடம்! 🌱
முக்கூர்த்தி தேசியப் பூங்கா போன்ற பாதுகாக்கப்பட்ட பகுதிகள் இதன் பாதுகாப்புக்கு முக்கியமானவை! 🏞️
இந்த இனத்தை பாதுகாப்பது மேற்குத் தொடர்ச்சி மலை உயிரியல் பல்வகைமையையும் பாதுகாக்க உதவுகிறது! 🌍
வரையாடுகள் பாறைகள் நிறைந்த மலைப்பகுதிகளில் நகர்வதற்கு ஏற்ற உடல் அமைப்பைக் கொண்டுள்ளன! ⛰️
மலை சூழலின் மாற்றங்கள் அவற்றின் வாழ்விடத்தை பாதிக்கக்கூடும்! 🌱
பாதுகாப்புப் பகுதிகள் இந்த இனத்தின் வாழ்விடத்தை பாதுகாக்க உதவுகின்றன! 🏞️

en.title: 🎉 AMAZING FUN FACTS - Did You Know?
en.mainText: Tamil Nadu is full of CRAZY cool facts! From ancient temples to movie stars to coconut oil - let's explore! 🌟

keyFacts.text: Tamil Nadu has many thousands of temples - MORE temples than any other state! 🕉️
Kollywood (Tamil cinema) makes 200+ movies EVERY YEAR! 🎬
Tamil Nadu produces 80% of India's silk! 🧵
The state has a GIANT monsoon season - Oct to Dec! 🌧️
Chepauk Palace looks like a castle but it's over 250 years old! 🏰
Tamil Nadu has the LONGEST coastline after Gujarat! 🌊
Pearl fishing has been done here for 2,000 years! 💎
The Nilgiri Mountains have a train that's 150+ years old - STILL running! 🚂
Silk production is a HUGE industry - worms spin magic! 🪡
Ancient Tamil scholars invented ZERO in math (maybe)! 🧮

coolFacts.text: Ooty (Nilgiri Hills) is called 'Queen of Hill Stations' - SO beautiful! 👑
The Nilgiri Mountain Railway is one of India's oldest - built in 1873! 🚂
Tamil Nadu exports coconut oil worldwide! 🥥
Thanjavur paintings are SUPER detailed and gorgeous - 300+ years old! 🎨
The state produces 80% of India's spice exports! 🌶️
Some temples in Tamil Nadu have underground tunnels! 🕳️
Tamil Nadu's internet speed is the FASTEST in India! 🚀
The state grows MORE rice than most countries! 🍚

didYouKnow.text: Tamil Nadu has MORE temples (38,000+) than any other Indian state! That's an AVERAGE of 10 temples per town! Plus, Tamil cinema produces one of India's major film industries! 🎬

tryThis.text: Research Tamil Nadu's Thanjavur paintings - they're AMAZING! Or watch a Tamil movie with subtitles and hear the beautiful language! 🎥

en.narration: Tamil Nadu is famous for its ancient temples, classical arts, literature, cinema and long coastline. It is also home to important parts of the Western Ghats and several wildlife habitats. 🌿

ta.title: 🎉 தமிழ்நாடு - அற்புதமான தகவல்களின் பொக்கிஷம்!
ta.mainText: தமிழ்நாடு கோயில்கள், கலை, இலக்கியம், கடற்கரை, மலைகள் மற்றும் தொழில்துறையால் செழித்த மாநிலம்! 🌟
ta.narration:
தமிழ்நாடு வரலாறும் கலாச்சாரமும் நிறைந்த மாநிலம்! 🌟

பெரிய கோயில்கள், பழமையான தமிழ் இலக்கியம், பாரம்பரிய நடனங்கள், ஓவியங்கள் மற்றும் நீண்ட கடற்கரை — இவை அனைத்தும் தமிழ்நாட்டின் தனித்துவத்தை உருவாக்குகின்றன.

நீலகிரி மலை ரயில் மலைகளைக் கடந்து செல்லும் ஒரு புகழ்பெற்ற பாரம்பரிய ரயில். 🚂

தஞ்சாவூர் ஓவியங்கள் மற்றும் பரதநாட்டியம் தமிழ்நாட்டின் கலை மரபுகளை வெளிப்படுத்துகின்றன. 🎨💃

மாமல்லபுரம் மற்றும் சோழர் கோயில்கள் போன்ற இடங்கள் தமிழ்நாட்டின் கட்டிடக்கலை வரலாற்றை உலகிற்கு காட்டுகின்றன. 🌍

didYouKnow.text: உங்களுக்குத் தெரியுமா? தமிழ்நாட்டில் UNESCO உலக பாரம்பரியத் தளங்களாக அங்கீகரிக்கப்பட்ட பல முக்கிய இடங்கள் உள்ளன; சோழர் கோயில்கள் மற்றும் மாமல்லபுரம் அவற்றில் அடங்கும்! 🌍

tryThis.text: தமிழ்நாட்டின் ஒரு பாரம்பரியக் கலையைத் தேர்ந்தெடுத்து அதன் வரலாறு மற்றும் சிறப்பைப் பற்றி அறிந்து பாருங்கள்! 🔎

keyFacts.text: தமிழ்நாட்டில் ஆயிரக்கணக்கான கோயில்கள் உள்ளன! 🛕
தமிழ் இந்தியாவின் செம்மொழிகளில் ஒன்று! 📚
நீலகிரி மலை ரயில் UNESCO உலக பாரம்பரிய மலை ரயில்களில் ஒன்றாகும்! 🚂
தமிழ்நாட்டுக்கு இந்தியாவின் நீளமான கடற்கரைகளில் ஒன்று உள்ளது! 🌊
தஞ்சாவூர் ஓவியங்கள் தமிழ்நாட்டின் புகழ்பெற்ற பாரம்பரியக் கலை! 🎨
பரதநாட்டியம் தமிழ்நாட்டுடன் நெருக்கமாக இணைந்த பாரம்பரிய நடன வடிவம்! 💃
மாமல்லபுரத்தின் நினைவுச் சின்னங்கள் பல்லவர் காலக் கலைக்குப் புகழ்பெற்றவை! 🛕
சோழர் கோயில்கள் தமிழ்நாட்டின் கட்டிடக்கலை வரலாற்றின் முக்கிய சான்றுகள்! 🏛️
காவிரி டெல்டா தமிழ்நாட்டின் முக்கியமான வேளாண் பகுதிகளில் ஒன்று! 🌾
தமிழ்நாட்டின் பல நகரங்களில் பாரம்பரிய இசை மற்றும் நடன நிகழ்ச்சிகள் நடைபெறுகின்றன! 🎵

coolFacts.text: நீலகிரி மலை ரயில்வே 1908ல் தொடங்கப்பட்டு UNESCO உலக பாரம்பரிய தளத்தின் ஒரு பகுதியாக உள்ளது! 🚂
தஞ்சாவூர் ஓவியங்களில் தங்கத் தகடு மற்றும் நுணுக்கமான அலங்காரங்கள் காணப்படுகின்றன! 🎨

en.title: 🛕 BRIHADEESWARAR TEMPLE - The Giant Chola Temple!
en.mainText: A MASSIVE 1,000-year-old temple in Thanjavur with a tower so tall and heavy, no one knows exactly how ancient builders raised it!

keyFacts.text: Built around 1010 CE by Chola king Rajaraja I! 📅
Its tower (vimana) stands 66 meters tall! 📏
A UNESCO World Heritage Site! 🌍

coolFacts.text: The huge dome on top is carved from a SINGLE 80-ton block of granite - and nobody is fully sure how it was lifted to the top!
The temple was built entirely without any modern cranes or machines, using ramps and elephants!

didYouKnow.text: The giant dome capping the temple tower weighs about 80 tons and was carved from a single block of granite - historians still debate exactly how ancient builders lifted it 66 meters into the air!

tryThis.text: If you visit, stand at the base and look all the way up at the tower - imagine how it was built without any machines!

en.narration:
In the city of Thanjavur stands one of the greatest achievements of ancient engineering - the Brihadeeswarar Temple! 🛕

Built over 1,000 years ago by the Chola king Rajaraja I, its tower soars 66 meters into the sky.

Here's the truly amazing part - the massive dome on top is carved from a single 80-ton block of granite! Historians still aren't completely sure how ancient builders raised something so heavy without modern cranes.

Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar are separate cities.

en.title: 🍴 DHOKLA - The FLUFFY, STEAMY WONDER!
en.mainText: A light, fluffy, sweet cake made from lentils and rice! It's steamed (not fried) so it's nutritious! 🥘

keyFacts.text: Made from fermented rice and lentil batter! 🍚
Steamed in a large flat pan - SO fluffy! ☁️
Only 100 calories - super light meal! 🏃
Topped with mustard seeds, green chili, and coconut! 🥥
Takes 15 minutes to steam - fast! ⏰
Breakfast or snack - eaten EVERYWHERE in Gujarat! 🌅
Can be sweet or savory - both taste AMAZING! 😋
Stays fresh for 3-4 days! 📅
nutritious - protein + carbs! 💪
Each family has their own special recipe! 👨‍🍳

coolFacts.text: The steaming creates bubbles inside - making it fluffy like a sponge! 🧽
Khichiyu (sweet dhokla) tastes like sweet bread - SO good! 🍮
Some dhoklas are fried - called 'fafda' - CRISPY and DELICIOUS! 🍟
The fermentation process creates natural probiotics - GOOD for your tummy! 💚
You can add vegetables to dhokla batter - peas, carrots, corn! 🥕
A single dhokla can be torn and eaten - it's SO fluffy! 🤏
Street vendors sell dhoklas stacked in towers - beautiful presentation! 🏢
Dhokla pairs PERFECTLY with fresh fruit juice! 🥤

didYouKnow.text: Dhokla has been eaten in Gujarat for HUNDREDS of years! It's mentioned in ancient Gujarati texts! Even today, it's THE most popular breakfast in Gujarat! Street vendors wake up at 4 AM to make it fresh! 🌅

tryThis.text: Try making dhokla at home! It's so easy - mix batter, steam, and eat! Top it with mustard seeds, chili, and coconut. YUM! 🍳

en.narration:
Dhokla is FLUFFY, LIGHT, and YUMMY! ☁️

It looks like a golden sponge cake but it's NOT sweet - it's savory and amazing! 🥘

Makers take fermented rice and lentil batter, add ginger, chili, and spices, then steam it in BIG flat pans! 🍲

When it steams, it puffs up like a cloud! ☁️

Then you cut it into squares and top it with mustard seeds that CRACKLE and pop when you eat it! 🎆

It's SO healthy - only 100 calories! Perfect for active kids! 💪

Gujaratis eat dhokla for breakfast almost EVERY day! Street vendors sell it fresh in the morning! 🌅

You can eat it plain, with chutney, with pickles, or with yogurt!

The BEST part? It takes only 15 minutes to make - faster than most breakfasts! ⏰

Try it - your taste buds will LOVE the combination of fluffy texture and spicy flavor! 🌟

en.title: 🕌 STATUE OF UNITY - world's TALLEST Statue!
en.mainText: A COLOSSAL 182-meter tall statue of Vallabhbhai Patel! It's the TALLEST statue in the ENTIRE WORLD! 🌟

keyFacts.text: Located in Narmada Valley, Gujarat 📍
182 meters tall - SUPER SUPER tall! 🏛️
Built to honor Vallabhbhai Patel (Iron Man of India) 💪
Took 5 years to build! 👷
Bronze, limestone, and concrete - 2,000+ workers! 🔧
Has museum and galleries inside! 🎨
You can ride elevator to the chest - 150 meters high! 🛗
Visitors can see 3-4 km in all directions! 👁️
Built for $430 MILLION - one of world's most expensive statues! 💰
Over 1 million visitors per year! 👥

coolFacts.text: It's 33 meters TALLER than Statue of Liberty! 🗽
The statue weighs 68,000 tons - SUPER HEAVY! ⚖️
The face itself is 14 meters wide - you can see emotions! 😊
Elevated walkways let you walk INSIDE the statue! 🚶
Museum shows Patel's life story with holograms! 🔮
Laser light show at night - SPECTACULAR! 💡
The statue overlooks the Narmada River - beautiful views! 🌊
It's a symbol of Indian unity and strength! 🇮🇳

didYouKnow.text: Vallabhbhai Patel was the 'Iron Man of India' who united all of India's princely states! He's like the Avengers leader who brought everyone together! The statue honors his incredible achievement! 💪

tryThis.text: Visit the Statue of Unity and take the elevator inside! See the 360-degree view from the chest area - it's MIND-BLOWING! Take photos from different angles! 📸

en.narration:
The Statue of UNITY is ABSOLUTELY MASSIVE! 🌟

182 METERS TALL! That's like stacking a 20-story building on TOP of another 20-story building! 🏢🏢

It's the TALLEST statue in the ENTIRE WORLD! Taller than Statue of Liberty, taller than Christ the Redeemer in Brazil!

Who is it? Vallabhbhai Patel - called the 'Iron Man of India'! He united all of India's princely states after independence! 💪

Inside, there are elevators and galleries! You can ride UP 150 meters and see OUT from the statue's CHEST! 🛗

The view? You can see 3-4 kilometers in ALL directions! It's like looking from a helicopter! 👁️

At NIGHT, it has laser light shows - SPECTACULAR and MAGICAL! 💡

The statue is made of bronze, limestone, and concrete - 2,000+ workers built it over 5 YEARS! 👷

It cost $430 MILLION - one of the world's most expensive statues! 💰

Over 1 MILLION people visit every year to see this wonder! 👥

en.title: 🦁 ASIATIC LION - The Majestic King!
en.mainText: The world's only wild population of Asiatic lions is found in and around Gir in Gujarat. They're Asiatic lions are endangered and are protected through conservation efforts in and around Gir. 🙏

keyFacts.text: Only 600-700 Asiatic lions left in the world! 😢
Live only in Gir Forest National Park, Gujarat 📍
Weigh 160-190 kg (350-420 lbs) - HUGE! 💪
Males have MAGNIFICENT manes! 👑
Can live 15-20 years in wild 📅
Hunt in prides (groups) - cooperative hunters! 👨‍👩‍👦
Roar can be heard 9 km away! 📢
Cubs spend 2-3 years learning to hunt 👶
Eat 7-10 kg meat per day - BIG appetite! 🍖
about a century ago, fewer than 20 Asiatic lions left! 😢

coolFacts.text: Asiatic lions have smaller manes than African lions! 👑
They have a FOLD of skin on their belly - unique feature! 🐱
Prides are smaller than African lion prides - 3-10 lions! 👥
Female lions (lionesses) do most of the hunting! 💪
Cubs play-fight to learn hunting skills! 🎮
Project Lion in Gir Forest has successfully increased their numbers! 📈
Tourists can visit Gir Forest and see these MAJESTIC lions! 🚙
Asiatic lions roar to mark territory and communicate! 📢

didYouKnow.text: about a century ago, there were FEWER than 20 Asiatic lions left in the entire world! Now there are 600-700! This is one of the biggest conservation SUCCESSES! Scientists worked super hard to bring them back! 🙏

tryThis.text: Learn about Project Lion - the conservation effort that saved Asiatic lions! Visit Gir Forest (if possible) and see these AMAZING animals in their natural habitat! 🦁

en.narration:
Asiatic lions are ABSOLUTELY MAJESTIC! 👑

BUT - they're SUPER ENDANGERED! Only 600-700 left in the ENTIRE WORLD! 😢

They live ONLY in Gir Forest in Gujarat! That's the ONLY place where wild Asiatic lions exist!

They're HUGE - weigh 350-420 pounds! That's like 4-5 kids combined! 💪

Males have BEAUTIFUL manes - but smaller than African lions! 👑

Here's the cool part - lionesses (female lions) do the HUNTING! They work as a team! 💪

Their roar? You can hear it from 9 km away! That's like hearing a shout from 3 school blocks away! 📢

BUT here's the AMAZING part - about a century ago, fewer than 20 existed! Scientists saved them! Now there are 600+ through Project Lion! 🙏

They're making a COMEBACK! 📈

Visit Gir Forest and see these ROYAL animals! 🦁

en.title: 🙏 SOMNATH TEMPLE - The Temple of the Moon God!
en.mainText: One of India's 12 MOST SACRED temples! An ANCIENT temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, beautifully rebuilt after centuries of invasions!

keyFacts.text: One of the 12 JYOTIRLINGAS - most sacred shrines in Hinduism! 🙏
Located by the Arabian Sea - SO BEAUTIFUL! 🌊
First temple built in 649 CE - over 1350 YEARS OLD! 👵
Rebuilt 17 TIMES after invasions - a symbol of RESILIENCE! 💪
The current temple was rebuilt in 1951 after independence! 🇮🇳
The temple tower is 155 feet tall - MAGNIFICENTLY TALL! 📏
Made with intricate STONE CARVINGS - BEAUTIFUL CRAFTSMANSHIP! 🎨
Attracts over 10 LAKH pilgrims annually! 🙏

coolFacts.text: The name 'Somnath' means 'Lord of the Moon' - dedicated to Chandra (Moon God)! 🌙
The temple has SURVIVED multiple INVASIONS and EARTHQUAKES - a TRUE SURVIVOR! 💪
The sunken temple chamber is unique to Somnath - ARCHITECTURAL MARVEL! 🏛️
A famous saying: 'Somnath is never destroyed' - because it keeps getting REBUILT! ✨
The temple faces the Arabian Sea - unique positioning for a temple! 🌅
Inside, ancient STONE IDOLS are CAREFULLY PRESERVED! 🗿

didYouKnow.text: Somnath Temple is a SYMBOL of RESILIENCE and FAITH! It has been destroyed and rebuilt SO MANY TIMES that it represents the INDOMITABLE SPIRIT of India! 💪

tryThis.text: Visit Somnath Temple during SUNSET by the Arabian Sea - the VIEW is ABSOLUTELY MAGICAL! 🌅

en.narration:
SOMNATH TEMPLE is a SYMBOL of FAITH and RESILIENCE! 🙏

Located ON THE SEASHORE of the Arabian Sea, it's ONE OF THE 12 MOST SACRED TEMPLES IN HINDUISM! 🌊

Over 1350 YEARS OLD! Built in 649 CE - that's before the MIDDLE AGES in Europe! 👵

But here's the AMAZING part: It was DESTROYED and REBUILT 17 TIMES! After invasions, earthquakes, and disasters, the people ALWAYS rebuilt it! 💪

Even after COMPLETE DESTRUCTION, they said: 'Somnath is never destroyed!' - NEVER GIVE UP attitude! ✨

The CURRENT temple was rebuilt in 1951, right after India became independent! It's a SYMBOL of India's REVIVAL! 🇮🇳

The temple tower is 155 FEET TALL with INTRICATE STONE CARVINGS! Every detail is CAREFULLY CARVED! 🎨

Inside, you feel the SPIRITUAL ENERGY! MILLIONS of pilgrims have prayed here over 1350 YEARS! 🙏

The SUNSET VIEW here is ABSOLUTELY SPECTACULAR! The sun sinking into the Arabian Sea while the temple glows - it's MAGICAL! 🌅

en.narration:
Hyderabad is the CITY OF PEARLS! 💎

1 CRORE people live here on beautiful lakes! It's a city where HISTORY and TECHNOLOGY meet! 🏙️

The Charminar is the HEART of Hyderabad! Built 400 years ago (1591)! It has 4 towers - 'char' means 4, 'minar' means tower! 🕌

Hyderabad was FAMOUS throughout the world for its PEARLS! Traders came from everywhere to buy them! 💎

Now it's a TECH HUB! Google, Microsoft, Facebook, Amazon - all have HUGE offices here! Thousands of tech workers code, design, and build apps! 💻

But the BEST part? The BIRYANI! 🍲 Hyderabadi biryani is considered the BEST in the entire world! Rice cooked with meat, spices, and... MAGIC! People travel from other countries just to eat it!

Hussain Sagar is a MASSIVE lake right in the middle of the city! You can take boat rides! 🌊

When you visit Hyderabad:
- See Charminar 🕌
- Explore old bazaars (narrow streets full of colors!) 🎨
- Eat authentic biryani 🍲

- Feel the HISTORY! 👑

గోల్కొండ కోట వజ్రాల వ్యాపారంతో చారిత్రకంగా అనుబంధం కలిగి ఉంది! 💎
హైదరాబాద్‌లో HITEC సిటీ మరియు సైబరాబాద్ వంటి ఆధునిక ప్రాంతాలు ఉన్నాయి! 💻
రామోజీ ఫిల్మ్ సిటీ హైదరాబాద్ సమీపంలో ఉంది! 🎬
హైదరాబాద్‌లో అనేక ఉద్యానవనాలు మరియు పచ్చని ప్రదేశాలు కూడా ఉన్నాయి! 🌳

didYouKnow.text: హైదరాబాద్‌లో చారిత్రక వారసత్వం మరియు ఆధునిక సాంకేతిక ప్రపంచం రెండూ కలిసి కనిపిస్తాయి. ఒకవైపు చార్మినార్, గోల్కొండ కోట ఉంటే, మరోవైపు సైబరాబాద్‌లో ఆధునిక కార్యాలయాలు ఉన్నాయి! 🕌💻

tryThis.text: ఒక కాగితంపై హైదరాబాద్ నగరాన్ని గీయండి. చార్మినార్, సరస్సు, కోట మరియు ఆధునిక భవనాలను మీ చిత్రంలో చేర్చండి! 🎨

te.narration:
హైదరాబాద్ తెలంగాణ రాజధాని. 🏙️

మూసీ నది ఒడ్డున ఉన్న ఈ నగరం చారిత్రక కట్టడాలు మరియు ఆధునిక సాంకేతిక రంగం రెండింటికీ ప్రసిద్ధి చెందింది. చార్మినార్, గోల్కొండ కోట మరియు హుస్సేన్ సాగర్ ముఖ్యమైన ప్రదేశాలు.

హైదరాబాదీ బిర్యానీ వంటి వంటకాలు కూడా నగరానికి ప్రసిద్ధి తెచ్చాయి.

en.title: 🗣️ TELUGU - The Melodious Language!
en.mainText: Telugu is sometimes popularly described as musical because of its sound and literary tradition. 🎵 Over 75 million people speak it! 🎵

keyFacts.text: Spoken by millions people! 🌍
Called 'a language with a rich literary tradition' - super melodious! 🎵
One of the oldest Dravidian languages! 📜
Exact origin of the word 'Telugu' is debated by scholars - some link it to the ancient 'Trilinga' region! 🔍
Has beautiful curved script that looks like waves! 🌊
NAMASKARAM = Hello! 🙏
DHANYAVADAM = Thank you! 💚
Telugu cinema (Tollywood) is HUGE - many films yearly! 🎬
Ancient Telugu literature dates back 1,000+ years! 📚
Famous worldwide through Telugu movies and actors! 🌟

coolFacts.text: Telugu is the one of the major languages spoken in the region in India! 🏆
Tollywood (Telugu cinema) is the second-largest film industry after Hindi! 🎬
Telugu script is so artistic - each letter looks like a piece of art! 🎨
The language has beautiful poetry called 'Padyalu'! 📖
Telugu actors are SUPER famous in Indian cinema! ⭐
The language borrowed from Sanskrit and influenced other languages! 🌍
Some Telugu words have deep spiritual meaning! 🙏
Famous Telugu celebrities work in Hindi cinema too! 🌟

didYouKnow.text: Telugu is one of India's major languages and is spoken widely in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. Tollywood produces almost 100 movies EVERY YEAR! 🎬

tryThis.text: Watch Telugu movies with subtitles! Or learn Telugu greetings: NAMASKARAM (hello), DHANYAVADAM (thank you), ROJULLO (good day)! 🎥

en.narration:
Telugu is SUPER musical! It's called 'a language with a rich literary tradition' - imagine talking and singing at the same time! 🎵

millions people speak Telugu! That's like... the entire population of Egypt! 🌍

Tollywood (Telugu cinema) is HUGE - many films EVERY YEAR! That's almost 2 movies per week! 🎬

The script is SO beautiful - it looks like waves and curves! 🌊

Telugu has been written for over 1,000 YEARS! Ancient poets wrote beautiful verses called 'Padyalu'! 📖

Vocabulary is SO poetic - some words have meanings that go super deep! 🙏

Telugu actors are WORLD FAMOUS! They act in Hindi movies too!

NAMASKARAM (Nah-mas-KAR-um) = Hello! DHANYAVADAM (Dhan-ya-VAH-dum) = Thank you!

Say these words and you're speaking one of world's famous languages! 🌟

te.title: 🗣️ తెలుగు - తెలంగాణ భాష!
te.mainText: తెలుగు తెలంగాణలో ప్రధానంగా మాట్లాడే భాష. ఇది ద్రావిడ భాషా కుటుంబానికి చెందినది మరియు ప్రత్యేకమైన తెలుగు లిపిలో వ్రాయబడుతుంది.

keyFacts.text: తెలంగాణలో ప్రధాన భాష! 🗣️
తెలుగు ద్రావిడ భాషా కుటుంబానికి చెందినది! 🌏
తెలుగు ప్రత్యేకమైన లిపిలో వ్రాయబడుతుంది! ✍️
తెలుగు భారతదేశంలోని ప్రాచీన సాహిత్య భాషల్లో ఒకటి! 📚
తెలంగాణ తెలుగు మాట్లాడే విధానానికి ప్రత్యేకమైన శైలి ఉంది! 🗣️
తెలుగు సాహిత్యానికి సుదీర్ఘమైన చరిత్ర ఉంది! 📖
తెలంగాణలో ఉర్దూ కూడా ముఖ్యమైన భాష! 🗣️
'నమస్కారం' తెలుగు అభివాద పదం! 🙏
'ధన్యవాదాలు' అంటే Thank you! 💚
తెలుగు ప్రపంచంలోని వివిధ దేశాల్లోని తెలుగు సమాజాలచే మాట్లాడబడుతుంది! 🌍

coolFacts.text: తెలుగు లిపిలో అచ్చులు మరియు హల్లులకు ప్రత్యేక అక్షరాలు ఉన్నాయి! 🔤
తెలుగు లిపి వంపుల ఆకారాలతో కనిపిస్తుంది! ✍️
తెలుగు సాహిత్యంలో కవిత్వానికి గొప్ప సంప్రదాయం ఉంది! 📖
తెలుగు సినిమా పరిశ్రమలో హైదరాబాద్ ముఖ్యమైన కేంద్రం! 🎬
తెలుగు భాషను భారతదేశంలోని శాస్త్రీయ భాషలలో ఒకటిగా గుర్తించారు! 🏛️
తెలుగు పద్యాలు మరియు పాటలకు గొప్ప సాహిత్య సంప్రదాయం ఉంది! 🎶
తెలుగు పద్యాలు మరియు పాటలకు గొప్ప సాహిత్య సంప్రదాయం ఉంది! 🎶
తెలుగు పద్యాలు మరియు పాటలకు గొప్ప సాహిత్య సంప్రదాయం ఉంది! 🎶

didYouKnow.text: తెలుగును 'ఇటాలియన్ ఆఫ్ ది ఈస్ట్' అని ఒకప్పుడు పిలిచేవారు. ఇది భాషలోని అనేక పదాల చివర అచ్చులు వినిపించే ధ్వని లక్షణాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది! 🎵

tryThis.text: తెలుగు లిపిలో మీ పేరును రాయడానికి ప్రయత్నించండి. ముందుగా కొన్ని తెలుగు అక్షరాలు నేర్చుకుని వాటిని కలపండి! ✍️

te.narration:
తెలుగు తెలంగాణలో ప్రధానంగా మాట్లాడే భాష మరియు ద్రావిడ భాషా కుటుంబానికి చెందినది. 🗣️

తెలుగు ప్రత్యేకమైన లిపిలో వ్రాయబడుతుంది. ఈ లిపిలో అచ్చులు, హల్లులు మరియు వాటి కలయికలకు ప్రత్యేక గుర్తులు ఉన్నాయి.

తెలుగు సాహిత్యానికి సుదీర్ఘ చరిత్ర ఉంది. తెలంగాణలో తెలుగు తో పాటు ఉర్దూ కూడా ముఖ్యమైన భాషగా ఉపయోగించబడుతుంది.

en.title: 🍲 HYDERABADI BIRYANI - The Royal Rice Treasure!
en.mainText: A LEGENDARY rice dish with meat and spices layered together! Each grain of rice is infused with flavor! It's the KING of Indian rice dishes! 👑

keyFacts.text: Biryani means 'cooked together' - rice + meat cooked together! 🍚
Hyderabadi biryani is THE BEST in India! 👑
Invented for royal kings (Nizams) of Hyderabad! 👑
Takes 45-60 minutes to cook! ⏰
Uses basmati rice - long and fragrant! 🌾
Cooked in layers - marinated meat, then rice! 🍽️
Saffron (expensive spice) gives it golden color! 🟡
Each grain is separate - never mushy! ✨
Served with raita (yogurt) and pickles! 🥒
One of world's most famous Indian dishes! 🌍

coolFacts.text: Biryani was invented for Mughal emperors! 👑
The word 'Biryani' comes from Persian! 🌏
Dum pukht (slow cooking) is the SECRET! ⏱️
Saffron and rose water give it fragrance! 🌹
Different regions make biryani differently - Hyderabadi is best! 🏆
A single biryani pot feeds 4-5 people easily! 👥
The rice never gets mushy - each grain is PERFECT! ✨
Biryani can be made with chicken, mutton, or vegetables! 🥘

didYouKnow.text: Hyderabadi biryani developed in the Hyderabad region and is strongly associated with the city's culinary history and Nizami-era cuisine.! Kings ate it at royal feasts! 👑

tryThis.text: Visit a authentic Hyderabadi biryani restaurant and order a proper biryani! Eat it with raita and pickles! Or watch videos of biryani-making! 🎥

en.narration:
Hyderabadi biryani is ABSOLUTELY LEGENDARY! 👑

Imagine - long golden rice grains mixed with tender meat, all fragrant with saffron and spices!

It was invented for the NIZAMS (kings) of Hyderabad! This is ROYAL FOOD! 👑

Cooks layer marinated meat and rice in a big pot - then seal it! 🔒

Slow cooking (called 'dum pukht') - the flavors mix together perfectly!

When you open the lid - WOW! Golden rice, aromatic steam, AMAZING smell! 🌟

Each grain of rice is SEPARATE - not mushy! That's the art of making biryani! ✨

Saffron (the most expensive spice!) gives it golden color and special fragrance! 🌹

You eat it with yogurt (raita) and pickles - the flavors are MIND-BLOWING! 🤯

One pot of biryani feeds a WHOLE family!

It's so famous that UNESCO recognizes it as part of world's cultural heritage! 🌍

Hyderabadi biryani is the BEST biryani in the ENTIRE WORLD! 👑

te.title: 🍛 హైదరాబాదీ బిర్యానీ - తెలంగాణ ప్రసిద్ధ వంటకం!
te.mainText: హైదరాబాదీ బిర్యానీ తెలంగాణలో ప్రసిద్ధి చెందిన వంటకం. సువాసనగల బియ్యం, మసాలాలు మరియు కూరగాయలు లేదా మాంసంతో తయారయ్యే ఈ వంటకం హైదరాబాదీ వంటకాలలో ముఖ్యమైనది.

keyFacts.text: హైదరాబాద్‌కు ప్రసిద్ధి చెందిన వంటకం! 🍛
బాస్మతి లేదా ఇతర పొడవైన గింజల బియ్యం ఉపయోగించవచ్చు! 🍚
సువాసనగల మసాలాలు వాడతారు! 🌶️
కూరగాయలు లేదా మాంసంతో తయారు చేయవచ్చు! 🥕
దమ్ పద్ధతిలో నెమ్మదిగా వండే సంప్రదాయం ఉంది! ♨️
ఉల్లిపాయ, పుదీనా మరియు కొత్తిమీర వంటి పదార్థాలు వాడతారు! 🌿
హైదరాబాదీ వంటకాలలో బిర్యానీకి ప్రత్యేక స్థానం ఉంది! ⭐
రైతా వంటి పెరుగు వంటకంతో వడ్డించవచ్చు! 🥣
బిర్యానీకి అనేక ప్రాంతీయ రకాలున్నాయి! 🍽️
పండుగలు మరియు ప్రత్యేక సందర్భాల్లో కూడా వడ్డిస్తారు! 🎉

coolFacts.text: దమ్ పద్ధతిలో పాత్రను మూసి బియ్యం మరియు మసాలాలను నెమ్మదిగా ఉడికిస్తారు! ♨️
పుదీనా మరియు కొత్తిమీర సువాసనను పెంచుతాయి! 🌿
హైదరాబాదీ బిర్యానీలో బియ్యం పొరలుగా అమర్చవచ్చు! 🍚
బిర్యానీతో పాటు మిర్చీ కా సాలన్ వంటి వంటకం కూడా వడ్డిస్తారు! 🌶️
బిర్యానీ వంట విధానంలో మసాలాలు, బియ్యం మరియు ఇతర పదార్థాల సమతుల్యత ముఖ్యమైనది! 🍛
హైదరాబాదీ వంటకాల్లో తీపి మరియు కారపు రుచుల కలయిక కూడా కనిపిస్తుంది! 🍽️
హైదరాబాదీ వంటకాల్లో తీపి మరియు కారపు రుచుల కలయిక కూడా కనిపిస్తుంది! 🍽️
హైదరాబాదీ వంటకాల్లో తీపి మరియు కారపు రుచుల కలయిక కూడా కనిపిస్తుంది! 🍽️

didYouKnow.text: హైదరాబాదీ బిర్యానీకి 'దమ్' వంట పద్ధతి ముఖ్యమైనది. పాత్రను మూసి నెమ్మదిగా వండటం వల్ల బియ్యం మరియు మసాలాల సువాసనలు కలుస్తాయి! ♨️

tryThis.text: బియ్యంతో బిర్యానీ తయారయ్యే దశలను చిత్రాలుగా గీయండి: బియ్యం, మసాలాలు, పొరలు మరియు వడ్డించడం! 🎨

te.narration:
హైదరాబాదీ బిర్యానీ తెలంగాణలో ప్రసిద్ధి చెందిన వంటకం. 🍛

బియ్యం, సువాసనగల మసాలాలు, పుదీనా, కొత్తిమీర మరియు కూరగాయలు లేదా మాంసంతో దీనిని తయారు చేయవచ్చు. దమ్ పద్ధతిలో పాత్రను మూసి నెమ్మదిగా వండడం ఒక ప్రసిద్ధ విధానం.

హైదరాబాద్‌లో బిర్యానీతో పాటు అనేక ఇతర స్థానిక వంటకాలు కూడా ప్రసిద్ధి చెందాయి.

en.title: 🕌 CHARMINAR - Four-Faced Beauty!
en.mainText: A historic monument built in 1591 with four grand arches. It's the most iconic building in Hyderabad! 🌟

keyFacts.text: Built in 1591 by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah! 📜
156 feet tall - SUPER impressive! 🏛️
Four arches on four sides - one for each direction! 🧭
Each arch is 21.3 meters high! 🎯
Named after Charminar (4 minarets)! ✨
Used as a watchtower historically! 👀
Over 4 million visitors annually! 👥
Surrounded by busy marketplace - action everywhere! 🛍️
Part of UNESCO World Heritage Site area! 🌍
Symbol of Hyderabad's identity! 🏛️

coolFacts.text: Built to commemorate the founding of Hyderabad! 🎉
The architect designed it in Persian style! 🌏
Each arch has beautiful stucco work - ART! 🎨
The tower was used to call people to prayer! 📯
Built with granite core and lime mortar! 🏗️
From top, you can see the whole old city! 👁️
The marketplace around it is 400 YEARS OLD! 🏪
Charminar appears in Indian currency design! 💵

didYouKnow.text: Charminar is so famous that it appears on Indian currency! It's the symbol of Hyderabad's 400-year history! Millions of people visit every year! It's an icon of India's architectural heritage! 🌟

tryThis.text: Visit Charminar early morning to avoid crowds! Climb to the top and see 360-degree views of Hyderabad! Shop at the bazaar around it for traditional items! 🛍️

en.narration:
Charminar is ABSOLUTELY BEAUTIFUL! 🌟

4-FACED beauty - 'Char' means 4 in Hindi, 'Minar' means tower!

It's 156 FEET TALL - built 400 YEARS AGO! 📜

When you stand under Charminar and look UP - it's BREATHTAKING! 😍

Four massive arches - one facing each direction! North, South, East, West! 🧭

Each arch is 21.3 meters high - like stacking 7 tall adults! 📏

Built in Persian architectural style - SO elegant! 🌏

Inside, there's a marketplace that's been ACTIVE for 400 YEARS! People are buying, selling, eating, shopping - organized CHAOS! 🛍️

Climb to the top and see ENTIRE old city of Hyderabad! 👁️

From the top, you can see how the city grew around Charminar!

It's so important that it appears on INDIAN CURRENCY! 💵

Over 4 MILLION people visit every year! 👥

Charminar is the HEART and SOUL of Hyderabad! 💓

te.title: 🏰 గోల్కొండ కోట - రాళ్లలో దాగిన చరిత్ర!
te.mainText: హైదరాబాద్‌లోని గోల్కొండ కోట దక్కన్ చరిత్రలో ముఖ్యమైన కోట. బలమైన గోడలు, ద్వారాలు మరియు ధ్వని ప్రతిధ్వని వ్యవస్థకు ఇది ప్రసిద్ధి చెందింది.

keyFacts.text: హైదరాబాద్‌లో ఉంది! 📍
కాకతీయుల కాలంతో గోల్కొండ ప్రారంభ చరిత్ర అనుబంధం కలిగి ఉంది! 🏰
కుతుబ్ షాహీ రాజవంశం గోల్కొండను ముఖ్యమైన కేంద్రంగా అభివృద్ధి చేసింది! 👑
కోటకు భారీ రాతి గోడలు ఉన్నాయి! 🧱
ప్రధాన ద్వారం వద్ద చప్పట్లు కొడితే పైభాగంలో వినిపించే ధ్వని వ్యవస్థ ప్రసిద్ధి! 👏
గోల్కొండ ప్రాంతం చారిత్రకంగా వజ్రాల వ్యాపారంతో ప్రసిద్ధి చెందింది! 💎
కుతుబ్ షాహీ సమాధులు కోట సమీపంలో ఉన్నాయి! 🕌
కోట దక్కన్ వాస్తుశిల్పానికి ఉదాహరణ! 🏛️
కోటలో రాజభవనాలు, మందిరాలు మరియు ఇతర నిర్మాణాల అవశేషాలు ఉన్నాయి! 🏰
గోల్కొండ హైదరాబాద్‌లోని ముఖ్యమైన పర్యాటక ప్రదేశం! 🎒

coolFacts.text: కోటలోని ధ్వని వ్యవస్థ సందేశాలను దూరానికి చేరవేయడానికి ఉపయోగపడేదని చెబుతారు! 👏
గోల్కొండ కోట కొండపై నిర్మించబడింది! ⛰️
కోటకు అనేక ద్వారాలు మరియు రక్షణ గోడలు ఉన్నాయి! 🧱
గోల్కొండ వజ్రాల వ్యాపారానికి చారిత్రకంగా ప్రసిద్ధి చెందింది! 💎
కోట సమీపంలోని కుతుబ్ షాహీ సమాధులు కూడా ముఖ్యమైన చారిత్రక ప్రదేశాలు! 🕌
కోటలోని రాతి నిర్మాణాలు దాని రక్షణ వ్యవస్థను చూపిస్తాయి! 🧱
కోటలోని రాతి నిర్మాణాలు దాని రక్షణ వ్యవస్థను చూపిస్తాయి! 🧱
కోటలోని రాతి నిర్మాణాలు దాని రక్షణ వ్యవస్థను చూపిస్తాయి! 🧱

didYouKnow.text: గోల్కొండ కోటలోని ప్రసిద్ధ ధ్వని వ్యవస్థలో ప్రవేశద్వారం వద్ద చేసిన చప్పట్ల శబ్దం పైభాగంలో వినిపిస్తుంది. ఇది కోట నిర్మాణంలోని ఆకౌస్టిక్ రూపకల్పనకు ఉదాహరణ! 👏

tryThis.text: కోటకు వెళ్లినప్పుడు దాని గోడలు, ద్వారాలు మరియు కొండపై ఉన్న నిర్మాణాలను గమనించండి. అవి రక్షణ కోసం ఎలా ఉపయోగపడేవో ఊహించండి! 🏰

te.narration:
గోల్కొండ కోట హైదరాబాద్‌లోని ముఖ్యమైన చారిత్రక కోట. 🏰

దీని చరిత్ర కాకతీయుల కాలంతో అనుబంధం కలిగి ఉండగా, కుతుబ్ షాహీ పాలకులు గోల్కొండను ఒక ముఖ్యమైన కేంద్రంగా అభివృద్ధి చేశారు. భారీ రాతి గోడలు, ద్వారాలు మరియు కొండపై ఉన్న నిర్మాణాలు కోటకు ప్రత్యేకతను ఇస్తాయి.

గోల్కొండ ప్రాంతం వజ్రాల వ్యాపారంతో కూడా చారిత్రకంగా ప్రసిద్ధి చెందింది.

en.title: 🐘 ASIAN ELEPHANT - Gentle Giant!
en.mainText: The Asian elephant is the largest land animal in Asia and can weigh several tonnes. 🐘 Super intelligent, emotional, and social! 💪

keyFacts.text: Asian elephants weigh 4-5 TONS! 💪
Largest land animal in Asia! 🏆
Can live 40-50 years in wild! 📅
Trunk has 40,000+ muscles! 💪
Ears are HUGE - like fans! 👂
Incredibly intelligent - can solve puzzles! 🧩
Family-oriented - live in herds! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
Communicate through rumbling sounds! 📢
Only 3 species of wild elephants left! 😢
Memory is LEGENDARY - never forget! 🧠

coolFacts.text: Trunk is like a super hand - 40,000+ muscles! 💪
Can pick up a pea or knock down a tree! 🌳
Asian elephants have smaller ears than African elephants! 👂
They're vegetarian - eat 200+ kg food daily! 🥗
Babies (calves) are called 'umbrellas' - adorable! 👶
Elephants mourn their dead - VERY emotional! 💔
Live in family groups led by oldest female! 👵
Play in mud - it's like sunscreen for them! 🏊

didYouKnow.text: Asian elephants are ENDANGERED! Only 40,000-50,000 left in wild! They're losing habitat because forests are disappearing! Many sanctuaries are trying to save them! 😢

tryThis.text: Visit an elephant sanctuary and observe elephants! See how they interact with family members! Support elephant conservation! 🐘

en.narration:
Asian elephants are ABSOLUTELY AMAZING! 🐘

They're HUGE - 5-6 TONS! That's like 10 cars combined! 💪

Their trunk? 40,000+ muscles! It can pick up a tiny pea OR knock down a TREE! 🌳

They're SO intelligent - they solve puzzles, use tools, and remember things for YEARS!

Elephants are EMOTIONAL! They cry, celebrate, and mourn their dead! 💔

They live in family groups - mothers, daughters, sisters together! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦

Communicate through RUMBLING sounds - like underground telephone! 📢

Babies are SO CUTE - called 'calves' - they follow moms everywhere! 👶

Elephants love water and mud! They spray mud like sunscreen! 🏊

BUT - they're ENDANGERED! Only 40,000-50,000 left! 😢

Forests are disappearing and elephants lose homes! We NEED to save them! 🌳

Support elephant sanctuaries! 🐘

te.title: 🦌 చిత్తల జింక - తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్ర జంతువు!
te.mainText: చిత్తల జింక లేదా స్పాటెడ్ డీర్ తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్ర జంతువు. దాని శరీరంపై తెల్లటి మచ్చలు ఉండటం వల్ల దీనిని సులభంగా గుర్తించవచ్చు.

keyFacts.text: తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్ర జంతువు! 🏆
శరీరంపై తెల్లటి మచ్చలు ఉంటాయి! 🦌
నర జింకలకు కొమ్ములు ఉంటాయి! 🫎
గడ్డి మరియు ఇతర మొక్కలను తింటుంది! 🌿
అడవులు, గడ్డి భూములు మరియు నీటి వనరుల దగ్గర కనిపిస్తుంది! 🌳
భారతదేశంలోని అనేక ప్రాంతాల్లో విస్తృతంగా కనిపిస్తుంది! 🇮🇳
జింకలు గుంపులుగా కనిపించవచ్చు! 👥
పులులు మరియు చిరుతపులుల వంటి మాంసాహార జంతువులకు ఆహారంగా ఉంటాయి! 🐅
వన్యప్రాణి సంరక్షణ ప్రాంతాల్లో వీటిని రక్షిస్తారు! 🛡️
చిత్తల జింక వేగంగా పరుగెత్తగలదు! 💨

coolFacts.text: తెల్లటి మచ్చలు చిన్న వయస్సు నుంచే శరీరంపై కనిపిస్తాయి! 🦌
నర జింకలు కొమ్ములను ప్రతి సంవత్సరం వదిలి మళ్లీ పెంచుకుంటాయి! 🫎
చిత్తల జింకలు ప్రమాదాన్ని గుర్తించినప్పుడు హెచ్చరిక శబ్దాలు చేయగలవు! 📣
గడ్డి, ఆకులు మరియు పండ్లు కూడా వీటి ఆహారంలో భాగం కావచ్చు! 🌿
అడవిలో ఇతర జంతువులతో కలిసి ఒకే నీటి వనరులను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి! 💧
చిత్తల జింకలకు నీరు లభించే ప్రాంతాలు ముఖ్యమైనవి! 💧
చిత్తల జింకలకు నీరు లభించే ప్రాంతాలు ముఖ్యమైనవి! 💧
చిత్తల జింకలకు నీరు లభించే ప్రాంతాలు ముఖ్యమైనవి! 💧

didYouKnow.text: చిత్తల జింక శరీరంపై ఉన్న తెల్లటి మచ్చలు దాని ప్రత్యేక గుర్తింపు. అడవిలో చెట్ల మధ్య ఈ మచ్చల నమూనా దాని శరీరాన్ని పరిసరాలతో కలిసిపోయేలా చేయడంలో సహాయపడవచ్చు! 🦌🌳

tryThis.text: చిత్తల జింకను గీయండి. దాని శరీరంపై చిన్న తెల్లటి మచ్చలు వేయడం మర్చిపోవద్దు! 🎨

te.narration:
చిత్తల జింక తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్ర జంతువు. 🦌

దీనిని స్పాటెడ్ డీర్ అని కూడా అంటారు. శరీరంపై తెల్లటి మచ్చలు ఉండటం దీని ముఖ్యమైన గుర్తింపు. నర జింకలకు కొమ్ములు ఉంటాయి.

చిత్తల జింకలు గడ్డి, ఆకులు మరియు ఇతర మొక్కలను తింటాయి. ఇవి అడవులు, గడ్డి భూములు మరియు నీటి వనరుల దగ్గర కనిపిస్తాయి. వన్యప్రాణి సంరక్షణ ప్రాంతాలు వీటి రక్షణలో ముఖ్యమైనవి.

en.title: THE KOH-I-NOOR AND GOLCONDA
en.mainText: The historic Golconda region in present-day Telangana was famous for its diamond trade. The Koh-i-Noor is historically linked to the Golconda diamond region.

keyFacts.text: Golconda became an important centre for the diamond trade.
The Koh-i-Noor passed through many rulers and empires over time.
Historical gems can have complex histories, so avoid claiming an exact discovery site without a source.
