নীরমহল ত্রিপুরার গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ঐতিহাসিক দর্শনীয় স্থান! 🎒
প্রাসাদ ও হ্রদের মিল একটি বিশেষ দৃশ্য তৈরি করে! 🌅

coolFacts.text: নীরমহলের নামের অর্থ 'জলের প্রাসাদ'! 🌊
প্রাসাদে বিভিন্ন অলংকরণ ও খিলান দেখা যায়! 🏛️
রুদ্রসাগর হ্রদ পরিযায়ী পাখিদের জন্য গুরুত্বপূর্ণ! 🐦
বর্ষাকালে হ্রদ ও প্রাসাদের চারপাশের দৃশ্য আরও জলময় হয়ে ওঠে! 🌧️
নৌকায় করে প্রাসাদের কাছে যাওয়া পর্যটকদের কাছে জনপ্রিয়! 🚣

didYouKnow.text: নীরমহলকে 'জলের প্রাসাদ' বলা হয় কারণ এটি রুদ্রসাগর হ্রদের মাঝখানে নির্মিত। প্রাসাদ ও হ্রদের মিল এটিকে ত্রিপুরার একটি বিশেষ ঐতিহাসিক স্থানে পরিণত করেছে! 🌊🏛️

tryThis.text: একটি হ্রদের মাঝে ছোট্ট প্রাসাদের ছবি আঁকুন। তারপর একটি নৌকা ও কয়েকটি পাখি যোগ করুন! 🎨

bn.narration:
নীরমহল ত্রিপুরার রুদ্রসাগর হ্রদের মাঝখানে অবস্থিত একটি ঐতিহাসিক প্রাসাদ। 🏛️

মহারাজা বীর বিক্রম কিশোর মাণিক্য বাহাদুরের সময়ে এটি নির্মিত হয় এবং রাজপরিবারের গ্রীষ্মকালীন আবাস হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হতো। স্থাপত্যে বিভিন্ন ঐতিহ্যের প্রভাব দেখা যায়।

প্রাসাদের চারপাশে জল থাকায় নৌকায় করে এখানে পৌঁছানো যায়। রুদ্রসাগর জলাভূমিও পাখিদের জন্য গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।

en.title: 🐒 PHAYRE'S LANGUR - Tripura's Spectacled Monkey!
en.mainText: Tripura's official state animal is a leaf-eating monkey with white rings around its eyes that look just like glasses!

keyFacts.text: Official state animal of Tripura! 🏆
Also called the spectacled langur, for its eye markings! 👓
Fur is gray, with a lighter belly! ⚪
Lives in groups high in the forest canopy! 🌳
Eats mostly leaves, fruit, and flowers! 🍃
Babies are born bright orange, then turn gray! 🧡
Found in forests of Tripura and Northeast India! 🌏
Listed as an Endangered species! 😢
Rarely comes down to the ground! 🌲
Communicates with loud calls across the forest! 📢

coolFacts.text: Baby Phayre's langurs are born bright orange and slowly turn gray as they grow! 🧡
The white rings around its eyes make it look like it's wearing spectacles! 👓
It almost never leaves the treetops its whole life! 🌳
Groups can include a dozen or more monkeys living together! 👥
It's found in only a few pockets of forest left in the region! 😢

didYouKnow.text: Baby Phayre's langurs are born a bright orange color - completely different from the gray adults - and scientists think this helps other monkeys in the group easily spot and protect the babies! 🧡

tryThis.text: Draw a monkey wearing glasses - that's basically what a Phayre's langur looks like in real life! 🖍️

en.narration:
Tripura's state animal wears its own natural spectacles! The Phayre's langur has bright white rings circling its eyes, making it look like it's peering through a pair of glasses. 👓

These leaf-eating monkeys live in groups high up in the forest canopy and almost never touch the ground. And here's something surprising - their babies are born bright orange, not gray, slowly changing color as they grow older! 🧡

Sadly, this gentle monkey is now endangered, surviving in only a few patches of Tripura's shrinking forests.

bn.title: 🐦 ফেয়ার্স ল্যাঙ্গুর - ত্রিপুরার রাজ্য প্রাণী!
bn.mainText: ফেয়ার্স ল্যাঙ্গুর ত্রিপুরার রাজ্য প্রাণী। এটি একটি পাতাভোজী বানর, যার কালো মুখ, ধূসর-বাদামি শরীর এবং লম্বা লেজ রয়েছে।

keyFacts.text: ত্রিপুরার রাজ্য প্রাণী! 🏆
কালো মুখের জন্য সহজে চেনা যায়! 🐒
শরীর ধূসর-বাদামি রঙের হতে পারে! 🤎
লম্বা লেজ রয়েছে! 🐒
মূলত পাতা ও উদ্ভিদের অংশ খায়! 🌿
গাছে বসবাস করতে ভালোভাবে অভিযোজিত! 🌳
উত্তর-পূর্ব ভারতের বনাঞ্চলে পাওয়া যায়! 🌲
দলে দলে দেখা যেতে পারে! 👥
বন সংরক্ষণ এর বেঁচে থাকার জন্য গুরুত্বপূর্ণ! 🛡️
এটি এশিয়ার পাতাভোজী প্রাইমেটদের একটি! 🐒

coolFacts.text: ফেয়ার্স ল্যাঙ্গুর গাছের উঁচু ডালে চলাফেরা করতে পারে! 🌳
এর লম্বা লেজ ভারসাম্য রাখতে সাহায্য করে! 🐒
পাতা এর খাদ্যের একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অংশ! 🌿
দলবদ্ধ জীবন শিকারি থেকে নিরাপত্তায় সাহায্য করতে পারে! 👥
বন ধ্বংস হলে এদের বাসস্থান কমে যেতে পারে! 🌳

didYouKnow.text: ফেয়ার্স ল্যাঙ্গুরের কালো মুখ এবং লম্বা লেজ তার সহজে চেনার মতো বৈশিষ্ট্য। ত্রিপুরার বন সংরক্ষণ এই প্রাণীর জন্য গুরুত্বপূর্ণ! 🐒🌳

tryThis.text: ফেয়ার্স ল্যাঙ্গুরের একটি ছবি আঁকুন এবং তার লম্বা লেজ ও কালো মুখটি আলাদা করে দেখান! 🎨

bn.narration:
ফেয়ার্স ল্যাঙ্গুর ত্রিপুরার রাজ্য প্রাণী। 🐒

এটি গাছে বসবাসে দক্ষ এবং প্রধানত পাতা ও অন্যান্য উদ্ভিদের অংশ খায়। কালো মুখ, ধূসর-বাদামি শরীর এবং লম্বা লেজ এর বৈশিষ্ট্য।

দলবদ্ধভাবে থাকা এবং বনাঞ্চল সংরক্ষণ এই প্রজাতির নিরাপত্তার জন্য গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।

en.title: 🌏 TRIPURA - Tiny State, Big Heart!
en.mainText: One of India's smallest states, almost completely surrounded by Bangladesh, with royal palaces, rubber forests, and its own ancient language!

keyFacts.text: One of India's smallest states by area! 📏
Surrounded by Bangladesh on 3 sides! 🗺️
Once an independent kingdom for over 500 years! 👑
Ujjayanta Palace: former royal home, now a museum! 🏰
Kokborok: native Tripuri language! 🗣️
Rubber plantations are a major industry! 🌳
Bamboo and cane handicrafts are famous! 🎋
Home to 19 different tribal communities! 🏘️
Neermahal: a stunning royal 'water palace' on a lake! 💧
Gumti River flows through the state! 🌊

coolFacts.text: Neermahal, a royal palace built ON a lake, is one of the largest lake palaces in India! 💧
Tripura is home to 19 recognized tribal communities, each with its own traditions! 🏘️
The state is connected to the rest of India by only a narrow strip of land! 🗺️
Rubber trees cover huge areas of Tripura's countryside! 🌳
Its royal history stretches back over 500 years! 👑

didYouKnow.text: Neermahal, Tripura's stunning 'water palace', was built right in the middle of a lake as a royal summer retreat - visitors have to take a boat to reach it! 💧

tryThis.text: Design your own dream summer palace - would you build it on a lake like Tripura's kings did? 🎨

en.narration:
Tripura is one of India's smallest states, but it's packed with history. For over 500 years it was its own kingdom, ruled by a royal family whose palaces still stand today. 👑

One of the most magical is Neermahal, a royal retreat built right in the middle of a lake - you can only reach it by boat!

Surrounded almost entirely by Bangladesh, Tripura is home to 19 different tribal communities, each with unique languages, food, and traditions, all packed into this small, hilly state. 🌏

bn.title: 🎨 বাঁশের শিল্প - ত্রিপুরার সৃজনশীল ঐতিহ্য!
bn.mainText: ত্রিপুরায় বাঁশ ও বেত দিয়ে ঝুড়ি, আসবাব, অলংকার এবং দৈনন্দিন ব্যবহারের নানা জিনিস তৈরি করা হয়। এই কারুশিল্প স্থানীয় জীবনের সঙ্গে গভীরভাবে যুক্ত।

keyFacts.text: বাঁশ ত্রিপুরায় প্রচুর ব্যবহৃত প্রাকৃতিক উপাদান! 🎋
বাঁশ দিয়ে ঝুড়ি তৈরি করা হয়! 🧺
বেত দিয়ে আসবাব ও কারুশিল্প তৈরি হয়! 🪑
স্থানীয় কারিগররা হাতে নানা জিনিস তৈরি করেন! ✋
বাঁশ ও বেতের কাজ বিভিন্ন সম্প্রদায়ের ঐতিহ্যের অংশ! 🌏
দৈনন্দিন ব্যবহারের জিনিসও বাঁশ দিয়ে তৈরি হয়! 🧺
বাঁশ দ্রুত বেড়ে ওঠা উদ্ভিদগুলোর একটি! 🌱
কারুশিল্প স্থানীয় জীবিকা ও সংস্কৃতির সঙ্গে যুক্ত! 🤝
বাঁশের তৈরি জিনিস হালকা ও ব্যবহারযোগ্য হতে পারে! 🎋
ত্রিপুরার হস্তশিল্প রাজ্যের সাংস্কৃতিক পরিচয়ের অংশ! ❤️

coolFacts.text: বাঁশের কঞ্চি কেটে ও বুনে বিভিন্ন নকশা তৈরি করা যায়! 🎋
ঝুড়ি ও মাদুর বাঁশ বা বেত দিয়ে তৈরি হতে পারে! 🧺
বাঁশের কাজের জন্য দক্ষ হাতের প্রয়োজন হয়! ✋
প্রাকৃতিক উপাদান ব্যবহার স্থানীয় কারুশিল্পকে পরিবেশের সঙ্গে যুক্ত করে! 🌿
বাঁশ ও বেতের পণ্য বাজারেও বিক্রি হয়! 🛍️

didYouKnow.text: ত্রিপুরার বাঁশ ও বেতের কারুশিল্পে প্রাকৃতিক উপাদানকে কাজে লাগিয়ে দরকারি ও সুন্দর জিনিস তৈরি করা হয়। এটি সৃজনশীলতা ও স্থানীয় ঐতিহ্যের একটি উদাহরণ! 🎋

tryThis.text: কাগজ দিয়ে একটি ছোট ঝুড়ির নকশা আঁকুন। তাতে পুনরাবৃত্ত জ্যামিতিক নকশা যোগ করুন! 🎨

bn.narration:
ত্রিপুরায় বাঁশ ও বেতের কারুশিল্পের দীর্ঘ ঐতিহ্য রয়েছে। 🎋

স্থানীয় কারিগররা বাঁশ ও বেত দিয়ে ঝুড়ি, মাদুর, আসবাব এবং নানা দৈনন্দিন ব্যবহার্য জিনিস তৈরি করেন। এই কাজ বিভিন্ন সম্প্রদায়ের সংস্কৃতি ও জীবিকার সঙ্গে যুক্ত।

প্রাকৃতিক উপাদান ব্যবহার করে তৈরি এসব পণ্য ত্রিপুরার হস্তশিল্পের একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অংশ।

en.title: 🏯 NEERMAHAL - The Palace on a Lake!
en.mainText: A magical palace built RIGHT IN THE MIDDLE of a lake - you can only reach it by boat!

keyFacts.text: Built in 1930 on Rudrasagar Lake! 🌊
Its name means 'Water Palace'! 💧
Blends Hindu and Islamic architecture styles! 🏰

coolFacts.text: The only way to reach the palace is by boat - there's no bridge or road!
At night, the palace lights up and reflects beautifully on the still lake water!

didYouKnow.text: Neermahal was built as a royal summer retreat, and the king would sail across the lake to relax away from the noise of the city!

tryThis.text: If you visit, take a boat ride across the lake at sunset for the best view!

en.narration:
In the middle of Rudrasagar Lake floats a magical palace - Neermahal, the 'Water Palace'! 🏯

Built in 1930, it can only be reached by boat, gliding across calm lake waters to reach its white walls and domed towers.

The palace blends Hindu and Islamic architecture beautifully, and at night, its lights shimmer and reflect across the lake!

bn.title: 🏰 উজ্জয়ন্ত প্রাসাদ - রাজকীয় ইতিহাসের স্মৃতি!
bn.mainText: আগরতলার উজ্জয়ন্ত প্রাসাদ ত্রিপুরার রাজপরিবারের প্রাক্তন রাজপ্রাসাদ। বিশাল বাগান, জলাশয় এবং সুন্দর স্থাপত্যের জন্য এটি রাজ্যের অন্যতম পরিচিত ঐতিহাসিক ভবন।

keyFacts.text: আগরতলায় অবস্থিত! 📍
মহারাজা রাধাকিশোর মাণিক্য এটি নির্মাণ করেছিলেন! 👑
প্রাসাদটি ১৯শ শতাব্দীর শেষ দিকে নির্মিত হয়! 🏛️

coolFacts.text: প্রাসাদের স্থাপত্যে গম্বুজ, স্তম্ভ ও খিলান দেখা যায়! 🏛️
প্রাসাদের বাগানে বিভিন্ন গাছ ও জলাশয় রয়েছে! 🌳

didYouKnow.text: উজ্জয়ন্ত প্রাসাদ একসময় ত্রিপুরার রাজপরিবারের রাজপ্রাসাদ ছিল। আজ এটি রাজ্যের ইতিহাস, শিল্প ও সংস্কৃতি জানার একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ স্থান! 🏛️

tryThis.text: একটি রাজপ্রাসাদের নকশা আঁকুন। গম্বুজ, স্তম্ভ, বাগান এবং একটি জলাশয় যোগ করুন! 🎨

bn.narration:
উজ্জয়ন্ত প্রাসাদ আগরতলায় অবস্থিত ত্রিপুরার একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ঐতিহাসিক স্থাপনা। 🏰

মহারাজা রাধাকিশোর মাণিক্যের সময়ে এটি নির্মিত হয় এবং রাজপরিবারের বাসস্থান হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হতো। এর স্থাপত্যে ভারতীয় ও ইউরোপীয় প্রভাবের কিছু বৈশিষ্ট্য দেখা যায়।

বর্তমানে প্রাসাদটি ত্রিপুরার ইতিহাস ও সংস্কৃতির সঙ্গে যুক্ত একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ জাদুঘর ও ঐতিহ্যবাহী স্থান।

en.title: 🏙️ IMPHAL - Jewel of the Valley!
en.mainText: Nestled in a round green valley ringed by hills, Imphal is the birthplace of modern polo and home to a floating lake nearby!

keyFacts.text: Capital of Manipur, in a round valley surrounded by hills! ⛰️
Population: around 5 LAKH people! 🏙️
Ima Keithel: a huge market run ENTIRELY by women! 👩
Kangla Fort: ancient royal fort and heritage site! 🏰
Birthplace of modern polo (Sagol Kangjei)! 🐴
Loktak Lake is a short drive away! 🌊
Manipuri classical dance was born here! 💃
Home to war cemeteries from World War II! 🎖️
Surrounded by nine hill ranges! 🏔️
Best time to visit: October-March! 🌤️

coolFacts.text: Ima Keithel ('Mother's Market') has been run by women traders for centuries! 👩
The modern sport of polo traces its roots back to games played in Manipur! 🐴
Kangla Fort was once the seat of Manipur's kings! 🏰
Imphal sits inside a nearly perfectly round valley! ⛰️
Manipuri dance is one of India's eight classical dance forms! 💃

didYouKnow.text: Ima Keithel, Imphal's famous market, is run entirely by around 5,000 women traders and has operated this way for generations - it's one of the largest all-women markets in the world! 👩

tryThis.text: Imagine a market where every single seller is someone's mom or grandma - that's Ima Keithel in real life! 🛍️

en.narration:
Imphal sits inside a wide, round valley, ringed by nine hill ranges - almost like nature built a giant bowl for a city! ⛰️

Its most famous spot is Ima Keithel, the 'Mother's Market', where thousands of women have run every single stall for generations, selling everything from vegetables to handwoven cloth. 👩

Manipur also gave the world modern polo - a game once played on horseback by local warriors, later adopted by the British and spread across the globe! 🐴

mni.title: ইম্ফাল - মণিপুরগী রাজধানী!
mni.mainText: ইম্ফাল মণিপুর রাজ্যগী রাজধানী অমসুং প্রধান শহর অমনি। এদা রাজ্যগী প্রশাসন, সংস্কৃতি অমসুং দৈনন্দিন জীবনগী অচৌবা কেন্দ্র লৈরে।

keyFacts.text: ইম্ফাল - মণিপুরগী রাজধানী! 🏙️
রাজ্যগী প্রশাসনগী প্রধান কেন্দ্র! 🏛️
ইম্ফাল উপত্যকাদা লৈবা শহর! 🌄
ইমা কেইথেল - নুপীগী বাজার! 👩‍🦱
স্থানীয় বাজারশিং অচৌবা! 🛍️
মণিপুরী সংস্কৃতিগী কেন্দ্র! 🎭
পোলোগী ইতিহাসগা মরম লৈ! 🐎
লোকতাক হ্রদ নকশাদা অচৌবা জায়গা! 🌊
পাহাড়শিংনা উপত্যকা থুম্মা লৈরে! ⛰️
শহর অসি মণিপুরগী আধুনিক জীবনগী মখল অমনি! 🌆

coolFacts.text: ইমা কেইথেলদা নুপী ব্যবসায়ীগী ভূমিকা অচৌবা! 👩‍🦱
ইম্ফাল উপত্যকা পাহাড়শিংনা থুম্মা লৈরে! ⛰️
পোলো গেমগী ইতিহাস মণিপুরগা মরম লৈ! 🐎
মণিপুরী নৃত্য অমসুং সংগীত ইম্ফালগী সংস্কৃতিগী অংশ অমনি! 🎵
বাজারশিংদা স্থানীয় খাদ্য অমসুং হস্তশিল্প ফংই! 🛍️

didYouKnow.text: ইম্ফাল মণিপুরগী রাজধানী অমনি অমসুং ইম্ফাল উপত্যকাদা লৈরে।

tryThis.text: মণিপুরগী মানচিত্রদা ইম্ফাল অমসুং লোকতাক হ্রদ খুজ্জু! 🗺️

mni.narration:
ইম্ফাল মণিপুরগী রাজধানী অমনি! 🏙️

এদা রাজ্যগী প্রশাসন অমসুং সংস্কৃতিগী অচৌবা কেন্দ্র লৈরে।

ইম্ফাল উপত্যকা পাহাড়শিংনা থুম্মা লৈরে। ⛰️

ইমা কেইথেল অমসুং স্থানীয় বাজারশিং ইম্ফালগী পরিচিত জায়গা অমনি।

মণিপুরী নৃত্য, সংগীত অমসুং পোলো ঐতিহ্যসু শহর অসিগা মরম লৈরে! 🐎

en.title: 🗣️ MEITEI (MANIPURI) - Ancient Script, Living Language!
en.mainText: Manipuri, also called Meitei, has its own unique ancient script that almost disappeared - but is now being taught in schools again!

keyFacts.text: Meitei (Manipuri) is the main language of the Imphal valley! 🗣️
Has its own ancient script, separate from Hindi or Bengali! ✍️
The Meitei script fell out of use for centuries, replaced by Bengali script! 📜
Now being revived and taught again in Manipur's schools! 🎓
KHURUMJARI = Hello/greetings in Meitei! 🙏
THAGATCHARI = Thank you in Meitei! 💚
One of India's 22 scheduled official languages! 🇮🇳
Many hill communities speak their own tribal languages too! 🏔️
Rich oral and written poetic tradition! 📖
Manipuri dance songs are performed in this language! 💃

coolFacts.text: The old Meitei script almost vanished for 200 years before being revived! 📜
It's now taught again in Manipur's schools after decades of disuse! 🎓
Manipur's hill tribes speak dozens of additional, distinct languages! 🏔️
Manipuri is one of only 22 languages officially recognized in India's constitution! 🇮🇳
The script has curved letters quite different from Devanagari (Hindi's script)! ✍️

didYouKnow.text: The original Meitei script was banned and replaced with Bengali script centuries ago - but in recent decades, people worked hard to bring it back, and now children in Manipur learn to read and write it again! 📜

tryThis.text: Look up the Meitei script online and see how different its curved letters look from the English alphabet! 🔍

en.narration:
Manipuri, also called Meitei, once had its own beautiful script - but for centuries it was pushed aside and replaced with Bengali letters. 📜

In recent years, people in Manipur worked hard to bring the old script back to life, and today schoolchildren learn to read and write it again, alongside the Bengali-based writing still used in books and newspapers.

Beyond the valley, Manipur's hill communities speak dozens of their own separate languages, making the state one of India's most linguistically rich. 🗣️

mni.title: মৈতৈলোন - মণিপুরগী প্রধান ভাষা!
mni.mainText: মৈতৈলোন, যেটা মণিপুরী হায়নাসু কৌই, মণিপুরগী প্রধান ভাষাশিংগী অমনি। রাজ্য অসিদা অরোইবা অনেক ভাষাসু থাংই।

মৈতৈ ময়েক মৈতৈ সংস্কৃতিগী পুরানো লিখিত ঐতিহ্য অমনি! 📜

didYouKnow.text: মৈতৈলোন মণিপুরগী প্রধান ভাষা অমনি, অমসুং রাজ্যদা অনেক অরোইবা ভাষাসু শিজিন্নই।

mni.narration:
মণিপুর এক বহুভাষী রাজ্য অমনি! 🗣️

মৈতৈলোন বা মণিপুরী প্রধান ভাষাশিংগী অমনি।

পাহাড়ী অঞ্চলদা নাগা অমসুং কুকি-চিন ভাষাশিংসু শিজিন্নই।

লোকগীত, লোকনৃত্য অমসুং মৌখিক গল্পশিংনা মণিপুরগী সংস্কৃতি থাংজিনই! 🎵

en.title: 🍚 CHAK-HAO - The Black Rice of Manipur!
en.mainText: A rare, dark purple-black rice grown only in Manipur's hills, traditionally made into a sweet pudding for special occasions!

keyFacts.text: Chak-hao = 'black rice', a Manipuri specialty grain! ⚫
Usually made into Chak-hao Kheer, a sweet rice pudding! 🍮
Turns a deep purple color when cooked! 🟣
Grown mainly in Manipur's hill regions! ⛰️
Rich in antioxidants - considered a healthy 'superfood' rice! 💪
Eromba: mashed vegetables with fermented fish, a Manipuri classic! 🥘
Fish is a common protein, thanks to nearby Loktak Lake! 🐟
Bamboo shoots are used in many local dishes! 🎋
Fermented ingredients add tangy depth to Manipuri food! 🌿
Rice is the everyday staple across the state! 🍚

coolFacts.text: Chak-hao rice turns a rich purple color as it cooks! 🟣
It's sometimes nicknamed a 'superfood' for its high antioxidant content! 💪
Chak-hao Kheer is a must-have dessert at Manipuri festivals! 🎉
Loktak Lake supplies much of the fresh fish used in local cooking! 🐟
Eromba mixes mashed vegetables, chili, and fermented fish for a bold flavor! 🌶️

didYouKnow.text: Chak-hao black rice is naturally rich in antioxidants, similar to blueberries, which is why nutritionists today call it a 'superfood' - even though Manipuri families have eaten it for centuries! 💪

tryThis.text: Ask a grown-up if you can find black or purple rice at a store, and see how its color changes as it cooks compared to white rice! 🍚

en.narration:
Manipur grows a rice unlike any other - Chak-hao, a rare grain that turns a deep purple-black color. 🟣

It's traditionally cooked into a sweet, creamy pudding called Chak-hao Kheer, served at festivals and celebrations.

Alongside it, dishes like Eromba mix mashed vegetables with tangy fermented fish, and fresh fish from nearby Loktak Lake shows up in meals across the valley. 🐟

mni.title: ইরোম্বা - মণিপুরগী ঐতিহ্যবাহী খাদ্য!

mni.narration:
ইরোম্বা মণিপুরগী জনপ্রিয় ঐতিহ্যবাহী খাবার অমনি! 🍚

সিদ্ধ সবজি অমসুং মরিচগী ঝাল এনী স্বাদগী অচৌবা অংশ। 🌶️

ফারমেন্টেড মাছ শিজিন্নরবদি বিশেষ স্বাদ ফংই। 🐟

ইরোম্বা চালগা খাই অমসুং স্থানীয় উপকরণশিংনা মণিপুরী রান্নাগী নিজস্ব পরিচয় পীবি! 🌿

en.title: 🌊 LOKTAK LAKE - The Floating Lake!
en.mainText: The largest freshwater lake in Northeast India is covered in floating islands of tangled plants and soil, called phumdis - some big enough to build houses on!

keyFacts.text: Loktak Lake: largest freshwater lake in Northeast India! 🌊
Famous for phumdis - floating islands of plants and soil! 🏝️
Some phumdis are thick enough for houses and fishing huts! 🏠
Home to Keibul Lamjao National Park - the ONLY floating national park on Earth! 🏞️
Sangai deer (Manipur's state animal) lives on the floating park! 🦌
Local fishing communities live on the phumdis full-time! 🎣
Considered the lifeline of Manipur's economy and culture! 💚
Threatened by pollution and shrinking water levels! 😢
Popular for boat rides and sunset views! 🌅
Sacred to local communities for centuries! 🙏

coolFacts.text: Keibul Lamjao is the world's only floating national park - built entirely on floating plant mats! 🏞️
Some phumdis are thick and strong enough to build entire fishing villages on! 🏠
Loktak Lake supports thousands of fishing families who live right on the water! 🎣
The lake is the last natural home of the rare Sangai deer! 🦌
Phumdis can be several feet thick, made of decades of built-up plant matter! 🌿

didYouKnow.text: Keibul Lamjao National Park, on Loktak Lake, is the only floating national park anywhere in the world - its entire ground is made of thick mats of floating vegetation called phumdis! 🏞️

tryThis.text: Imagine your school being built on a giant floating raft of plants - that's what daily life is like for some communities on Loktak Lake! 🏝️

en.narration:
Loktak Lake looks like an ordinary lake from far away - but get closer, and you'll see it's covered in floating islands called phumdis, thick mats of tangled plants and soil! 🌊

Some are strong enough for entire fishing villages to be built right on top of them, bobbing gently on the water.

One special patch of these floating islands forms Keibul Lamjao National Park - the only floating national park anywhere on Earth, and the last wild home of Manipur's rare Sangai deer. 🏞️

mni.title: লোকতাক হ্রদ - মণিপুরগী বিখ্যাত মিঠা পানির হ্রদ!

কেইবুল লামজাও বিশ্বের একমাত্র ভাসমান জাতীয় উদ্যান হায়না পরিচিত! 🦌
সাংগাই মণিপুরগী রাজ্য পশু অমসুং লোকতাকগা মরম লৈরে! 🦌

শীতকালে পরিযায়ী পাখীশিং হ্রদদা ফংই! 🐦

didYouKnow.text: লোকতাক হ্রদদা ফুমদি নামক ভাসমান গঠনশিং লৈ অমসুং দক্ষিণ অংশদা কেইবুল লামজাও জাতীয় উদ্যান লৈরে।

tryThis.text: লোকতাক হ্রদগী ফুমদি মখলশিংগী ছবি খুজ্জু অমসুং সাংগাই হরিণগী মরমদা তমশু! 🔍

mni.narration:
লোকতাক হ্রদ মণিপুরগী প্রাকৃতিক রত্ন অমনি! 🌊

এনি মিঠা পানির অচৌবা হ্রদ অমনি।

ফুমদি নামক ভাসমান গঠনশিং এদা লৈরে। 🌿

কেইবুল লামজাও জাতীয় উদ্যান হ্রদ অসিগী দক্ষিণ অংশদা লৈরে।

এদা সাংগাই হরিণ ফংই, অমসুং হ্রদ অসি স্থানীয় জীবিকা অমসুং পর্যটনগা মরম লৈরে! 🦌

en.title: 🦌 SANGAI - The Dancing Deer!
en.mainText: Manipur's state animal is a rare deer that lives only on Loktak Lake's floating islands, walking with a strange bouncy gait that looks like dancing!

keyFacts.text: Official state animal of Manipur! 🏆
Also called the 'Brow-antlered Deer' or 'Dancing Deer'! 💃
Lives ONLY in Keibul Lamjao National Park, on Loktak Lake! 🌊
Walks with a bouncy, careful gait suited to floating ground! 🦶
Once thought completely EXTINCT in the 1950s! 😢
Rediscovered and brought back through conservation! 💚
Males have unique branching antlers! 🌿
Critically endangered - population carefully monitored! 🛡️
Weight: around 95-115 kg! ⚖️
A powerful symbol of Manipuri pride and identity! 💚

coolFacts.text: The Sangai was believed extinct before a small surviving group was found in the 1950s! 😢➡️💚
Its careful, bouncy walk on the soft floating phumdis looks like a graceful dance! 💃
It lives nowhere else on Earth except this one lake! 🌍
Conservationists have worked for decades to bring its numbers back up! 🛡️
It's featured on Manipur's state emblem as a symbol of pride! 🏆

didYouKnow.text: The Sangai deer was once thought to be completely extinct - until a small surviving herd was discovered hiding on Loktak Lake's floating islands, giving conservationists a second chance to save the species! 💚

tryThis.text: Try walking carefully on a soft, unstable surface like a trampoline - that's a bit like how the Sangai moves on its floating home! 🦶

en.narration:
The Sangai deer has one of the most incredible comeback stories in wildlife conservation. It was believed to be completely extinct - until a tiny surviving group was found hiding on the floating islands of Loktak Lake. 💚

It walks with a careful, bouncy step suited to the soft, spongy ground of its floating home, which is why people call it the 'dancing deer'.

Today it lives nowhere else on Earth except Keibul Lamjao National Park, making it one of the rarest and most precious animals in India. 🦌

mni.title: সাংগাই - মণিপুরগী রাজ্য পশু!
mni.mainText: সাংগাই মণিপুরগী রাজ্য পশু অমসুং কেইবুল লামজাও জাতীয় উদ্যানগী পরিচিত হরিণ অমনি। ফুমদিগী উপরে হাঁকপা মরমদা এনী 'ড্যান্সিং ডিয়ার' হায়না কৌই।

কেইবুল লামজাও জাতীয় উদ্যানদা ফংই! 🌿

en.title: 🏵️ MANIPUR - Jeweled Land of Dance and Sport!
en.mainText: The birthplace of modern polo, home to a classical dance form, and a floating lake with a dancing deer - Manipur is packed with one-of-a-kind wonders!

keyFacts.text: Manipuri dance: one of India's 8 classical dance forms! 💃
Birthplace of modern polo (Sagol Kangjei)! 🐴
Loktak Lake: home to floating islands and the rare Sangai deer! 🌊
Ima Keithel: massive all-women's market in Imphal! 👩
Chak-hao: rare black rice grown only here! ⚫
Nine hill ranges surround the central valley! ⛰️
Home to over 30 recognized tribal communities! 🏘️
Name means 'Jeweled Land' in Sanskrit! 💎
Shares a border with Myanmar! 🗺️
Rich handloom weaving tradition! 🧵

coolFacts.text: The word 'Manipur' translates to 'Jeweled Land' or 'Land of Jewels'! 💎
Manipur gave the modern world the game of polo, played on horseback! 🐴
Its classical dance form uses graceful, flowing movements inspired by nature! 💃
Loktak Lake and its floating islands exist nowhere else quite like this! 🌊
Handwoven textiles from Manipur are prized across India! 🧵

didYouKnow.text: The British first learned polo from watching a local Manipuri game called Sagol Kangjei, then took the sport home to England - which is how Manipur ended up giving the world modern polo! 🐴

tryThis.text: Look up a picture of Manipuri classical dance costumes - notice the beautiful, decorated skirts dancers spin in! 💃

en.narration:
Manipur's name means 'Jeweled Land', and it lives up to it - a lush valley ringed by nine hill ranges, filled with one-of-a-kind treasures. 💎

It gave the world the sport of polo, grew a classical dance form full of graceful, flowing movement, and is home to Loktak Lake's magical floating islands.

With over 30 tribal communities living across its hills and valley, Manipur is one of India's most culturally rich and least-explored corners. 🏵️

mni.mainText: পোলো খেলাগী ইতিহাস মণিপুরগা গভীরভাবে মরম লৈরে। স্থানীয় সাগোল কাংজেই খেলাগী ঐতিহ্য আধুনিক পোলোগী ইতিহাসদা অচৌবা জায়গা অমা লৈরে।

পনি সংরক্ষণগী গুরুত্ব অচৌবা! 🛡️

'সাগোল' মণিপুরী ভাষাদা ঘোড়াগী অর্থ পীবি! 🐎

didYouKnow.text: সাগোল কাংজেই মণিপুরগী ঐতিহ্যবাহী ঘোড়ার খেলা অমনি অমসুং আধুনিক পোলো খেলাগী ইতিহাসগা মরম লৈরে।

mni.narration:
সাগোল কাংজেই মণিপুরগী ঐতিহ্যবাহী ঘোড়ার খেলা অমনি! 🐎

'সাগোল' মানে ঘোড়া অমসুং 'কাংজেই' মানে লাঠি। 🏑

en.title: 🏯 KANGLA FORT - The Sacred Ancient Fort!
en.mainText: The ancient seat of Manipur's kings, believed to be the birthplace of Manipuri civilization!

keyFacts.text: Served as the royal capital for centuries! 👑
Home to sacred dragon statues called Kangla-Sha! 🐉
Located on the banks of the Imphal River! 🌊

coolFacts.text: The word 'Kangla' means 'dry land' - it was one of the first settled areas in the Imphal valley!
The fort has ancient temples, moats, and royal ceremonial grounds still preserved today!

didYouKnow.text: Kangla Fort is considered the spiritual and historical heart of Manipur, believed to be where Manipuri civilization first began!

tryThis.text: Look for the twin dragon statues (Kangla-Sha) guarding the fort's entrance!

en.narration:
On the banks of the Imphal River sits Kangla Fort - the ancient heart of Manipur! 🏯

For centuries, this was the royal capital where Manipur's kings ruled, and many believe it's where Manipuri civilization itself began.

Guarding the fort are twin dragon statues called Kangla-Sha, watching over the sacred grounds, temples, and moats that still remain today.

mni.title: 🏯 শ্রী গোবিন্দজী মন্দির - ইম্ফালগী ঐতিহ্যবাহী মন্দির!
mni.mainText: শ্রী গোবিন্দজী মন্দির ইম্ফালদা লৈবা মণিপুরগী গুরুত্বপূর্ণ বৈষ্ণব মন্দির অমনি। মন্দির অসি মণিপুরী রাজপরিবার অমসুং বৈষ্ণব ঐতিহ্যগা মরম লৈরে।

didYouKnow.text: শ্রী গোবিন্দজী মন্দির মণিপুরগী বৈষ্ণব সংস্কৃতিগী গুরুত্বপূর্ণ কেন্দ্র অমনি অমসুং ইম্ফালগী ঐতিহাসিক অঞ্চলগা মরম লৈরে।

tryThis.text: মণিপুরী রাসলীলা নৃত্যগী মরমদা তমশু অমসুং মন্দিরগী স্থাপত্যগী ছবি খুজ্জু!

mni.narration:
ইম্ফালগী শ্রী গোবিন্দজী মন্দির মণিপুরগী বৈষ্ণব ঐতিহ্যগী গুরুত্বপূর্ণ জায়গা অমনি। 🛕

en.title: 🏞️ SRINAGAR - The City of Lakes!
en.mainText: Srinagar is the summer capital of the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir; Jammu serves as the winter capital.

keyFacts.text: Summer capital of Jammu & Kashmir (Jammu is the winter capital)! ❄️☀️
Population: around 12 LAKH people! 🏙️
Dal Lake: famous for houseboats and floating gardens! 🛶
Mughal Gardens: Shalimar Bagh and Nishat Bagh, built by emperors! 🌷
Shikaras: colorful wooden boats used to ferry people on the lake! 🚣
Surrounded by snow-capped Himalayan peaks! 🏔️
Famous for hand-knotted Kashmiri carpets and shawls! 🧵
Old city has narrow lanes and centuries-old wooden houses! 🏘️
Saffron fields bloom nearby every autumn! 🌸
Best time to visit: April-October! 🌤️

coolFacts.text: Jammu & Kashmir switches capitals with the seasons - Srinagar in summer, Jammu in winter! ❄️☀️
Dal Lake has a floating vegetable market every morning, run entirely from boats! 🥕
The Mughal emperors built entire gardens here just to enjoy the mountain views! 🌷
Kashmiri Pashmina shawls, woven from ultra-soft wool, are famous worldwide! 🧣
Houseboats on Dal Lake were originally built by the British over a century ago! 🛶

didYouKnow.text: Srinagar's Dal Lake has a floating vegetable market that opens before sunrise - farmers paddle their boats loaded with fresh vegetables and sell them right on the water! 🥕

tryThis.text: Imagine buying your groceries from a boat instead of a store - that's daily life for people around Dal Lake! 🛶

en.narration:
Srinagar is built right around the shimmering Dal Lake, where wooden houseboats float like little hotels on the water! 🛶

Every morning before sunrise, farmers paddle out to sell fresh vegetables at a floating market, right there on the lake.

All around the city, Mughal emperors once built beautiful gardens like Shalimar Bagh just to enjoy the view of snow-capped mountains reflected in the still water - and you can still visit them today! 🌷

ur.title: 🏙️ سری نگر - جموں و کشمیر کا گرمائی دارالحکومت!
ur.mainText: سری نگر جموں و کشمیر کا مشہور شہر اور گرمائی دارالحکومت ہے۔ یہ دریائے جہلم کے کنارے واقع ہے اور اپنی جھیلوں، باغات اور کشتیوں کے لیے جانا جاتا ہے۔

keyFacts.text: سری نگر - گرمائی دارالحکومت! 🏙️
دریائے جہلم کے کنارے! 🌊
ڈل جھیل! 🚤
مغل باغات! 🌳
شکارے! 🛶
کشمیری دستکاری! 🎨
کشمیری کھانا! 🍚
برف پوش پہاڑوں کے قریب! 🏔️
کشمیری ثقافت کا اہم مرکز! 🎭
تاریخی شہر! 📜

coolFacts.text: ڈل جھیل پر شکارہ کشتی سواری ایک مشہور سرگرمی ہے! 🛶
سری نگر کے مغل باغات تاریخی باغبانی کی مثال ہیں! 🌳
دریائے جہلم شہر کے اہم آبی راستوں میں سے ایک ہے! 🌊
کشمیری قالین اور شالیں مقامی دستکاری کا حصہ ہیں! 🧶
سری نگر کی جھیلیں شہر کی شناخت کا اہم حصہ ہیں! 💧

didYouKnow.text: سری نگر جموں و کشمیر کا گرمائی دارالحکومت ہے اور ڈل جھیل، مغل باغات اور کشمیری دستکاری کے لیے مشہور ہے۔

tryThis.text: نقشے پر سری نگر اور ڈل جھیل تلاش کرو۔ پھر شکارہ اور عام کشتی میں فرق معلوم کرو! 🗺️

ur.narration:
سری نگر جموں و کشمیر کا مشہور شہر ہے! 🏙️

یہ گرمائی دارالحکومت ہے اور دریائے جہلم کے کنارے واقع ہے۔ 🌊

ڈل جھیل، شکارے اور مغل باغات شہر کی نمایاں پہچان ہیں۔ 🛶🌳

یہاں کشمیری دستکاری، کھانے اور ثقافت بھی دیکھنے کو ملتی ہے! 🎭

en.title: 🗣️ KASHMIRI - Language of the Valley!
en.mainText: Kashmiri has a beautiful, ancient poetic tradition and can be written in two completely different scripts!

keyFacts.text: Kashmiri is the main language of the Kashmir Valley! 🏞️
Can be written in Perso-Arabic script OR Devanagari script! ✍️
Dogri is the main language of the Jammu region! 🗣️
SALAM/ASSALAMU ALAIKUM = Hello in Kashmiri (Islamic greeting)! 🙏
SHUKRIYA = Thank you in Kashmiri! 💚
Rich Sufi poetic tradition, sung for centuries! 📜
Urdu is widely used for official and literary purposes! ✍️
Ladakhi, Balti, and other languages are spoken in nearby regions! 🗻
Belongs to the Dardic branch of Indo-Aryan languages! 🌏
Home to famous poets like Lal Ded and Habba Khatoon! 📖

coolFacts.text: Kashmiri can be written in two totally different alphabets, depending on the community! ✍️
Its Sufi poetry tradition is centuries old and still sung today! 🎵
Poet Lal Ded's verses from the 14th century are still recited in Kashmir today! 📜
Kashmiri belongs to a special Indo-Aryan branch called Dardic! 🌏
Jammu and Kashmir together are home to many different regional languages! 🗣️

didYouKnow.text: The 14th-century mystic poet Lal Ded composed short, powerful verses in Kashmiri that people in the valley still recite from memory today - nearly a long culinary history later! 📜

tryThis.text: Try writing your name in two different alphabets, like Kashmiri speakers can choose between two scripts! ✍️

en.narration:
Kashmiri carries centuries of poetry inside it. Mystic poets like Lal Ded wrote short, powerful verses hundreds of years ago that people in the valley still recite from memory today! 📜

It's unusual because it can be written in two completely different alphabets - Perso-Arabic or Devanagari - depending on the community.

Down in the Jammu region, most people speak Dogri instead, showing how much language changes across this one state's mountains and valleys. 🗣️

گوجری - کئی برادریوں میں بولی جاتی ہے! 🏔️

ڈوگری جموں خطے کی اہم زبان ہے! 🎤
اردو طویل عرصے سے خطے کی ادبی روایت کا حصہ رہی ہے! 📖
مختلف پہاڑی اور قبائلی برادریاں اپنی زبانیں بولتی ہیں! 🏔️
لوک گیت اور زبانی روایتیں مقامی تاریخ کو محفوظ رکھتی ہیں! 🎵

didYouKnow.text: جموں و کشمیر ایک کثیر لسانی خطہ ہے جہاں کشمیری، اردو، ڈوگری اور کئی دوسری زبانیں بولی جاتی ہیں۔

tryThis.text: کشمیری، اردو اور ڈوگری کے تین تین الفاظ سیکھو اور ان کے معنی تلاش کرو! 🗣️

ur.narration:
جموں و کشمیر میں کئی زبانیں بولی جاتی ہیں! 🗣️

کشمیری، اردو اور ڈوگری اہم زبانیں ہیں۔

گوجری اور مختلف پہاڑی زبانیں بھی کئی برادریاں بولتی ہیں۔

زبانوں کے ساتھ لوک گیت، کہانیاں اور ادب بھی ثقافت کو زندہ رکھتے ہیں! 🎵

en.title: 🍛 WAZWAN - A Royal Feast of 36 Courses!
en.mainText: Wazwan is a legendary Kashmiri feast that can include up to 36 different meat dishes, cooked by master chefs called wazas and served at big celebrations!

keyFacts.text: Wazwan: a multi-course Kashmiri feast, traditionally up to 36 dishes! 🍽️
Prepared by expert chefs called 'wazas'! 👨‍🍳
Rogan Josh: a rich, red meat curry - a Wazwan star dish! 🍖
Yakhni: a yogurt-based curry with warming spices! 🥘
Served on a big shared plate called a 'trami', for 3-4 people! 🍽️
Traditionally eaten at weddings and big celebrations! 💒
Cooking a full Wazwan can take an entire day! ⏳
Saffron, the world's most expensive spice, grows in Kashmir! 🌸
Kahwa: a fragrant green tea with saffron and almonds! ☕
Rice is served alongside almost every meal! 🍚

coolFacts.text: A full traditional Wazwan can include as many as 36 separate courses! 🍽️
Master wazas train for years to learn the recipes and techniques! 👨‍🍳
Guests often eat from one shared 'trami' plate as a sign of togetherness! 🍽️
Kashmiri saffron is considered among the finest and most expensive in the world! 🌸
Kahwa tea is traditionally served in special copper pots called 'samovars'! ☕

didYouKnow.text: Kashmiri saffron, used to flavor dishes and Kahwa tea, is one of the most expensive spices in the world - it takes about 150 flowers just to make one gram of saffron threads! 🌸

tryThis.text: Ask an adult if you can smell a saffron thread - notice its strong, unique fragrance, worth more than its weight in silver! 👃

en.narration:
Wazwan is not just a meal - it's a legendary feast! At big Kashmiri weddings, master chefs called wazas can prepare up to 36 different meat courses, served on one big shared plate called a trami. 🍽️

Dishes like Rogan Josh, a rich red curry, and Yakhni, a creamy yogurt curry, are Wazwan favorites.

And no Kashmiri meal is complete without Kahwa, a fragrant tea flavored with saffron - a spice so precious that it takes about 150 flowers just to make a single gram! 🌸

ur.title: 🍚 وازوان - کشمیری کھانوں کی روایتی دعوت!

چاول اہم حصہ! 🍚
کئی مختلف پکوان! 🍲
گوشت کے پکوان عام! 🥘

کشمیری مصالحے! 🌶️
بڑی تقریبات کی دعوت! 🎉
کھانے کی مشترکہ روایت! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
کشمیری ثقافت کا اہم حصہ! 🎭

coolFacts.text: وازوان میں کئی پکوان ایک ہی دعوت میں پیش کیے جا سکتے ہیں! 🍲

وازوان کشمیری مہمان نوازی کی ایک نمایاں مثال ہے! 🎉

didYouKnow.text: وازوان کشمیری کھانوں کی روایتی ضیافت ہے۔ اس میں مختلف گوشت کے پکوان، چاول اور دیگر کھانے شامل ہو سکتے ہیں اور اسے خاص تقریبات میں پیش کیا جاتا ہے۔

tryThis.text: وازوان میں شامل پانچ کھانوں کے نام تلاش کرو۔ پھر معلوم کرو کہ وازہ کس کام میں ماہر ہوتا ہے! 👨‍🍳

ur.narration:
وازوان کشمیر کی مشہور روایتی دعوت ہے! 🍚

اس میں ایک سے زیادہ پکوان شامل ہوتے ہیں۔ 🍲

خاص طور پر شادیوں اور بڑی تقریبات میں وازوان پیش کیا جاتا ہے۔ 💍

اسے تیار کرنے والے ماہر باورچی کو وازہ کہا جاتا ہے! 👨‍🍳

en.title: 🛶 DAL LAKE - Kashmir's Floating World!
en.mainText: A stunning lake in Srinagar where people live on houseboats, shop from floating markets, and paddle between gardens on colorful shikara boats!

keyFacts.text: Located in Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir! 📍
Famous for wooden houseboats people actually live and stay on! 🏠
Shikaras: decorated wooden boats used for rides! 🚣
Floating vegetable market operates every morning! 🥕
Surrounded by Mughal gardens like Shalimar Bagh! 🌷
Reflects the surrounding snow-capped mountains! 🏔️
Home to floating gardens where vegetables are grown! 🥬
A major tourist destination for boat stays! 🌟
Threatened by pollution - conservation efforts ongoing! 💧
Best enjoyed at sunrise or sunset! 🌅

coolFacts.text: You can actually spend the night sleeping on a houseboat floating on Dal Lake! 🏠
Local farmers grow vegetables on floating garden beds right on the water! 🥬
Shikara boats are often brightly painted and decorated with cushions! 🚣
The lake perfectly mirrors the mountains around it on calm days! 🏔️
Some houseboat families have lived on the lake for generations! 👨‍👩‍👧

didYouKnow.text: Some Kashmiri families have lived on houseboats on Dal Lake for generations, running floating shops and gardens as their family business, passed down parent to child! 🏠

tryThis.text: Imagine your whole house floating on water - what would be the best part, and the trickiest part, of living like that? 🤔

en.narration:
Dal Lake isn't just a lake - it's a whole floating world! Families live year-round on wooden houseboats, farmers grow vegetables on floating garden beds, and colorful shikara boats ferry people from place to place. 🛶

Every morning before sunrise, a floating vegetable market fills the water with boats loaded with fresh produce.

All around, snow-capped Himalayan peaks reflect perfectly on the still water, and Mughal-era gardens line the shores - a view so beautiful, emperors built entire palaces just to enjoy it. 🏔️

سبز میدان! 🌿

سردیوں میں گلمرگ برفانی کھیلوں کے لیے مشہور ہے! ❄️

didYouKnow.text: گلمرگ کشمیر کا ایک مشہور پہاڑی مقام ہے جو موسم گرما کے سبز میدانوں اور سردیوں کی برف باری اور اسکیئنگ کے لیے جانا جاتا ہے۔

tryThis.text: گلمرگ کے موسم گرما اور موسم سرما کے مناظر کا موازنہ کرو۔ کون سا موسم تمہیں زیادہ پسند آئے گا؟ 🏔️

ur.narration:
گلمرگ کشمیر کا مشہور پہاڑی مقام ہے! 🏔️

گرمیوں میں یہاں سبز میدان نظر آتے ہیں۔ 🌿

سردیوں میں برف پڑتی ہے اور اسکیئنگ کی جاتی ہے۔ ❄️⛷️

گنڈولا کیبل کار بھی یہاں کی معروف سرگرمی ہے۔ 🚠

en.title: 🦌 HANGUL - The Kashmir Stag!
en.mainText: The Hangul, or Kashmir stag, is one of India's rarest deer, found only in the forests of Kashmir - and nowhere else on the planet!

keyFacts.text: State animal of Jammu & Kashmir! 🏆
Also known as the Kashmir stag! 🦌
Found ONLY in and around Dachigam National Park! 📍
Males grow large, branching antlers with up to 11-16 points! 🌿
A cousin of the European red deer! 🌍
Critically Endangered - fewer than 300 left in the wild! 😢
Weight: around 170-240 kg (males)! ⚖️
Lives in high-altitude forests and meadows! ⛰️
Conservation programs are working to save the species! 💚
A powerful symbol of Kashmir's wildlife heritage! 🏔️

coolFacts.text: The Hangul survives in only one main protected forest on Earth! 📍
It's related to the red deer found across Europe! 🌍
Its population dropped dangerously low before conservation efforts began! 😢💚
Males use their large antlers to compete for mates during breeding season! 🌿
Dachigam National Park was created largely to protect this one species! 🛡️

didYouKnow.text: The Hangul population dropped to only a few dozen animals decades ago, but dedicated conservation work in Dachigam National Park has helped their numbers slowly grow back - though they're still critically endangered. 💚

tryThis.text: Draw a deer with big branching antlers, then count how many 'points' or branches you gave it - real Hangul stags can have up to 16! 🖍️

en.narration:
High in the forests near Srinagar lives one of India's rarest animals - the Hangul, or Kashmir stag. 🦌

It exists nowhere else on Earth except in and around Dachigam National Park, where males grow huge branching antlers to compete during mating season.

Its numbers dropped dangerously low over the years, but conservationists have worked hard to protect its last remaining forest home, giving this beautiful deer a fighting chance at survival. 💚

ur.title: 🐐 ہانگُل - جموں و کشمیر کا ریاستی جانور!
ur.mainText: ہانگُل، جسے کشمیری ہرن بھی کہا جاتا ہے، جموں و کشمیر کا ریاستی جانور ہے۔ یہ کشمیر کی وادی میں پائی جانے والی ایک اہم اور خطرے سے دوچار ہرن کی نسل ہے۔

didYouKnow.text: ہانگُل جموں و کشمیر کا ریاستی جانور ہے۔ یہ کشمیر کی وادی میں پائی جانے والی خطرے سے دوچار ہرن کی نسل ہے اور اس کے تحفظ کے لیے اقدامات کیے جاتے ہیں۔

tryThis.text: ہانگُل اور عام ہرن کی تصویریں دیکھ کر تین فرق تلاش کرو۔ پھر ڈاچگام نیشنل پارک کے بارے میں پڑھو! 🔍

ہانگُل جموں و کشمیر کا ریاستی جانور ہے! 🦌

en.title: 🏔️ JAMMU & KASHMIR - Paradise on Earth!
en.mainText: Snow-capped mountains, floating gardens, saffron fields, and a legendary feast - it's easy to see why this region is called 'Paradise on Earth'!

keyFacts.text: Nicknamed 'Paradise on Earth' by Mughal emperors! 🏔️
Two capitals: Srinagar (summer) and Jammu (winter)! ❄️☀️
Gulmarg: one of India's top skiing destinations! ⛷️
Saffron fields bloom purple every October! 🌸
Home to the rare Hangul deer, found nowhere else! 🦌
Dal Lake's houseboats are world-famous! 🛶
Wazwan feast can include up to 36 dishes! 🍽️
Pashmina shawls are woven from incredibly soft mountain-goat wool! 🧣
Amarnath Cave: major pilgrimage site high in the mountains! 🕉️
Vaishno Devi shrine near Jammu draws millions of pilgrims! 🛕

coolFacts.text: Gulmarg has one of the highest cable car rides in the world, the Gulmarg Gondola! 🚡
The Mughal emperor Jahangir supposedly said 'if there is a paradise on Earth, it is this, it is this, it is this' about Kashmir! 🏔️
Kashmiri saffron fields turn entire hillsides purple during bloom season! 🌸
Pashmina wool comes from a special mountain goat that lives at very high altitudes! 🐐
Millions of pilgrims trek to the Vaishno Devi and Amarnath shrines every year! 🕉️

didYouKnow.text: Legend says the Mughal emperor Jahangir was so amazed by Kashmir's beauty that he called it paradise on Earth - a phrase people still use to describe the region today! 🏔️

tryThis.text: Look up a photo of Gulmarg in winter, covered in snow - notice how it looks like a scene from a storybook! ❄️

en.narration:
Jammu & Kashmir has been called 'Paradise on Earth' for centuries, and it's easy to see why. Snow-capped mountains ring lakes so still they mirror the sky, saffron fields bloom purple every autumn, and Mughal emperors built entire gardens just to enjoy the view. 🏔️

Skiers flock to Gulmarg's snowy slopes, pilgrims climb to ancient mountain shrines, and families still cook the legendary Wazwan feast for special celebrations.

With two capital cities, one for summer and one for winter, this region truly changes with the seasons. ❄️☀️

ur.title: 🎉 دلچسپ حقیقت - کشمیر کی تیرتی سبزیاں!
ur.mainText: کشمیر کی کچھ جھیلوں میں تیرتے باغات اور کھیت دیکھے جا سکتے ہیں۔ ڈل جھیل کے تیرتے باغات میں سبزیاں اگانے کی روایت مشہور ہے۔

ڈل جھیل میں مقامی لوگ جھیل کے پانی اور زمین کا استعمال مختلف طریقوں سے کرتے ہیں! 💧
شکارہ جھیل پر آمدورفت کا روایتی ذریعہ ہے! 🛶
ڈل جھیل کے تیرتے بازار سیاحوں کے لیے منفرد منظر پیش کرتے ہیں! 🛍️

tryThis.text: تیرتے باغ کی تصویر بناؤ اور بتاؤ کہ پودوں کو پانی کیسے ملتا ہوگا! 🌱

en.title: 🛕 SHANKARACHARYA TEMPLE - A Temple Above the Clouds!
en.mainText: An ancient temple perched on top of a hill in Srinagar, with breathtaking views of the whole valley!

keyFacts.text: Sits atop Shankaracharya Hill, over 1,000 meters above Srinagar! ⛰️
Believed to be over 2,500 years old! 📅
Offers a stunning panoramic view of Dal Lake and the Kashmir Valley! 🏞️

coolFacts.text: The temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva and is one of the oldest shrines in Kashmir!
On a clear day, you can see the entire city of Srinagar and Dal Lake spread out below!

didYouKnow.text: From the top of Shankaracharya Hill, you can see the whole of Srinagar and Dal Lake spread out like a painting below you!

tryThis.text: If you visit, go at sunset for the most spectacular view over the valley!

en.narration:
High above Srinagar, on top of a hill, sits the ancient Shankaracharya Temple! 🛕

Believed to be over 2,500 years old, this temple has watched over the Kashmir Valley for millennia.

Climb to the top and you'll be rewarded with a breathtaking view - the whole city of Srinagar and the sparkling Dal Lake spread out below like a picture!

ur.title: 🏰 امر محل - جموں کا تاریخی محل!
ur.mainText: امر محل جموں میں دریائے توی کے قریب واقع ایک تاریخی محل ہے۔ اسے 19ویں صدی میں ڈوگرہ حکمران خاندان سے وابستہ محل کے طور پر تعمیر کیا گیا تھا۔

keyFacts.text: جموں میں واقع! 📍

coolFacts.text: محل کی تعمیر میں یورپی اور روایتی طرز کے عناصر ملتے ہیں! 🏰
آج امر محل میں ایک میوزیم بھی موجود ہے! 🏺

didYouKnow.text: امر محل جموں کا ایک تاریخی محل ہے جو ڈوگرہ دور سے وابستہ ہے اور آج اس میں ایک میوزیم بھی موجود ہے۔

tryThis.text: امر محل کی عمارت کی تصویر دیکھو اور اس میں نظر آنے والے مختلف طرزِ تعمیر کے عناصر تلاش کرو!

ur.narration:
جموں کا امر محل ایک تاریخی عمارت ہے! 🏰

یہ دریائے توی کے قریب واقع ہے اور ڈوگرہ دور سے وابستہ ہے۔

اس کی عمارت میں یورپی اور روایتی طرز کے عناصر نظر آتے ہیں۔

آج یہاں میوزیم بھی موجود ہے، جہاں خطے کی تاریخ اور ثقافت سے متعلق چیزیں دیکھی جا سکتی ہیں۔ 🏺

en.title: 🏔️ LEH - Gateway to the Cold Desert!
en.mainText: Perched at over 3,500 meters in the Himalayas, Leh is a high-altitude town of ancient monasteries, blue skies, and some of the world's highest roads!

keyFacts.text: Capital of Ladakh, at about 3,500 meters altitude! 🏔️
Population: around 30,000 people! 🏙️
Leh Palace: a 9-story former royal palace overlooking the town! 🏯
Extremely dry, high-altitude 'cold desert' climate! 🏜️
Home to centuries-old Buddhist monasteries (gompas)! 🛕
Gateway to Khardung La, one of the world's highest motorable roads! 🚗
Nubra Valley and Pangong Lake are nearby! 💧
Population is largely Tibetan Buddhist in culture! 🙏
Visitors need time to adjust to the thin mountain air! 🫁
Best time to visit: May-September (roads open)! ☀️

coolFacts.text: Leh sits so high up that some visitors need a day just to adjust to the thin air! 🫁
Leh Palace resembles a smaller version of the famous Potala Palace in Tibet! 🏯
Roads leading in and out of Leh are only open a few months a year due to snow! ❄️
The region gets very little rainfall, making it a true cold desert! 🏜️
Ladakh's culture is closely tied to Tibetan Buddhism, with monasteries everywhere! 🛕

didYouKnow.text: Leh is so high up (about 3,500 meters, or 11,500 feet) that the air has noticeably less oxygen than at sea level - visitors are told to rest for a day when they arrive so their bodies can adjust! 🫁

tryThis.text: Take a normal breath, then imagine that same breath giving you less oxygen than usual - that's what it's like to visit Leh for the first time! 🫁

en.narration:
Leh sits high in the Himalayas, over 3,500 meters up, where the sky looks impossibly blue and the air is thin and dry. 🏔️

Ancient Buddhist monasteries dot the hillsides, and the old Leh Palace, built like a smaller cousin of Tibet's famous Potala Palace, watches over the town from above. 🏯

Roads here climb to some of the highest points any car can drive in the entire world - and they're only open a few months each year before winter snow seals them shut. ❄️

keyFacts.text: ལེ་གྷ་རྫོང་ཁག་གི་ལྟེ་གནས། 🏛️
རི་བོ་དང་གངས་རིས་བསྐོར་བ། 🏔️
ལེ་གྷ་ཕོ་བྲང་གི་གནས་ཡུལ། 🏰
དགོན་པ་མང་པོ་ཡོད། 🛕
ལ་དྭགས་ཀྱི་རིག་གནས་ཀྱི་ལྟེ་གནས། 🎭
རྒྱལ་མཚམས་ལ་ཉེ། 🗺️
རི་འཛེགས་དང་གནས་སྐོར་གྱི་ལྟེ་གནས། 🥾
བོད་བརྒྱུད་ཆོས་ཀྱི་ཤུལ་བཞག་གལ་ཆེ། 📜

coolFacts.text: ལེ་གྷ་ཕོ་བྲང་ནི་ལོ་རྒྱུས་རྙིང་པའི་ཁང་པ་ཞིག་ཡིན། 🏰
ལེ་གྷ་རི་རྒྱུད་དུ་དགོན་པ་དང་ཆོས་ཀྱི་གནས་མང་པོ་ཡོད། 🛕
མཐོ་སྒང་གི་གནམ་གཤིས་ནི་གྲང་ཞིང་སྐམ་པོ་ཡིན། ❄️
ལེ་གྷ་ནས་རི་ལམ་གྱི་ལམ་ཆེན་མང་པོ་འགྲོ་ཐུབ། 🥾
ལ་དྭགས་ཀྱི་སྐད་དང་གོམས་གཤིས་ནི་ས་གནས་ཀྱི་རིག་གནས་ཡིན། 🎭

didYouKnow.text: ལེ་གྷ་ནི་ལ་དྭགས་ཀྱི་གཙོ་སྐྱོང་གྲོང་ཁྱེར་དང་རིག་གནས་ཀྱི་ལྟེ་གནས་གལ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞིག་ཡིན།

tryThis.text: ལ་དྭགས་ཀྱི་ས་ཁྲའི་ནང་ལེ་གྷ་དང་རི་དང་གཙང་པོ་གང་དག་ཡོད་པ་འཚོལ་དང་། ལེ་གྷ་ཕོ་བྲང་གི་སྐོར་ལ་ཡང་སློབས། 🗺️

en.title: 🗣️ LADAKHI - Voice of the High Mountains!
en.mainText: Ladakhi is closely related to Tibetan and is often written using the same ancient Tibetan script, reflecting Ladakh's deep Buddhist heritage!

keyFacts.text: Ladakhi is closely related to the Tibetan language! 🏔️
Often written using the Tibetan script! ✍️
JULE = Hello, thank you, AND goodbye - one word for all three! 🙏
Reflects centuries of Buddhist culture and tradition! 🛕
Balti is spoken in some western parts of Ladakh! 🗣️
Hindi and Urdu are also understood, especially in towns! 🇮🇳
Passed down through generations of monks and traders! 📿
Many place names come from Tibetan Buddhist terms! 🏔️
Prayer flags and prayer wheels often carry Tibetan script! 🎏
English is common in the tourism industry! 🌍

coolFacts.text: 'Jule' is one of the most useful words in Ladakh - it means hello, thank you, and goodbye, all in one! 🙏
Ladakhi shares deep roots with the Tibetan language spoken across the Himalayas! 🏔️
Prayer flags fluttering on mountain passes are printed with sacred Tibetan script! 🎏
Buddhist monks have preserved Ladakhi language and texts for centuries! 📿
Ladakh's culture and language link it closely with Tibet, just across the mountains! 🗻

didYouKnow.text: In Ladakh, you can use the single word 'Jule' to say hello, thank you, and goodbye - it makes learning your first Ladakhi word incredibly easy! 🙏

tryThis.text: Try using just one word for hello, thanks, AND goodbye for a whole day, like Ladakhis do with 'Jule' - see how far it gets you! 😄

en.narration:
In Ladakh, one simple word does almost everything - 'Jule' can mean hello, thank you, or goodbye, all depending on how you use it! 🙏

The Ladakhi language is closely related to Tibetan, and is often written using the same beautiful, ancient Tibetan script you'll see printed on colorful prayer flags fluttering across mountain passes. 🎏

Buddhist monks in Ladakh's monasteries have helped keep the language and its ancient texts alive for centuries. 📿

keyFacts.text: ལ་དྭགས་སྐད - ས་གནས་ཀྱི་སྐད། 🗣️
བོད་སྐད་རིགས་ཀྱི་སྐད། 📖
ཨིང་ལིཤ - སློབ་གྲྭ་དང་ལས་ཀའི་ནང། 📚
ཧིན་དཱི - མི་མང་པོས་གོ་བ། 🗣️
ཨུར་དུ - སྐད་ཡིག་གཞན་ཞིག 🎤
རིག་གནས་དང་སྐད་ཡིག་མཉམ་འབྲེལ། 🎭
བོད་ཡིག་ལ་གཞི་བཞག་པའི་ཡིག་གེ། ✍️
གྲོང་ཚོ་མང་པོར་སྐད་རང་རང་ཡོད། 🏘️
སྐད་ཡིག་ནི་རིག་གནས་ཀྱི་ངོ་རྟགས་ཡིན། 💚

coolFacts.text: ལ་དྭགས་སྐད་ནི་ས་གནས་ཀྱི་ཉིན་རེའི་སྐད་ཆའི་ནང་སྤྱོད་ཀྱི་ཡོད། 🗣️
བོད་ཡིག་གི་ཡིག་གེ་ནི་ཆོས་དང་རིག་གནས་ཀྱི་ཡིག་ཆའི་ནང་གལ་ཆེ། 📜
ལ་དྭགས་ཀྱི་གྲོང་ཚོ་ཁ་ཤས་ལ་སྐད་ཀྱི་མིང་སྒྲ་མི་འདྲ་བ་ཡོད། 🏘️
གླུ་གཞས་དང་གཏམ་རྒྱུད་ཀྱིས་ལོ་རྒྱུས་བསྲུངས་ཡོད། 🎵
སྐད་ཡིག་སྣ་ཚོགས་ཀྱིས་ལ་དྭགས་ཀྱི་རིག་གནས་སྣ་མང་མཚོན། 🌍

didYouKnow.text: ལ་དྭགས་ནི་སྐད་ཡིག་སྣ་མང་ཡོད་པའི་ས་ཁུལ་ཞིག་ཡིན་ཞིང་། ལ་དྭགས་སྐད་དང་བོད་སྐད་རིགས་ཀྱི་སྐད་མང་པོ་སྤྱོད་ཀྱི་ཡོད།

tryThis.text: ལ་དྭགས་སྐད་དང་བོད་ཡིག་གི་གསལ་བྱེད་ཁ་ཤས་སློབས། དེ་ནས་ས་གནས་ཀྱི་གླུ་གཞས་ཞིག་ཉན་དང་། 🎵

en.title: 🍜 THUKPA - Warming Noodle Soup of the Mountains!
en.mainText: A hot, hearty noodle soup packed with vegetables - the perfect meal to warm up in Ladakh's freezing mountain air!

keyFacts.text: Thukpa: a noodle soup with vegetables and sometimes meat! 🍜
Perfect for Ladakh's cold, high-altitude climate! ❄️
Skyu: a hearty pasta-and-vegetable stew, a Ladakhi classic! 🥘
Gur Gur Cha: traditional butter tea, salty and warming! ☕
Momos (dumplings) are hugely popular here too! 🥟
Barley is a key local crop, used to make Tsampa (roasted flour)! 🌾
Apricots grow well in Ladakh's sunny, dry valleys! 🍑
Food here is simple, warming, and high in energy! 🔥
Ingredients reflect what can grow in a cold desert! 🏜️
Meals are shared and eaten hot, fresh off the stove! 🍲

coolFacts.text: Butter tea (Gur Gur Cha) is salty, not sweet - it's made with butter, salt, and tea leaves! 🧈
Ladakh's dry sunny climate is actually perfect for growing sweet apricots! 🍑
Skyu is made by pinching small bits of dough into a rich vegetable stew! 🥘
Barley flour (Tsampa) has fueled Himalayan travelers for centuries! 🌾
Momos here often use local yak meat as a filling! 🥟

didYouKnow.text: Ladakh's traditional butter tea is salty, not sweet, and is packed with calories and fat - perfect for keeping people warm and energized in the freezing mountain cold! 🧈

tryThis.text: Ask an adult if you can try a warm bowl of noodle soup on a cold day, and notice how quickly it warms you up - just like Thukpa does in Ladakh! 🍜

en.narration:
Up in Ladakh's freezing mountain air, food needs to do one important job - keep you warm! Thukpa, a hearty noodle soup, does exactly that, packed with vegetables and sometimes meat. 🍜

Ladakhis also sip Gur Gur Cha, a salty butter tea that's more about staying warm and energized than tasting sweet.

And thanks to Ladakh's sunny, dry valleys, sweet apricots grow surprisingly well here, giving a fruity treat in this cold desert landscape. 🍑

keyFacts.text: ཐུག་པ - དྲོད་ཁོལ་གྱི་ཟས། 🍲
བག་ལེབ་ཀྱི་རིགས་དང་འདྲ་བའི་ཟས་ཆས། 🌾
སྔོ་ཚལ་དང་ཤ་སྤྱོད་ཆོག། 🥬
ཆུ་མང་པོ་ཡོད་པའི་ཟས། 💧
གྲང་དུས་སུ་དར་ཁྱབ་ཆེ། ❄️
ས་གནས་ཀྱི་ཁ་ཟས་ཀྱི་ཆ་ཤས། 🍚
ཁྱིམ་ཚང་གི་ཟས་སྡེ་ཞིག། 🏠
རྩམ་པ་དང་མཉམ་དུ་ཟ་བའི་སྲོལ་ཡོད། 🌾
དྲོ་པོར་ཟ་བའི་ཟས། 🔥
ལ་དྭགས་ཀྱི་ཟས་རིགས་ཀྱི་ངོ་རྟགས། 🎭

coolFacts.text: ཐུག་པའི་ནང་སྔོ་ཚལ་དང་ཤ་སོགས་ཀྱི་རྒྱུ་ཆ་སྣ་ཚོགས་བེད་སྤྱོད་ཆོག། 🥬
ཐུག་པ་ནི་གྲང་ངར་ཆེ་བའི་གནམ་གཤིས་སུ་དྲོད་ཁོལ་སྤྲོད་པའི་ཟས་ཡིན། ❄️
ས་གནས་སོ་སོར་ཐུག་པའི་རྒྱུ་ཆ་དང་བཟོ་སྟངས་མི་འདྲ། 🍲
ཁྱིམ་ཚང་གི་ཟ་མའི་ནང་ཐུག་པ་སྤྱོད་པ་མང་། 🏠
ཐུག་པ་ནི་སྔོ་ཚལ་དང་འབྲུ་རིགས་སོགས་ཀྱི་ཟས་སྡེ་ཞིག་ཡིན། 🌾

didYouKnow.text: ཐུག་པ་ནི་ལ་དྭགས་ཀྱི་གྲང་གནམ་གཤིས་དང་འཚམ་པའི་དྲོད་ཁོལ་གྱི་ཟས་ཤིག་ཡིན།

tryThis.text: ཐུག་པ་བཟོ་བར་རྒྱུ་ཆ་གང་དག་དགོས་མིན་འཚོལ། དེ་ནས་གྲང་ངར་ཆེ་བའི་ས་ཆར་དེ་ཅི་ལ་འཚམ་པ་བསམ་བློ་ཐོང་། 🍲

en.title: 💧 PANGONG LAKE - The Lake That Changes Color!
en.mainText: A stunning high-altitude lake that shifts between blue, green, and purple through the day - and stretches all the way from India into Tibet!

keyFacts.text: Located at about 4,350 meters above sea level! ⛰️
Stretches roughly 135 km long, mostly into Tibet (China)! 🗺️
Water shifts color - blue, green, turquoise, even purple! 🌈
Freezes completely solid in winter! ❄️
One of the highest saltwater lakes in the world! 🧂
Surrounded by bare, dramatic mountain ranges! ⛰️
Featured in several famous Bollywood movies! 🎬
No fish live in it due to high salt content! 🐟
Popular for camping under incredibly starry night skies! ✨
Roughly a 5-6 hour drive from Leh! 🚗

coolFacts.text: Pangong Lake's water is salty, but it still freezes completely solid every winter! ❄️
Only about a third of the lake actually lies in India - the rest stretches into Tibet! 🗺️
The lake's color can change several times in a single day depending on sunlight! 🌈
Its night skies are so clear and dark that stargazers travel here just for that! ✨
No fish or major aquatic life survive in its salty water! 🧂

didYouKnow.text: Even though Pangong Lake is a saltwater lake, it freezes completely solid in the harsh Ladakhi winter - people have even been known to walk across parts of it when frozen! ❄️

tryThis.text: Look up photos of Pangong Lake at different times of day and see how dramatically its color changes! 🌈

en.narration:
High in Ladakh's mountains lies a lake that seems to change its mind about what color it wants to be. Pangong Lake shifts between deep blue, turquoise, green, and even purple as the sunlight moves across the sky. 🌈

It's so long that most of it actually stretches into Tibet - only about a third lies inside India.

Despite being salty, the whole lake freezes solid in winter, and at night, its clear skies fill with more stars than most people have ever seen at once. ✨

keyFacts.text: ལ་དྭགས་ཀྱི་མཐོ་སྒང་དུ་ཡོད། 📍
མཚོའི་ཆུ་ཚྭ་ཅན་ཡིན། 💧
རི་བོས་བསྐོར་བ། 🏔️
མཚོའི་ཚོས་མདོག་འགྱུར་སྲིད། 🎨

en.title: 🐆 SNOW LEOPARD - The Ghost of the Mountains!
en.mainText: Ladakh is one of the best places on Earth to spot the elusive snow leopard, a big cat so well camouflaged it's nicknamed 'the ghost of the mountains'!

keyFacts.text: Ladakh is called the 'Snow Leopard Capital of the World'! 🏔️
Found especially in Hemis National Park! 🛡️
Thick gray-white fur camouflages it against rocky snow! ⚪
Weight: around 27-55 kg! ⚖️
Tail can be almost as long as its whole body, for balance! 🐈
Can leap up to 15 meters in a single jump! 🦘
Lives at altitudes up to 5,500 meters! 🏔️
Extremely elusive - very rarely seen even by researchers! 👻
Listed as Vulnerable, with only a few thousand left worldwide! 😢
Preys mainly on wild sheep and goats! 🐐

coolFacts.text: A snow leopard can leap up to 15 meters in one single bound - about the length of a bus! 🚌
Ladakh is considered one of the best places in the world to spot wild snow leopards! 🏔️
Its thick tail helps it balance on steep rocky cliffs and also wraps around its body for warmth! 🐈
It's so well camouflaged that local trackers can go years without a confirmed sighting! 👻
Snow leopards can survive in some of the coldest, highest terrain of any big cat! ❄️

didYouKnow.text: A snow leopard can leap an incredible 15 meters in a single jump - about as long as a city bus - which helps it chase prey across steep, rocky mountain terrain! 🦘

tryThis.text: Measure out 15 meters with a tape measure or by counting big steps - now imagine a big cat clearing that whole distance in one leap! 🐆

en.narration:
High in Ladakh's mountains lives one of the world's most mysterious big cats - the snow leopard. It's so well camouflaged against the gray, rocky, snow-dusted landscape that people call it the 'ghost of the mountains'. 👻

With a thick tail almost as long as its body, it can leap an astonishing 15 meters across cliffs while hunting wild sheep and goats.

Ladakh is one of the very best places on Earth to try and spot one - though even experienced trackers can search for years without a confirmed sighting! 🏔️

keyFacts.text: སྐམ་སྲིང - ལ་དྭགས་ཀྱི་སྲོག་ཆགས། 🐐

ལ་དྭགས་ཀྱི་རང་བྱུང་ངོ་རྟགས། 💚

coolFacts.text: སྐམ་སྲིང་གི་རྭ་ནི་གནས་སྟངས་དང་ལྟར་མི་འདྲ་བའི་རྣམ་པ་ཡོད། 🐐

en.title: 🏜️ LADAKH - The Cold Desert of the Himalayas!
en.mainText: A land of towering mountains, ancient monasteries, and barely any rain at all - Ladakh is one of the highest and driest inhabited places on Earth!

keyFacts.text: Known as India's 'Cold Desert'! 🏜️
Some of the highest motorable roads on Earth pass through here! 🚗
Home to centuries-old Buddhist monasteries (gompas)! 🛕
Least populated Union Territory in India! 🏙️
Magnetic Hill: an optical illusion where cars seem to roll uphill! 🧲
Nubra Valley has real sand dunes and double-humped camels! 🐫
Extremely low rainfall - a true high-altitude desert! ☔
Became its own Union Territory in 2019! 📅
Home to the Snow Leopard Capital of the World! 🐆
Winters can drop well below -20°C! ❄️

coolFacts.text: Nubra Valley has actual sand dunes, home to rare double-humped Bactrian camels! 🐫
Magnetic Hill creates an optical illusion where a parked car appears to roll uphill on its own! 🧲
Despite being called a desert, Ladakh is surrounded by some of the world's tallest mountains! 🏔️
Ladakh became a separate Union Territory, apart from Jammu & Kashmir, in 2019! 📅
It's one of the least densely populated regions anywhere in India! 🏙️

didYouKnow.text: Nubra Valley in Ladakh actually has sand dunes in the middle of the Himalayas - and you can ride double-humped Bactrian camels there, a species usually found in Central Asia, not India! 🐫

tryThis.text: Look up 'Magnetic Hill Ladakh' and watch a video of the strange uphill-rolling illusion! 🧲

en.narration:
Ladakh might be the strangest landscape in all of India - a cold desert tucked between some of the tallest mountains on Earth. 🏜️

It barely rains here, but ancient Buddhist monasteries have thrived in these dry valleys for centuries, their prayer flags fluttering in the thin mountain wind. 🛕

And Ladakh saves its biggest surprises for last: real sand dunes with double-humped camels in Nubra Valley, a hill where cars seem to roll uphill by magic, and enough snow leopards prowling the peaks to earn the nickname 'Snow Leopard Capital of the World'. 🐆

keyFacts.text: ལ་དྭགས - མཐོ་སྒང་གི་ས་ཆ། 🏔️

coolFacts.text: ལ་དྭགས་ཀྱི་རི་ལམ་མང་པོ་ནི་མཐོ་སྒང་གི་ས་ཁུལ་དུ་ཡོད། 🥾

en.title: 🏯 THIKSEY MONASTERY - The Mini Potala Palace!
en.mainText: A magnificent 12-story monastery perched on a hill, so grand it's often called a 'mini Potala Palace'!

keyFacts.text: Built in the 15th century! 📅
Home to a giant 15-meter-tall statue of the Maitreya Buddha! 🙏
Has 12 levels stacked up the hillside! 🏔️

coolFacts.text: The giant Buddha statue inside took four years to build and spans two stories of the monastery!
Monks here perform traditional masked dances during special festivals!

didYouKnow.text: Thiksey Monastery looks so similar to the famous Potala Palace in Tibet that people call it the 'mini Potala Palace' of Ladakh!

tryThis.text: If you visit, wake up early to watch the monks' morning prayer ceremony - it's a magical experience!

en.narration:
Perched on a hillside in Ladakh is Thiksey Monastery, sometimes called the 'mini Potala Palace'! 🏯

Built in the 15th century, its 12 levels climb up the hill, packed with prayer halls and monk quarters.

Inside sits a GIANT statue of the Maitreya Buddha, standing 15 meters tall and taking up two full stories of the building - it's truly awe-inspiring!

en.title: 🏛️ PATNA - An Ancient City on the Ganga!
en.mainText: Patna is the capital of Bihar and has a long history linked to ancient Magadha.

keyFacts.text: Capital of Bihar, on the banks of the Ganges River! 🌊
Population: around 20+ LAKH people! 🏙️
Ancient name: Pataliputra - over 2,500 years old! 📜
Was the capital of the mighty Maurya Empire (Emperor Ashoka's empire)! 👑
Golghar: a giant beehive-shaped granary built in 1786! 🏛️
Patna Sahib: important Sikh pilgrimage site (Guru Gobind Singh's birthplace)! 🙏
One of the longest continuously inhabited cities in the world! ⏳
Sits right along the mighty Ganges River! 🌊
Known for its historic role in India's freedom movement! 🇮🇳
Best time to visit: October-March! 🌤️

coolFacts.text: Patna, as ancient Pataliputra, was once one of the largest cities on Earth, over 2,000 years ago! 🏛️
Emperor Ashoka ruled his vast empire from right here! 👑
Golghar was built as an emergency grain storehouse after a terrible famine! 🌾
Guru Gobind Singh, the 10th Sikh Guru, was born in Patna! 🙏
Patna sits on the banks of the Ganges, one of the world's most sacred rivers! 🌊

didYouKnow.text: Patna was known as Pataliputra in ancient times and was the capital of the mighty Maurya Empire under Emperor Ashoka - making it one of the oldest continuously lived-in cities on the entire planet! 📜

tryThis.text: Look up how old your own city or town is, then compare it to Patna's 2,500+ year history! 📚

en.narration: Patna is the capital of Bihar and stands on the southern bank of the Ganga. The city has a long history stretching back to ancient Magadha. 🏛️

गोलघर पटना का प्रसिद्ध ऐतिहासिक स्थल! 🏛️
पटना साहिब सिख धर्म का महत्वपूर्ण तीर्थस्थल! 🙏
कुम्हरार में प्राचीन पाटलिपुत्र के अवशेष मिले हैं! 🏺
पटना संग्रहालय में अनेक ऐतिहासिक वस्तुएँ हैं! 🏛️
बिहार की शिक्षा और प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं का प्रमुख केंद्र! 📚
गंगा के कारण शहर का इतिहास व्यापार से जुड़ा रहा है! 🚤

coolFacts.text: प्राचीन पाटलिपुत्र मौर्य साम्राज्य की राजधानी था! 🏛️
चाणक्य और सम्राट अशोक का संबंध पाटलिपुत्र से था! 📚
गोलघर अनाज भंडारण के लिए बनाया गया था! 🌾
पटना साहिब गुरु गोबिंद सिंह जी का जन्मस्थान है! 🙏
कुम्हरार में प्राचीन सभा-भवन के अवशेष मिले हैं! 🏺

didYouKnow.text: पटना का प्राचीन नाम पाटलिपुत्र था। यह मौर्य साम्राज्य सहित कई शक्तिशाली प्राचीन राज्यों की राजधानी रहा था! 🏛️

tryThis.text: गोलघर और पटना संग्रहालय देखो! गंगा के किनारे शहर का इतिहास जानो और पटना साहिब के बारे में पढ़ो! 📚

hi.narration:
पटना बिहार की राजधानी और एक ऐतिहासिक शहर है! 🏛️

आज का पटना प्राचीन पाटलिपुत्र के पास विकसित हुआ है।

पाटलिपुत्र मौर्य साम्राज्य की राजधानी था और भारतीय इतिहास में इसका बहुत महत्व है! 📚

शहर गंगा नदी के किनारे बसा है! 🌊

गोलघर पटना की प्रसिद्ध ऐतिहासिक इमारत है। इसे अनाज रखने के लिए बनाया गया था! 🌾

पटना साहिब सिख धर्म का महत्वपूर्ण तीर्थस्थल है और गुरु गोबिंद सिंह जी का जन्मस्थान है! 🙏

कुम्हरार में प्राचीन पाटलिपुत्र के अवशेष मिले हैं! 🏺

पटना संग्रहालय में इतिहास से जुड़ी अनेक वस्तुएँ सुरक्षित हैं! 🏛️

आज पटना बिहार का प्रशासनिक, आर्थिक और शैक्षिक केंद्र है! 💼

जब पटना जाओ, तो इसके प्राचीन इतिहास और गंगा नदी से जुड़े जीवन को जरूर जानो! 🌊

en.title: 🗣️ MAITHILI, BHOJPURI & HINDI - Bihar's Many Voices!
en.mainText: Bihar is home to several beautiful languages - Maithili has its own ancient script and literary tradition dating back centuries!

keyFacts.text: Hindi is the main official language of Bihar! 🗣️
Maithili: a major regional language with its OWN ancient script (Mithilakshar)! ✍️
Bhojpuri: widely spoken, and famous through folk songs and films! 🎵
Magahi: another important regional language in Bihar! 🗣️
NAMASTE = Hello (Hindi)! 🙏
PRANAM = A respectful greeting used across Bihar! 🙏
Maithili literature dates back over a long culinary history! 📚
Bhojpuri cinema is a big regional film industry! 🎬
Ancient Pali and Sanskrit texts were composed in this region! 📜
Bihar was a major center of ancient Buddhist learning and scripture! 🕉️

coolFacts.text: Maithili has its own centuries-old script, separate from Devanagari! ✍️
Bhojpuri has grown into a full regional film industry, similar to Bollywood! 🎬
Buddhist scriptures were composed and studied in Bihar's ancient language, Pali! 📜
Maithili poet Vidyapati, from the 14th century, is still celebrated today! 📖
Bihar recognizes multiple regional languages alongside Hindi! 🗣️

didYouKnow.text: The Buddha delivered many of his early teachings in the Bihar region, and they were later written down in Pali - an ancient language closely related to Bihar's local tongues! 🕉️

tryThis.text: Try saying 'Pranam' with your palms together - it's a respectful greeting used widely across Bihar! 🙏

en.narration:
Bihar isn't just a one-language state - it's home to Hindi, Maithili, Bhojpuri, and Magahi, each with its own songs, poems, and history. 🗣️

Maithili even has its own ancient script, and its 14th-century poet Vidyapati is still celebrated today, over 600 years later!

Meanwhile Bhojpuri has grown into a whole film industry of its own, and centuries ago, this same region echoed with the ancient language of Pali, in which the Buddha's early teachings were first written down. 📜

hi.title: 🗣️ हिंदी - बिहार की प्रमुख भाषाओं में से एक!
hi.mainText: हिंदी बिहार की प्रमुख भाषाओं में से एक है! बिहार में हिंदी के साथ कई क्षेत्रीय भाषाएँ और बोलियाँ भी बोली जाती हैं! 📖

keyFacts.text: बिहार में हिंदी व्यापक रूप से बोली और समझी जाती है! 🗣️
देवनागरी लिपि में लिखी जाती है! ✍️
शिक्षा और प्रशासन में हिंदी का महत्वपूर्ण स्थान है! 🏫
भोजपुरी, मैथिली और मगही जैसी भाषाएँ भी बिहार में बोली जाती हैं! 💬
हिंदी साहित्य में बिहार के लेखकों का महत्वपूर्ण योगदान है! 📚
नमस्ते = अभिवादन का सामान्य शब्द! 🙏
धन्यवाद = आभार व्यक्त करने का शब्द! 💚
बिहार की लोकभाषाएँ इसकी सांस्कृतिक विविधता दिखाती हैं! 🌍
हिंदी फिल्मों और मीडिया में बिहार की भाषाई संस्कृति दिखाई देती है! 🎬
देवनागरी में स्वर और व्यंजन की व्यवस्थित लिपि है! ✍️

coolFacts.text: मैथिली भारत की मान्यता प्राप्त शास्त्रीय भाषाओं में शामिल है! 📖
विद्यापति मैथिली के प्रसिद्ध कवि थे! ✍️
भोजपुरी बिहार और आसपास के क्षेत्रों में व्यापक रूप से बोली जाती है! 🌍
मगही का संबंध प्राचीन मगध क्षेत्र से है! 🏛️
बिहार की भाषाओं में लोकगीतों की समृद्ध परंपरा है! 🎶

didYouKnow.text: बिहार भाषाई रूप से बहुत विविध है। हिंदी के साथ मैथिली, भोजपुरी, मगही और कई अन्य भाषाएँ तथा बोलियाँ यहाँ बोली जाती हैं! 🌟

tryThis.text: बिहार की अलग-अलग भाषाओं में 'नमस्ते' और 'धन्यवाद' कहना सीखो! मैथिली, भोजपुरी या मगही का कोई लोकगीत सुनो! 🎶

hi.narration:
बिहार की भाषाई दुनिया बहुत रंगीन है! 📖

हिंदी यहाँ व्यापक रूप से बोली और समझी जाती है।

लेकिन बिहार में केवल हिंदी ही नहीं बोली जाती। मैथिली, भोजपुरी, मगही और कई अन्य भाषाएँ और बोलियाँ भी यहाँ जीवंत हैं! 💬

मैथिली को भारत की मान्यता प्राप्त शास्त्रीय भाषाओं में शामिल किया गया है।

विद्यापति मैथिली के महान कवि माने जाते हैं! ✍️

भोजपुरी बिहार और आसपास के क्षेत्रों में बहुत व्यापक रूप से बोली जाती है।

मगही का संबंध प्राचीन मगध क्षेत्र से है! 🏛️

बिहार के लोकगीत इसकी संस्कृति का महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा हैं। छठ के गीत विशेष रूप से प्रसिद्ध हैं! 🎶

इन भाषाओं और बोलियों की विविधता बिहार की सांस्कृतिक पहचान को मजबूत बनाती है! 🌍

en.title: 🔥 LITTI CHOKHA - Bihar's Smoky Comfort Food!
en.mainText: Roasted wheat balls stuffed with spiced roasted gram flour, served with a smoky mashed-vegetable side - Litti Chokha is Bihar's ultimate comfort food!

keyFacts.text: Litti: round wheat-flour balls stuffed with spiced sattu (roasted gram flour)! 🌾
Traditionally roasted over an open cow-dung or wood fire! 🔥
Chokha: mashed, roasted eggplant, potato, and tomato! 🍆
Served with a drizzle of pure ghee (clarified butter)! 🧈
A filling, protein-rich, energy-packed meal! 💪
Sattu (roasted gram flour) is a Bihar specialty ingredient! 🌾
Thekua: a sweet fried wheat snack, big during festivals! 🍪
Simple, rustic ingredients from Bihar's farms! 🚜
A beloved street food and home-cooked classic! 🍽️
Eaten across the state, from villages to cities! 🏘️

coolFacts.text: Litti is traditionally roasted directly over hot coals or cow-dung fires for its smoky flavor! 🔥
Sattu, the stuffing, is a nutritious roasted-gram flour used in many Bihari dishes! 🌾
Litti Chokha is often called Bihar's answer to the baked potato - hearty and simple! 🥔
Thekua cookies are a must-have during the Chhath Puja festival! 🍪
The dish became popular across India as migrant Bihari workers carried the recipe with them! 🚉

didYouKnow.text: Litti is traditionally cooked over an open fire made from dried cow-dung cakes, which gives it a distinct smoky flavor that's hard to recreate in a regular oven! 🔥

tryThis.text: Ask a grown-up to help you roast something (like marshmallows or bread) over an open flame, and notice how the smoke changes the flavor! 🔥

en.narration:
Litti Chokha is Bihar's proudest comfort food - round balls of wheat dough stuffed with spiced sattu (roasted gram flour), traditionally roasted right over an open fire until smoky and golden. 🔥

They're served alongside Chokha, a smashed mix of roasted eggplant, potato, and tomato, with a drizzle of ghee on top for good measure.

During festivals like Chhath Puja, families also make Thekua, a sweet fried wheat cookie that fills homes with a delicious aroma. 🍪

hi.title: 🍚 लिट्टी-चोखा - बिहार का स्वाद!
hi.mainText: भुनी हुई लिट्टी और स्वादिष्ट चोखा—बिहार का लोकप्रिय पारंपरिक भोजन! 🌾

keyFacts.text: लिट्टी गेहूँ के आटे से बनाई जाती है! 🌾
अंदर सत्तू का मसालेदार भरावन होता है! 🌶️
लिट्टी को परंपरागत रूप से अंगारों पर भूना जाता है! 🔥
चोखा आलू, बैंगन और टमाटर से बनाया जा सकता है! 🍅
सरसों का तेल स्वाद में खास भूमिका निभाता है! 🌿
लिट्टी को घी के साथ भी परोसा जाता है! 🧈
ग्रामीण बिहार के पारंपरिक भोजन से जुड़ा व्यंजन! 🏡
अब यह बिहार के बाहर भी लोकप्रिय है! 🌍
सत्तू भुने हुए चने से बनाया जाता है! 🌾
इसे अलग-अलग तरीकों से परोसा जा सकता है! 🍽️

coolFacts.text: सत्तू को भुने हुए चने पीसकर बनाया जाता है! 🌾
लिट्टी का भरावन सत्तू, मसालों और जड़ी-बूटियों से तैयार होता है! 🌿
अंगारों पर पकाने से लिट्टी में अलग खुशबू आती है! 🔥
चोखा को हल्का भूनकर उसका स्वाद बढ़ाया जाता है! 🍆
लिट्टी-चोखा बिहार की पहचान से जुड़ा लोकप्रिय भोजन है! ❤️

didYouKnow.text: लिट्टी के अंदर भरा जाने वाला सत्तू भुने हुए चने से बनता है। अंगारों पर भुनी लिट्टी और बैंगन-टमाटर के चोखे का मेल बहुत लोकप्रिय है! 🍚

tryThis.text: लिट्टी-चोखा का स्वाद चखो! सत्तू का भरावन, भुनी लिट्टी और चोखे के अलग-अलग स्वाद पहचानने की कोशिश करो! 😋

hi.narration:
लिट्टी-चोखा बिहार का बहुत लोकप्रिय पारंपरिक भोजन है! 🍚

लिट्टी गेहूँ के आटे से बनती है और इसके अंदर सत्तू का मसालेदार भरावन भरा जाता है! 🌾

सत्तू भुने हुए चने को पीसकर बनाया जाता है। इसमें मसाले और दूसरी सामग्री मिलाई जाती है।

लिट्टी को पारंपरिक रूप से अंगारों पर भूना जाता है, जिससे उसमें खास खुशबू आती है! 🔥

इसके साथ चोखा परोसा जाता है। चोखा आलू, बैंगन और टमाटर जैसी सब्जियों से बनाया जा सकता है! 🍅

सरसों का तेल, हरी मिर्च और मसाले इसके स्वाद को बढ़ाते हैं! 🌶️

कई जगह लिट्टी को घी, चटनी और अचार के साथ भी खाया जाता है! 🧈

यह भोजन बिहार की ग्रामीण और शहरी दोनों खाद्य परंपराओं से जुड़ा है।

अब लिट्टी-चोखा बिहार के बाहर भी खूब लोकप्रिय है! 🌍

यह केवल खाना नहीं, बल्कि बिहार की भोजन संस्कृति का एक स्वादिष्ट हिस्सा है! ❤️

en.title: 🌳 BODH GAYA - Where Buddha Found Enlightenment!
en.mainText: Under a sacred fig tree in this small Bihar town, Siddhartha Gautama became the Buddha - making it one of the holiest places on Earth for millions of Buddhists!

keyFacts.text: Located in Bodh Gaya, Bihar! 📍
Site where the Buddha attained enlightenment, around 2,500 years ago! 🕉️
Mahabodhi Temple: a UNESCO World Heritage Site! 🏅
The sacred Bodhi Tree still grows here (a descendant of the original)! 🌳
Millions of Buddhist pilgrims visit from around the world! 🌏
Temple spire rises about 55 meters tall! 🏛️
Surrounded by monasteries built by different countries (Thailand, Japan, Bhutan and more)! 🛕
One of four most important Buddhist pilgrimage sites globally! 🙏
Original structure dates back over 1,a long culinary history! 📜
A peaceful place for meditation and reflection! 🧘

coolFacts.text: The Bodhi Tree growing here today is believed to be a direct descendant of the very tree Buddha sat under! 🌳
Countries from all over the world - Japan, Thailand, Bhutan, and more - have built their own monasteries around the temple! 🛕
Bodh Gaya is one of Buddhism's four holiest pilgrimage sites in the world! 🙏
The Mahabodhi Temple has stood, in various forms, for over 1,a long culinary history! 📜
Pilgrims travel from across Asia specifically to meditate under the Bodhi Tree! 🧘

didYouKnow.text: The Bodhi Tree at Bodh Gaya isn't the original tree from 2,500 years ago - but it's believed to be grown from cuttings of the original tree, carried and replanted across generations, keeping an unbroken living link to the Buddha's time! 🌳

tryThis.text: Sit quietly and still for two full minutes, like someone meditating - notice how your thoughts settle down! 🧘

en.narration:
Under a humble fig tree in the small town of Bodh Gaya, a young man named Siddhartha Gautama sat down to meditate - and rose up as the Buddha, having found enlightenment. 🌳

Today, a descendant of that very tree still grows on the spot, right beside the towering Mahabodhi Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Countries from across Asia - Japan, Thailand, Bhutan, and more - have built their own beautiful monasteries nearby, making Bodh Gaya one of the most peaceful and important pilgrimage sites on Earth. 🕉️

hi.title: 🏞️ राजगीर - पहाड़ों और इतिहास की धरती!
hi.mainText: राजगीर प्राचीन मगध की महत्वपूर्ण नगरी रही है! पहाड़, गर्म जलस्रोत और बौद्ध-जैन इतिहास इसे खास बनाते हैं! 🏛️

keyFacts.text: प्राचीन मगध की राजधानी रहा! 🏛️
राजगीर की पहाड़ियों से घिरा प्राकृतिक क्षेत्र! ⛰️
गर्म जलस्रोतों के लिए प्रसिद्ध! ♨️
बौद्ध और जैन परंपराओं से गहरा संबंध! 🙏
गृद्धकूट पहाड़ी बौद्ध इतिहास में महत्वपूर्ण है! 🏔️
भगवान बुद्ध के राजगीर आने का उल्लेख मिलता है! 📖
जैन धर्म के लिए भी महत्वपूर्ण तीर्थस्थल! 🕊️
विश्व शांति स्तूप यहाँ स्थित है! 🕊️
राजगीर के पास प्राचीन अवशेष और गुफाएँ हैं! 🏺
प्राकृतिक सुंदरता और इतिहास का मेल! 🌳

coolFacts.text: राजगीर का प्राचीन नाम राजगृह था! 🏛️
मगध के राजा बिंबिसार का संबंध राजगृह से था! 👑
गृद्धकूट पहाड़ी को बुद्ध के उपदेशों से जोड़ा जाता है! 📖
राजगीर के गर्म जलस्रोत धार्मिक और पर्यटन दोनों दृष्टि से प्रसिद्ध हैं! ♨️
विश्व शांति स्तूप एक पहाड़ी पर स्थित है! 🕊️

didYouKnow.text: राजगीर को प्राचीन समय में राजगृह कहा जाता था और यह मगध की महत्वपूर्ण राजधानी थी। बुद्ध और महावीर दोनों की परंपराओं से इसका गहरा संबंध है! 🏛️

tryThis.text: राजगीर की पहाड़ियों और गर्म जलस्रोतों को देखो! विश्व शांति स्तूप और प्राचीन अवशेषों के बारे में जानो! 🕊️

hi.narration:
राजगीर बिहार का एक ऐतिहासिक और प्राकृतिक रूप से सुंदर स्थान है! 🏞️

प्राचीन समय में इसे राजगृह कहा जाता था और यह मगध की महत्वपूर्ण राजधानी रहा था! 🏛️

राजगीर चारों ओर से पहाड़ियों से घिरा है। ⛰️

यहाँ गर्म जलस्रोत भी पाए जाते हैं, जो लंबे समय से धार्मिक और सामाजिक जीवन का हिस्सा रहे हैं! ♨️

राजगीर का संबंध बौद्ध और जैन परंपराओं से बहुत गहरा है।

गृद्धकूट पहाड़ी को भगवान बुद्ध के उपदेशों से जोड़ा जाता है! 📖

जैन परंपरा में भी राजगीर का विशेष महत्व है। 🙏

विश्व शांति स्तूप एक पहाड़ी पर बना सुंदर स्मारक है! 🕊️

क्षेत्र में प्राचीन दीवारों और अन्य पुरातात्विक अवशेषों को भी देखा जा सकता है! 🏺

राजगीर इतिहास, धर्म, पहाड़ और हरियाली को एक साथ अनुभव करने का अवसर देता है! 🌳

en.title: 🐃 GAUR - Bihar's State Animal!
en.mainText: The gaur is the state animal of Bihar.

keyFacts.text: Bihar is a key habitat for the critically endangered gharial! 🐊
Found in the Gandak River and other Bihar waterways! 🌊
Has a very long, thin snout, unlike other crocodiles! 👃
Lined with over 100 sharp, interlocking teeth for catching fish! 🐟
Males grow a bulb on the tip of the snout, called a 'ghara'! 🔵
Can grow up to 5-6 meters long! 📏
Almost entirely fish-eating (piscivorous)! 🐠
Critically Endangered - among the world's rarest crocodiles! 😢
Conservation centers breed gharials to release into rivers! 💚
Harmless to humans due to its narrow snout and diet! 🙂

coolFacts.text: The bump on a male gharial's snout, called a 'ghara', is used to make buzzing sounds to attract mates! 🔵
A gharial's thin snout is perfectly built for slicing through water to grab slippery fish! 🐟
Unlike other big crocodiles, gharials are not considered dangerous to people! 🙂
Wildlife centers along Bihar's rivers hatch and raise young gharials before releasing them! 💚
Gharials have changed very little in millions of years - they're almost living fossils! 🦴

didYouKnow.text: The gaur, also called the Indian bison, is Bihar's state animal.

tryThis.text: Look up a picture of a gharial's snout next to a regular crocodile's - notice how much longer and thinner it is! 🐊

en.narration: The gaur, also called the Indian bison, is Bihar's state animal.

hi.title: 🐂 गौर - बिहार का राजकीय पशु!
hi.mainText: गौर, जिसे भारतीय बाइसन भी कहा जाता है, बिहार का राजकीय पशु है। यह दुनिया के सबसे बड़े जंगली गोवंशों में से एक है! 🌳

keyFacts.text: गौर बिहार का राजकीय पशु है! 🐂
भारतीय बाइसन के नाम से भी जाना जाता है! 🌿
दुनिया के सबसे बड़े जंगली गोवंशों में से एक! 💪
वयस्क नर का शरीर बहुत शक्तिशाली होता है! 🐂
गौर झुंड में रह सकते हैं! 👥
घास, पत्तियाँ और वनस्पतियाँ खाते हैं! 🌱
घने जंगल इनके महत्वपूर्ण आवास हैं! 🌳
मजबूत खुर इन्हें कठिन भूभाग पर चलने में मदद करते हैं! 🏔️
गौर मुख्यतः एशिया के कुछ हिस्सों में पाए जाते हैं! 🌏
वन संरक्षण इनके अस्तित्व के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है! ❤️

coolFacts.text: गौर का शरीर घरेलू मवेशियों से बहुत बड़ा होता है! 💪
नर गौर के कंधों पर मांसपेशियों का उभार दिखाई देता है! 🐂
गौर के पैरों के निचले हिस्से का रंग हल्का हो सकता है! 👣
वे घास और पत्तियों जैसे पौधों पर निर्भर रहते हैं! 🌱
गौर सामाजिक झुंड बना सकते हैं! 👥

didYouKnow.text: गौर दुनिया के सबसे बड़े जंगली गोवंशों में से एक है। इसका शक्तिशाली शरीर और ऊँचा कंधा इसे आसानी से पहचानने योग्य बनाते हैं! 🐂

tryThis.text: गौर की तस्वीर देखो और उसके शरीर की बनावट पहचानो! जानो कि जंगलों और घास के मैदानों की रक्षा से ऐसे वन्यजीवों को कैसे मदद मिलती है! 🌳

hi.narration:
गौर बिहार का राजकीय पशु है! 🐂

इसे भारतीय बाइसन भी कहा जाता है।

गौर दुनिया के सबसे बड़े जंगली गोवंशों में से एक है! 💪

इसका शरीर बहुत शक्तिशाली होता है और वयस्क नर के कंधे बहुत ऊँचे और मजबूत दिखाई देते हैं।

गौर घास, पत्तियाँ और दूसरी वनस्पतियाँ खाते हैं! 🌱

वे अक्सर झुंड में रहते हैं और जंगल तथा घास वाले क्षेत्रों पर निर्भर रहते हैं! 👥

मजबूत खुर उन्हें जंगल के कठिन और ऊबड़-खाबड़ रास्तों पर चलने में मदद करते हैं।

गौर एशिया के कुछ हिस्सों में पाए जाते हैं और इनके लिए सुरक्षित प्राकृतिक आवास जरूरी हैं! 🌏

वनों और वन्यजीवों का संरक्षण गौर जैसे बड़े जंगली पशुओं के भविष्य के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! ❤️

en.title: NALANDA — AN ANCIENT CENTRE OF LEARNING
en.mainText: Nalanda in Bihar was a famous ancient centre of learning. Scholars from different regions studied there many centuries ago.

keyFacts.text: Nalanda was known for teaching and scholarship.
The archaeological remains show that it was a large learning complex.
Nalanda is an important part of India's educational history.

en.narration: Nalanda in Bihar was a famous ancient centre of learning. Scholars travelled from different regions to study there.

coolFacts.text: Nalanda was known for teaching and scholarship.
The archaeological remains show that it was a large learning complex.
